title.rendered: Best 3-in-1 Apple charging stations in 2026

content.rendered:
With iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, you hold the most powerful Apple digital trinity. It can be tiring to keep track of the charge count for three separate gadgets. Isn’t it a great idea to find a charging station that powers up these three Apple products simultaneously? Feeling surprised? Don’t be; we have got you covered!  

We’ve compiled a list of the best 3-in-1 charging stations for iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. A number of parameters were taken into consideration when selecting each entry, including connectivity, output, and cost. Your perfect pick will be determined by the pros and cons listed below each product. Let’s start! 

  1. PITAKA MagEZ Slider 2
  2. Belkin 3-in-1 stand
  3. ESR Charger
  4. Anker
  5. HiRise 3
  6. EXW
  7. WAITIEE
  8. GEEKERA
  9. DUMTERR

1. PITAKA MagEZ Slider 2 – Editor’s Choice

You cannot create a list of the best wireless charging stations for Apple devices without mentioning PITAKA. The globally acclaimed brand offers various charging products, including a 3-in-1 charger named PITAKA MagEZ Slider 2. Designed to perfection, this modular charger is an instant power plug for iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch. 

The triangular design allows you to charge your iPhone on the front, Apple Watch on the side, and AirPods on the back of the stand. In addition, this MFi-certified MagSafe charger houses a detachable 4000mAh power bank for iPhone. Furthermore, you can place the phone in horizontal mode during charging for a better viewing experience in movies.

You are also provided with a USB-C port on the right to plug in PITAKA’s Apple Watch dongle. Unfortunately, the Apple Watch dongle must be purchased separately. You must place the AirPods on the magnetic holder at the back of the product to charge them. The charging speed for the iPhone is 7.5W, Apple Watch is 5W, and AirPods is 5W.    

Pros

  • Powerful 4000mAh battery power bank 
  • Detachable charging dongle and pad 
  • MFi-certified charger 
  • Supports horizontal charging mode for iPhone 

Cons

  • Apple Watch dongle must be purchased separately 

Check out on Amazon

2. Belkin 3-in-1 stand – MagSafe charging for Apple devices

Designed like a tree, Belkin 3-in-1 wireless charging station is a perfect companion for your Apple ecosystem. With MagSafe support, this powerful charger ensures on-the-go charging for your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously. In addition, the three charging modules make your work easy like never before.  

The wireless device supports Apple fast charging up to 15 watts for iPhone 14, 13, and 12 series. You also get 33% fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7, 8, and Ultra. Meanwhile, other Apple Watches get regular charge times.

The unique T-shape ensures that you can put the charger in the smallest of places, like your cluttered table. Also, you can suspend your iPhone and Apple Watch using the magnetic system embedded in the two side rods. For charging the AirPods, place them on the round bottom. Simple as it can get.  

Pros

  • Unique T-shaped compact design 
  • Wireless MagSafe charging 
  • Fast charging for Apple Watch and iPhone 
  • Robust magnetic connection 

Cons

  • Expensive 

Check out on Amazon 

3. ESR MagSafe charger – HaloLock & CryoBoost Support

Let’s accept that overheating is one of the most common problems synonymous with chargers, wired or wireless. But what if you get a charger with an in-built heat dissolution solution? I am talking about ESR’s HaloLock 3-in-1 charger with CryoBoost.

FYI, CryoBoost technology prevents gadget heating when charging is on. As a result, HaloLock and CryoBoost ensure the speedy and safe charging of the iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. The charger gives a maximum charging output of up to 7.5W for the iPhone and 5W for the Apple Watch and AirPods, respectively. Also, the magnetic strength of the charging pad is 1000 grams.

Furthermore, the 360-degree magnetic ring makes switching between landscape or portrait modes easy. For the Apple Watch, this device has a separate stand next to the AirPods charging pad. With its USB-A and USB-C ports, you get a seamless charging experience.

Additionally, the device houses a circular ridge that shows the CryoBoost status light and works as a vent for the cooling fan and the heat disbursement technology.   

Pros

  • HaloLock support 
  • CryoBoost technology ensures optimum heat dissipation 
  • A strong magnetic charging pad 
  • Speedy charging 

Cons

  • Lacks Qi wireless charging 

Check out on Amazon 

6. Anker – Magnetic pads for quick charging

Anker is undoubtedly one of the most trusted brands for charging equipment. The manufacturer’s 3-in-1 charger, designed exclusively for Apple devices, stands out in the market. Despite its compact size, the charger allows you to juice up the iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods at the same time.

The magnetic pads give instant charging of up to 7.5W for the iPhone 14, 13 and 12 series and a 5W output for AirPods. To charge, you must place the iPhone on the vertical pad AirPods and Apple Watch on the bottom pads. Moreover, this Anker charger boasts an innovative foldable design where you can press and pull the Apple Watch or iPhone charging pad as needed.   

Multiple viewing adjustments of the charger bless you with a comfortable viewing experience.  For instance, you can place your iPhone, either vertically or horizontally, or adjust the angle to 40 degrees to always be in sync with your work notifications. Further, you get short circuit protection, temperature control, foreign object detection, and other safety modules.  

Pros

  • The compact design gives portability 
  • Multiple viewing  
  • Various safety features 

Cons

  • Overheating 

Check out on Amazon

4. HiRise 3 – Clean design

Are you someone who likes using multiple gadgets but forgets to put them on charging? With HiRise 3 charger, you can smartly solve this common issue. The stunning yet compact design of the charging stand, paired with three robust charging surfaces, makes this product one of the best Apple charging stations.   

Additionally, you can save time by charging your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously with Twelve South’s HiRise 3 charger. Moreover, wireless charging support on this 3-in-1- charger gives you freedom from the hassle of cords. Place your iPhone on the magnetic pad, without or with MagSafe-compatible covers, to get an instant charging boost.   

HiRise 3 charger is CE, FCC, and ROHS certified, so safety will never be an issue with this product. The built-in voltage and temperature controllers add extra points to the dock’s protection level. Also, you get light indicators at the bottom.

Pros

  • Quick wireless charging 
  • MagSafe support 
  • Certified protection  
  • Light indicators 

Cons

  • Seldom overheating issue 
  • Gadget placement issues 

Check out on Amazon

8. EXW – Portable 3-in-1 Apple-friendly charger

Switch to EXW 3-in-1 charging station to enjoy safe, speedy, and economical charging support for your Apple gadgets. The wireless charging station saves you time by simultaneously charging your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch. This portable charging dock has a design where you can place the iPhone on the slanting magnetic pad, AirPods on the tiny pad next to it, and Apple Watch on the suspended pad.

With EXW multidirectional charging, you get complete flexibility to place your iPhone the way you want. Feel free to use vertical or horizontal charging orientation on video calls when enjoying movies. Moreover, the folding design of the charger adds another layer of comfort for you.

Also, the wireless charging station saves you from common issues like temperature fluctuation, overcurrent flow, and over-voltage flow. Moreover, the tiny holes at the bottom of the charger ensure quick heat dissipation while charging your gadgets. You also get a sleep-friendly blue light indicator on the charger that automatically turns off after 20 seconds. Easy, right?

Pros

  • Speedy charging  
  • Multi-angular adjustment  
  • Foldable design 

Cons

  • Issues with AirPods charging 

Check out on Amazon 

5. WAITIEE – Top-rated wireless charging station

With WAITIEE 3-in-1 charger, you get a combination of efficient, quick, and budget-friendly charging. The device helps you charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods at the same time.

The 15W fast wireless charging for iPhone keeps your smartphone ready for you at all times. In addition, the WAITIEE 3-in-1 charging station has a non-slip silicone design that offers the finest grip. So, your gadgets are safe even when you move the charging station from one place to another. The slight tilt angle of the magnetic charging pad allows you to place your iPhone vertically and horizontally.

Regarding safety, the powerful charger provides high-end protection from multiple mechanisms like excessive voltage flow, over-current flow, or fluctuating temperature play. Moreover, the foreign object detection feature adds an extra layer of security to your gadgets. In addition, the charger’s base has a venting hole that supports heat dissipation. 

Pros

  • Supports hybrid charging for Apple and Android 
  • No-slip silicone design 
  • Lights for charge status  

Cons

  • Less durable 

Check out on Amazon 

7. GEEKERA – Anti-slip padding for extra safety

Enjoy the ultimate charging experience with GEEKERA 3-in-1 wireless charging station for Apple devices. Super-efficient battery support helps you instantly charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. With its compact design, you don’t have to make a dedicated section to place this charger.

The innovative U-plate design of the charger gives you the much-needed flexibility to use it as a phone stand. Place your phone in horizontal or vertical orientations using this amazing multipurpose dock. Whether it is a video call or your routine binge-watching, the GEEKERA charger ensures you can place your iPhone how you want, even when it’s in charging mode.   

All three charging areas and the bottom of the GEEKERA charger carry anti-electrostatic and anti-slip pads. This keeps your gadgets and the charging stand from slipping down the surface it is placed on. Also, the charger houses a green LED indicator that ensures the correct placement of the Apple gadgets on the charging station.

Pros

  • U-plate design for quality viewing 
  • Anti-spillage padding 
  • LED indicator  

Cons

  • Less effective for Apple Watch 

Check out on Amazon 

9. DUMTERR – Charging with the case

DUMTERR 3-in-1 charger is one of the best charging stations for Apple products. Its USP lies in the fact that it supports charging even with your gadget’s case. In addition, the plug-in dock offers seamless compatibility with phone cases of different shapes and thicknesses. With this wireless charger, you can power up your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously.   

Regarding Power, DUMTEER offers a maximum output of 12W for iPhone and 2.5W for AirPods and Apple Watch, respectively. Additionally, the charging station supports magnetic charging for your smartwatch, has a sleep-friendly light indicator, and anti-slip padding at the bottom to avoid impromptu drops. The device works well for all iPhone series, Apple Watch Series Ultra/8/7/6/SE/5/4/3/2, and AirPods 1/2/3/Pro.  

The portable charger blesses you with perfect performance and ease of use pairing. Its sleek and handy design only consumes a little space on your desk. Moreover, the lightweight body of the product helps you carry it inside your backpack or laptop bag during outdoor visits. Now, you don’t have to worry about taking multiple chargers for every Apple device separately. 

Pros

  • Charging with gadget case 
  • 12W maximum output for iPhone  
  • Wide compatibility 

Cons

  • Issues with Apple Watch and AirPods charging 

Check out on Amazon 

Bonus: Apple MagSafe Duo

What’s better than choosing a charger from the creator itself? Here is Apple MagSafe Duo. The stunning charger can give an instant battery boost to two Apple devices simultaneously. So, be it your AirPods, Apple Watch, or iPhone – pick the gadget combo you want to power up and place them on the charger.

The MagSafe charging pad is on the left, while the Apple Watch charging pad and USB-C port are on the right. With its 14W maximum MagSafe charging and Lightning port, Apple MagSafe Duo will return your gadgets to work quickly. Also, the MagSafe charging pad doubles as a 7.5W Qi wireless charging pad.  

You get a metal hinge with 90-degree movement on the Apple Watch pad. This allows you to use it flush with the charging pad or press it up from the bottom to switch to the nightstand mode. Unfortunately, the charger does not support fast charging for the Apple Watch Series 7.   

Pros

  • Portable design 
  • Works with multiple Apple devices 
  • 14W MagSafe charging 
  • Lightning port 

Cons

  • Expensive 
  • No fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 

Check out on Amazon

Wrapping up… 

Technology makes your life easy, and Apple makes it more accessible. Having multiple gadgets is a boon for workaholics, but maintaining their battery levels can take time and effort. This is when these best 3-in-1 Apple charging stations can come into play. They are compact, cost-friendly, and super-efficient. I hope you find your perfect pick from the list here.   

What’s your favorite takeaway from this article? Do let me know in the comments.

title.rendered: Best 10.5” iPad Pro Stands in 2026

content.rendered:
So, if you have bought Apple’s newest tablet and looking to maximize its productivity, I would recommend you to keep a tab on two essential accessories—a quality keyboard case and a superior stand. Having already made an elite list of keyboard cases, I have now set my sight on the best 10.5-inch iPad Pro stands.

Table of Contents
  • 1. TechMatte
  • 2. OMOTON
  • 3. Pasonomi
  • 4. UGREEN
  • 5. Elevation Lab
  • 6. Lamicall
  • 7. MoKo
  • 8. Fintie
  • 9. Suptek
  • 10. AboveTEK

1. TechMatte

With the premium aluminum material, TechMatte, iPad stand sports a compact design. The matte finish gives it a polished look, while two-tone colors further enhance its appearance. The one-touch button, as well as 270-degree of rotation, ensures you have the desired viewing angle.

This solid stand holds your iPad Pro both in horizontal and vertical angles. The non-slip grip keeps your device intact. Lastly, TechMatte stand comes in two nice-looking colors like silver and rose gold.

USP: Premium Aluminum
Check out on Amazon

2. OMOTON

This stand from OMOTON is designed to provide you with optimal viewing and typing angle. What makes it highly impressive is the robust profile. Made of high-quality aluminum and silicone material, it’s very durable. You can rotate the stand up to 210-degree up and down. As it supports both vertical and horizontal angles, you will enjoy using your tablet.

It features a side circular cutout to let you neatly manage the charging cable. That’s not all; this good-looking tablet stand is available in three attractive colors such as black, rose gold, and silver.

USP: Optimum Viewing Angle
Check out on Amazon

3. Pasonomi

Pasonomi is what you would want to transform your iPad Pro into a convenient desktop computer (sort of). It securely holds your device both in portrait and landscape modes. You can comfortably adjust the angle of your tablet to make the most of your media time.

Premium aluminum construction has been enriched by the matte finish. The anti-slip pad provides it the needed stability to stand erectly. Despite being so solid, the stand is very lightweight and portable. It comes only in silver color.

USP: Solid Build-Up
Check out on Amazon

4. UGREEN

If simplicity is your choice, bring home UGREEN’s iPad Pro stand. This foldable iPad holder is so compact that you can slip it in your pocket. Its multi-adjustable angle allows you to position your iPad Pro in ten different viewing angles from 0 to 100 degrees.

For ultimate viewing comfort, use UGREEN desktop stand holder dock, which is perfect for watching videos, reading eBooks, video recording or browsing websites.

USP: Multi-adjustable angles
Check out on Amazon

5. Elevation Lab

As the name suggests, this iPad Pro stand elevates your device to give you that right angle while you are using your iPad. The stand is perfectly suitable for designers and creative people, who want to draw something quickly with Apple Pencil. This stand comes with a Pencil stand and an armrest so that you can continue your work for long hours.

All in all, this stand makes your iPad Pro more ergonomic and better to work on. Once the stand is placed on a surface, it doesn’t move as it is rock solid at all four positions. You can select from a wide range of angles.

USP: Engineered hinges
Check out on Amazon

6. Lamicall

Showcasing adorable workmanship, Lamicall strikes the right chord from all aspects. Engineered with the finest aluminum alloy material, this stand has been carved to be a premium choice. It provides a 270-degree rotation to let you perfectly adjust your device.

acceptedAnswer.text: An App Clip is generally between 10MB and 15MB in size. Earlier, the restriction was to keep App Clips under 10MB, but with the introduction of better technology and internet connectivity, App Clips in iOS 16 or later can be up to 15MB large.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to download the full app to use the App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you don't need to download the full app. In fact, App Clips work as a teaser for the full app, providing you access to a specific feature to showcase the app's capabilities. If you like the App Clip's functionality, you can download the full app from the App Store.

mainEntity.name: Can I use call waiting while using Wi-Fi calling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, call waiting works with Wi-Fi calling, provided your carrier supports the feature. You'll receive the same notifications for incoming calls.

mainEntity.name: Do iPhones show call waiting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when call waiting is active, your iPhone shows the incoming call notification, along with multiple options to handle the second call.

mainEntity.name: Does call waiting cost money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call waiting is generally free, but some carriers may charge for the feature. Check with your network provider for details.

title.rendered: Protect Your iPad Mini 5: Best Folio Case Picks

content.rendered:
Your iPad mini 5 has just gotten better with unique spec bumps. This will encourage many Apple fans to go for this mini but mightier tablet. But how long will you be able to keep your tab new? Well, you read my mind! It is cases and covers that retain the luster and glamour of your 2019 iPad mini. Check this collection of the best folio cases for iPad mini 5. Why folio cases for your mini-tablet? Unlike other cases, a folio case completely covers your iPad from all corners and sides. Moreover, it offers excellent functionality in card slots, currency pockets, pencil holders, and more. These are enough reasons for any consumer or a pro-user to go for the best folio cases.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Fintie
  • 2. Ztotop
  • 3. ESR
  • 4. Veco
  • 5. KAVAJ
  • 6. ROARTZ
  • 7. DTTO

1. Fintie

Fintie has achieved perfection in crafting a folio case. So it seems from this iPad mini smart case, which supports auto sleep/wake feature. This protective cover with pocket allows you to adjust your device to multiple angles. Don’t miss that document card pocket, which can store your business cards, bank cards, currency, etc.

Fintie uses premium material to build leather exterior and soft microfiber interior. This not only makes the case snug fit but also keeps it durable and protective.

USP: Premium composition
Check out on Amazon

2. Ztotop

Ztotop has successfully imparted premium quality and a remarkable elegance to this folio case. The very color (brown) grabs your attention for a long time. By the time you recover yourself from the color charisma, you are floored by its features. Auto sleep/wake, wallet pocket, pencil strap holder, and whatnot!

Enjoy quick and full access to all the features and controls on your iPad. User-friendliness is the key here as Ztotop has woven brilliant craft with multi-functional features. Look at those multiple deep grooves to adjust your iPad at numerous horizontal angles.

USP: Extraordinary artistry
Check out on Amazon

3. ESR

Bring home the urban charm of ESR’s premium folio case, which showcases a book cover design. A notable feature of this multi-angle viewing case is ventilation. To keep your device cool, ESR has installed a PC backplate with a large ventilation cut-out.

To create a magical effect, ESR has used PU leather with wood grain texture and decorative stitching. A combination of soft outer cover and robust frame keeps your iPad mini safe.

USP: Decorative stitching
Check out on Amazon

4. Veco

Veco leaves no stone unturned to impress iPad mini users – consumers and pro-users. Taken from Veco’s Denim Series, this folio flip stand case has Pencil holder. If you are using the first generation Apple Pencil, you can easily attach it to this case.

This book-style folio case adds an elegant personality to your iPad mini. Beyond fashion, Veco has paid full attention to features like anti-slip grip, comfortable touching with denim surface, and anti-perspiration.

USP: Denim surface
Check out on Amazon

5. KAVAJ

KAVAJ has carved a niche in the world of folio cases. For your iPad mini 5, Kavaj has used genuine cowhide leather and crafted a slim fit smart folio cover. On this lightweight and durable case, Kavaj has shown its artistry of thin and minimal design.

The elegance of organic leather never overshadows the bright display of your iPad mini. Whether you are watching movies or making FaceTime calls, you can always fold this folio case at a perfect angle.

USP: Organic leather
Check out on Amazon

6. ROARTZ

ROARTZ offers a range of eye-catching folio cases for your iPad mini. This metallic magenta case is the choice of women having discerning tastes. The thin and lightweight case does not add much bulk to your device, and you would love to carry your tablet everywhere.

The rubber finish on a robust polyurethane exterior ensures full body protection against fingerprints and scratches.

USP: Rubber finish
Check out on Amazon

7. DTTO

For the lovers of leather products, DTTO brings an iPad mini folio case with Apple Pencil holder. Its multi-functional design includes leather hand strap for easy handling and an organizer pocket to store other iPad accessories and bank cards.

On the inner left folio, you will notice multiple slots to set up horizontal stand angles to watch videos, type texts, and make FaceTime calls. Durable material and synthetic leather exterior make it a perfect case for your iPad mini tab.

USP: Stable stand mode
Check out on Amazon

That’s all folks!

Wrapping up…

The profile of a folio case is more suitable for people, who are living a calm and composed life. You can replace your wallet case with high-quality folios mentioned above.

Related Posts:

  • Best iPad Mini 5 Heavy-duty Cases

Which folio case would you like to buy from the list? Share your feedback in comment section.

title.rendered: Best Game Controllers for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
Even though Mac is not a hardcore gaming OS, there are some exciting games to play. Gaming Keyboards and Mouse are okay to deal with, but nothing can replace the comfort of playing with a Game Controller on your Mac. The additional comfort is that you can lay down cozily on your Couch while you enjoy the game. A thing to note with gaming controllers is their design. No matter how pro you are in a game, if you aren’t comfortable with your controller, you will likely lose the battle. If you are going through this trouble, better look at some of the best gaming controller for Mac we have handpicked down here in this list.

Table of Contents
  • Thrustmaster
  • Nimbus SteelSeries
  • iNNEXT
  • RunSnail
  • Gam3Gear

1. Thrustmaster

While playing a game on your Mac, you need superior comfort. For more extended gaming sessions, a gaming controller has to have wide hand-rest for optimal comfort. Thrustmaster’s joystick highlights this feature. With easily accessible buttons, this controller provides you hassle-free gaming pleasure.

This gaming joystick comes with 12 buttons and five axels, which are fully programmable. If you love to play games related to civil aviation and military air strikes, this controller has a trigger for brakes and rapid fire.

USP: High-precision
Check out on Amazon

2. Nimbus SteelSeries

Nimbus SteelSeries brings a Bluetooth gaming controller for your Mac. This MFi-certified controller gives you a real wireless console experience on your Mac and other iOS devices. Pressure-sensitive buttons allow you to play games for hours without causing finger cramp.

Once you recharge this controller, it can be used for more than 40 hours to enjoy non-stop gaming. You can use the Nimbus Companion app to explore free and paid controller-enabled games on your mobile devices. If you are a fan of playing Fortnight on your Mac, you must get this one!

USP: 40+ hours battery
Check out on Amazon

3. iNNEXT

iNNEXT offers two pack retro USB super controller gamepad for your Mac. It is not Bluetooth-enabled but has five feet long cord to keep a reasonable distance between your Mac and the joypad. You can connect this generic USB controller with a standard USB port.

Sensitive buttons ensure precise control over your game. This joypad can be connected to your personal computer, Notebook, laptop, MacBook, and Android smartphones via USB OTG cable.

USP: 5-feet cable
Check out on Amazon

4. RunSnail

RunSnail has achieved greater performance value with new features like motion controls, vibration, USB-C, and turbo functionality. RunSnail’s gaming controller is known for its broad compatibility, and this quality makes it the first choice of real gamers. This multi-compatible controller is perfect for gaming aficionados, who love to switch platforms at office and home.

A notable feature of this controller is built-in smart CPU. Its firmware can be upgraded to expand its function in the future. Enjoy its retro design and make the most of its clickable joysticks.

USP: Built-in smart CPU
Check out on Amazon

5. Gam3Gear

With its pocket-size profile, Gam3Gear wireless gamepad controller is your perfect companion while you are playing games on your Mac. Its petite body and delicate design can be moved around like a jewelry piece. Tie the lanyard (comes in the package) to the gamepad, and you can use it as a keychain.

Fully charge this gamepad for once and enjoy your games for 20 long hours. The product is compatible with all mainstream gaming platforms like macOS, Android, and Windows.

USP: Pocket-size profile
Check out on Amazon

That’s all, friends!

Are you in the game?

Mac offers an excellent platform for gamers to play their favorite games. A controller with ergonomic design and high-quality material, you can play games for a long time tirelessly.

You may also like to explore:

  • Best Game Controllers for iPhone
  • Free Games for iPhone and iPad

Which game controller would you like to buy for your Mac? Share your thoughts and feedback with us in the comment box.

title.rendered: Best iPad Mini 2 Keyboard Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
If you write emails, notes, create documents on the iPad mini (1, 2), a keyboard improves the experience vastly as opposed to tapping on the screen. iPad mini 2 keyboard cases are dual purpose: they serve as a good Bluetooth keyboard, and they protect your iPad. Even more importantly, each of these is designed to be a good stand for the iPad mini 2 so it’s easy to type and work on the iPad mini.

The market is quite inundated with a lot of knock-offs and low-quality iPad mini 2 keyboard cases. What matters is not just the keyboard’s quality but the backup(battery), the overall design, the case cover and its quality. Most keyboards have the Apple layout (Mac) and come with enough buttons to make interacting with the iPad mini (retina) very easy. We picked a few iPad Mini 2 Bluetooth keyboard cases/covers. Check it out:

Table of Contents
  • 1. BoriYuan
  • 2. elecfan
  • 3. Snugg
  • 4. Arteck
  • 5. Fintie
  • 6. Alpatronix KX101

1. BoriYuan

BoriYuan keyboard case has got a stylish look. The form-fitting design makes a fine match with the iPad Mini. Thanks to the aluminum alloy bottom and ABS plastic keys, the cover is very durable.

You can trust the clamshell to withstand impact. Beyond protection, the keys offer responsive feel ensuring your typing remains easy.

There are some special keys to let you carry out your tasks faster. If you like colorful profile, you would appreciate the six color options.

USP: Durable clamshell
Check out on Amazon

2. elecfan

Speaking the truth; it’s the attractive design that has made me want “elecfan.” The hard shell case pairs snuggly with the iPad. It has a special cutout for the Apple logo on the back, ensuring the brand can shine through elegantly.

With the 130-degree flip, you can fine-tune the viewing angle. You can take advantage of the seven colors LED backlit to work on your iPad comfortably even in the night.

Moreover, elecfan comes in four-color variants including black, rose gold, silver, and gold.

USP: Seven colors LED-backlit
Check out on Amazon

3. Snugg

Snugg keyboard case sports and elegant appearance. What I like about it is the 360-degree rotation and the multi-angle adjustments which offer great user-experience.

As the keyboard case is extremely lightweight, you can comfortably carry it. The precise cutouts for speakers, port, and buttons ensure you have a great time using it. Moreover, it is available in six beautiful colors like purple, hot pink, etc. (works with iPhone Mini 1/2/3)

USP: 360-degree rotating stand
Check out on Amazon

4. Arteck

With the larger key size, Arteck keyboard case is designed to offer a smooth-sailing typing experience. It quickly connects to your iPad via Bluetooth.

The keyboard case comes with the built-in hinges which allow the iPad to tilt up to 130-degrees to provide better viewing position. You can fully charge it in one hour and use it for up to 50 hours. It supports iPad Mini 1/2/3.

USP: Large key size for smooth typing
Check out on Amazon

5. Fintie

Fintie keyboard case is endowed with a captivating look. Crafted with the quality PU leather and soft microfiber interior, it’s equipped to safeguard your tablet from minor drops.

The keyboard with the finest ABS material makes typing easy. With the spring mechanism underneath each key, it provides tactile response speeds up typing. The Bluetooth keyboard case comes in as many as 14 vibrant colors.

USP: Rubberized interior for enhanced shock absorption
Check out on Amazon

6. Alpatronix KX101

“Alpatronix KX101” Bluetooth keyboard case is very protective. Prepared with the quality PU leather, it can safeguard your iPad from drops and scratch. The intuitive QWERTY keyboard offers a full-fledged typing experience.

The ABS chiclet keys are very responsive. Most importantly, it’s equipped to deliver 120 hours of working time and 800 hours of long standby time. The wireless keyboard case comes in only two colors—black and pink.

USP: High-quality vegan leather
Check out on Amazon

Signing Off

I hope these Bluetooth keyboard cases have been able to pass your test with good marks. If you have found any of these cases special, do let me know that. Also, if there is any keyboard case you want to see on this list, make sure to mention it.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

content.rendered:
Apple just unveiled its second-generation silicon, the M2 SoC, and the first device to sport it is none other than the bestselling laptop in the world, the MacBook Air. The refreshed MacBook Air 2022 has several upgrades like a new design, MagSafe 3 charging port, better battery life, etc. However, the M2 SoC is the most significant upgrade to the MacBook Air 2022.

Moreover, according to Apple, the M2 SoC is faster than its predecessor by 1.4x and a whopping 15x times that of its Intel-based model, thanks to the 8-Core CPU and a 10-Core GPU. Even if you aren’t planning to buy this cool MacBook Air right anytime soon, you can have its cool wallpaper. Yes, it’s pretty stunning!

Table of Contents
  • M2 MacBook Air 2022 wallpaper
  • More about M2 MacBook Air
  • What are your thoughts?

M2 MacBook Air 2022 wallpaper

I loved how WWDC presented this product; undoubtedly, its wallpaper is equally gorgeous! Just tap the download button below, right-click and select save the image to make it your new background.

Download

More about M2 MacBook Air

The M2-powered MacBook Air has undergone a design change and now looks quite similar to its Pro siblings in terms of the display and body. Yes, the notch is finally here, and it houses an upgraded 1080p FaceTime HD camera with a three-mic array and a quad-speaker Spatial Audio system.

The Liquid Retina display of the M2 MacBook Air is now 13.6 inches, thanks to the notch. Moreover, it has the highest brightness of 500 nits on any MacBook yet. It also supports a P3-wide color gamut, True Tone technology, and more. The text is crisp, and the video has excellent contrast and details.

The Magic Keyboard of the M2 MacBook Air finally has a dedicated function row while retaining Touch ID. Using Touch ID, you can unlock your Mac, make payments, make in-app purchases, and a lot more. Also, fast charging is here as the device supports 67W charging and can charge from 0-50% in 30 minutes.

The MacBook Air lineup has always stood true to its name; even the MacBook Air weighs just 2.7 pounds and is 0.44 inches thick (or should I say 0.44 inches thin?).

Exciting color options were what we were missing with the MacBooks, and this one finally comes in 4 new exciting colors: Midnight, Space Gray, Starlight, and Silver. I’m in love with the Midnight color variant and feel it looks the best among the lot.

What are your thoughts?

With significant upgrades to the device, the prices have also increased. You can get the MacBook Air M2 for $1,199 and also get $100 off with education pricing. The MacBook Air M1 is still available for $999. Let me know your thoughts on the MacBook Air M2 2022 and if you intend on getting one in the comments below!

title.rendered: Best iPhone and iPad games for kids in 2026

content.rendered:
If you’ve got kids, you’ll relate to the feeling of exasperation when you need to distract your kid and get some work done. However, rather than idling their time away with some insignificant games, you could expose them to games that could improve their cognitive or physical abilities. Yes, they exist! Keeping this in mind, I have listed some of the best iPhone and iPad games for kids. I am sure they will love them.

1. Kids games for 2,3,4-year-olds: Best educational game

The first five years of a child will house some of their most important experiences. At this age, cognitive abilities often develop the fastest. So when you’re exposing them to games, you’d want these games to aid their development.

Kids games for 2, 3, 4 year olds help improve children’s ability to understand and implement instructions. From problem-solving skills to creative nuances, you’ll find games catering to almost every aspect of a child’s development.

The app uses cartoon characters to keep a hold of the kid’s attention span. These characters interact with the children based on their responses to the games. It’s almost as if the characters were holding the children’s hands and walking them through different games.

Age: 0-5 years | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

2. Angry Birds 2: Best turn-based strategy game

The Angry Birds franchise has been a huge hit ever since it was released in 2009. Since then, it has been updated keeping in mind the rapid change in the available technology. There’s even an Augmented Reality version of this game now!

Regardless, you’ll find that it’s a puzzle game at its core. In fact, this game improves logical thinking as well as hand-eye coordination. Hence, I’d highly recommend this game for kids aged 4 and above.

The graphics and audio of this game will keep the kids’ attention for a long period of time. Moreover, the levels keep increasing the difficulty, thereby adding a layer of challenge to the gameplay.

However, this game can be addictive. Parents should watch the amount of exposure that their children get to it.

Age: 4+ | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

3. LEGO DUPLO WORLD: Good alternative for preschoolers

LEGO continues to be a popular franchise amongst children and adults alike. Even a couple of decades ago, LEGO building blocks were used as a creative tool to foster imaginative abilities in kids. Since children are now exposed to mobile phones at an early age, LEGO DUPLO WORLD is a good choice for preschool kids to learn.

The game is open-ended in its experience and uses different strategies such as Number Train and Family Camping to teach kids various skills. You’ll find logical reasoning exercises and activities that allow your child’s creative tendencies to shine through.

LEGO DUPLO WORLD is a worthy download. Fair warning, though – the in-app purchases can be a bit expensive.

Age: 0-5 | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download

4. Fruit Ninja: Best for improving motor skills

Fruit Ninja has been one of the most popular games for mobile phones ever since modern smartphones became pervasive. To this date, I still enjoy slashing and cutting random fruits on my screen.

It’s also a game that can greatly improve hand-eye coordination, as your reflexes have to be fast to achieve a high score. If you have a kid that’s 4 years or older, Fruit Ninja will keep them entertained.

There’s also a small strategy element to the game as the player has to slice certain fruits, which give them boosts. Your kids will remain attentive as there are innumerable in-game blades to collect and different modes to provide them with specific challenges.

What I didn’t like about its latest version is its in-game currencies. They’re important to continue progress in the game but can mostly be bought only with real-world money.

Age: 4+ | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

5. Pokemon GO: Best for physical activity

It’s easy for kids these days to become lazy under the influence of the plethora of technologies at their fingertips. If you want your child to be active from an early age, Pokemon GO is a fair option.

This game has been a sensation and is still one of the best iPhone games. As an AR game, Pokemon GO requires you and your child to take walks outside to catch Pokemon in the wild.

Since the game uses augmented reality, your child will be giving their full attention as they see a 3D Pokemon on the phone screen. The gameplay is simple but will require them to walk around and become active.

It also inculcates logical thinking in your child, as they will need to use strategies to catch the Pokemon. Overall, Pokemon GO is a good package for children aged 9 years and above.

The app needs a few patches to fix some glaring issues you’ll come across. However, it won’t hamper your child’s experience.

Age: 9+ | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

6. What Would You Choose? Rather: Best party game

Have you ever faced trouble getting your kids to join for a night of family games? Or have you found it difficult for different kids to gel together and make friends? What Would You Choose? Rather would be a perfect conversation starter for them.

This is a party game with good and safe content for kids. Moreover, it makes for a perfect game filled with fun for the whole family.

The premise of the game is simple. Different prompts will set up two unlikely scenarios, and the player has to choose one of the options given to them. These scenarios are often hilarious and can break the ice and start interesting conversations.

I’d recommend this game for kids aged above 10 years old. However, you’ll have to remember that the prompts are often repeated, and the game can get repetitive after you’ve played it multiple times.

Age: 12+ | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

7. Sago Mini First Words

Speech development is one of the most important facets of a growing child. With the Sago Mini First Words app, it gets much easier to handle your child’s growth in terms of dialogues and articulation.

The app provides multiple fun games to aid your child’s speech therapy. These games are based on proven methods and have been designed by speech pathologists to ensure your child gets the care they deserve!

Each game has been personalized to help children under the age of 5. Moreover, the app uses interactive videos to teach your toddler the perfect ways to use their first words. There are hundreds of videos based on your child’s development, and monthly updates ensure that none of the games or methods are outdated.

Age: 0-5 years | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

8. Crossy Road: Best arcade game for kids

This game tries to answer the age-old question, “Why did the chicken cross the road?” While you may not find the answer here, what you do find is a great arcade game for kids.

The game requires timing and strategy as the chicken has to get to the other side by avoiding multiple obstacles. Crossy Road is an endless game and continues to get more challenging as the game goes on.

This is a great game for kids aged 9 and above. Not only will it improve their logical skills, but it will also aid their motor reflexes.

Nonetheless, it suffers from one of the most common problems of these “endless runner” games. It can get boring after playing it for a substantial amount of time.

Age: 9+ | Price: Free (in-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

9. Puzzingo: Best puzzle game for kids

Puzzingo has many puzzles to help your child’s creative output and keep them entertained. The game has over 100 puzzles brought to life with lively animations and interactivity. These puzzles are made to help your child learn and aid their memory, spatial recognition, and fine motor skills.

Your child will have a gala time as they try to put shapes, letters, and numbers in order. This amount of interactivity also helps their cognitive skills to develop. Moreover, the game is updated frequently, so your children will have new things to try.

However, you will have to pay a premium to access all the puzzles.

Age: 0-5 | Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

That’s it!

It can be difficult to find the best games for kids in the App Store due to the large content available. Nonetheless, I’ve tried to curate the best iPhone games for kids based on different requirements.

Have I missed out on a game that your kid loves? Post your thoughts in the comments below.

  • Best party games for iPhone and iPad

  • Logitech G Astro A10 Wired Gaming Headset
  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

title.rendered: Best Chess Apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Chess is an ancient strategy game that has evolved over the years and gained tremendous popularity online. Therefore, it has attracted many people to practice and develop their skills on the go via mobile applications. While many apps are available, it can be challenging to find one that strikes the right balance of features and experience. Fortunately, we’re here to help you out, like a knight in shining armor (pun intended).

Table of Contents
  • 1. Chess Play and Learn
  • 2. Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf
  • 3. Chess Universe Play and Learn
  • 4. Real Chess 3D
  • 5. Chess
    • Checkmate!

1. Chess Play and Learn

Let’s start with the app that stands out as the top chess game on iPhone and iPad. It boasts a clean and intuitive user interface along with a range of options for chess lovers of skill level. When you open the chess app, there are seven options available, namely:

  • Play Computer
  • Play Online
  • Puzzles
  • Vision Trainer
  • Video
  • Daily Puzzle
  • Articles

Once you get into any one of these sections, there is an extended menu with more options. For instance, you can access forums to discuss everything about Chess, from game analysis to tips for beginners and beyond. It’s a great space to deepen your knowledge and sharpen your skills.

Whether you play against the computer or online, there is a play-by-play review of your games, which critiques your moves and tells you what you could have done better. This helps you gain an understanding of technique and strategy.

I particularly found the solo Chess mode interesting. It gives you a series of tasks to capture a piece with every move until one remains on the board. It starts with just two pieces on the board and then gets steadily tricky until ten pieces are on the board. This both challenges and trains your mind to come up with winning strategies.

Further, you can even customize the theme to match your color and style preferences. Plus, there are tons of articles and news to keep you updated with what’s happening in the world of Chess.

However, do note that you need to create an account to use this app’s full functionality, such as the Puzzles feature, which gives you over 65,000 Chess-board problems to have a crack at. Overall, it’s an incredibly detail-oriented app that will offer a rewarding Chess experience for newbies and pros alike. It’s also available on Apple Watch.

Price: Free (Gold Membership starts at $4.99)

Download

2. Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf

Here’s an app for anyone who wants to learn the game of Chess from scratch or improve their game to the next level. It’s got an interactive chatbot-style interface that makes you feel like you’re taking private coaching lessons. The first three coaching sessions are free, after which you can opt to subscribe.

With each move you make, Dr. Wolf explains what he is doing, and it’s designed to make you improve your game. There are also twenty-five in-depth lessons that explain various chess concepts and offer ample opportunities for guided practice.

What I especially loved is how Dr. Wolf sounds friendly, inspiring, gentle, and sometimes witty too! It creates an engaging gameplay experience that keeps you returning for more. He gradually introduces new concepts, and you earn points when you use a new skill in-game.

Further, you can even opt for specific lessons on various aspects of Chess such as what to do in the opening, how to attack with different power pieces, how to defend hanging pieces, etc.

It also keeps track of your stats and achievements to gain insights into how you’re progressing over time. It’s one of the best chess apps to advance your skills and learn the nitty-gritty of the game.

Price: Free (Monthly Coaching starts at $4.99)

Download

3. Chess Universe Play and Learn

The cute and colorful theme of this iOS chess game makes it stand apart from the rest. You can play free online games with live players, undertake chess quests, unlock cute characters, emojis, chess boards, and sets.

Challenge yourself against seven AI levels, solve puzzles, and learn about the winning moves from some legendary players like Bobby Fischer & Garry Kasparov. There’s also an in-game chat feature to connect with opponents and add a fun element to the gameplay.

For practice, you can choose to play versus the AI or play versus a friend. And when you’re ready, you can go for the more challenging games with timers of 30 seconds, 1 minute, 3 minutes, 5 minutes, 10, or 15 minutes per move.

Besides, there’s a match history section that enables you to revisit any online match you just played. And you can know about your past mistakes with the easy to use analysis feature.

One of the coolest aspects of the interface is that you can have fun customizing your look with unique avatars. However, one drawback is the frequency of the ads that appear in this app. But rewards and bonus points still make it tolerable and worth checking out!

Price: Free (In-app purchases)

Download

4. Real Chess 3D

This one’s in horizontal mode. On the opening screen, you have the option to begin a new game or to customize the look of it according to your preferences. You can choose from a few different options for the board, the pieces, the borders, and the table.

You can play against the computer or another player on the same device. In the two-player mode, the perspective changes after each move so that you and your partner can play your moves. Further, it saves your progress so you can continue a game from where you left it.

Its distinguishing feature is the 3D view, which is hard to come by in other apps. You can use your fingers to move and rotate the board for custom views. This gives it a more realistic feel and is especially suited to play on a larger screen like an iPad.

The best part is the soothing music, which promotes concentration and compliments the polished user interface.

Price: Free ($3.99 to remove ads)

Download

5. Chess

If you’re looking for a no-frills straightforward chess app, here’s an excellent option for you. It’s got a pleasing brown wood-like color scheme and intuitive options. When you open this app, you’ll have the option to choose between one player or two-player modes, then select a difficulty level, and get started.

The game has a real feel and sound to it. So, you can feel each piece as you move it, almost like it has a marble feel with a felt bottom. It’s straightforward to play and convenient on a mobile device. There’s also an option to undo moves.

Although it’s pretty basic and simplistic, it gets the job done. It automatically saves your progress so you can get back to a game where you left it. The graphics and sound effects are on-point, and you have the option to configure player names and track scores.

There are not many features to try out, but if your goal is to play Chess, this is perfect. However, there is no way to change the default brown and beige color scheme, and at times, ads detract from the experience. But do bear in mind that it’s completely free to use, which makes it worth it.

Price: Free

Download

Checkmate!

So, there you have it, our roundup of the top five chess apps for your iPhone and iPad. Just like the Queen, you have plenty of choices about which way to go. Your move!

Don’t forget to share your thoughts with us in the comments below. You might also like to read about the best puzzle games for your iPhone.

content.rendered:
If you’re an astronomy enthusiast or someone who loves to enjoy the beauty of the world above us at night, then these night sky iPhone wallpapers are for you. Here, we bring you some of the most stunning images of the night sky, displayed beautifully on your small and brilliant iPhone.

1. Lone person night sky iPhone wallpaper

This wallpaper for iPhone is a stunning 4k image that captures the beauty and solitude of the night sky. You can see a lone figure standing on a hill, with the blend of beauty and mystery of the night sky. Like this? Then it’s yours to download.

Download

2. Mountain night sky wallpaper

In this wallpaper, you are gifted with a breathtaking view of a starry night sky as seen from a mountain valley. The mountains with the sky create a stunning contrast against the vibrant colors of the cosmos. Want to keep this view forever with you? The download button is below.

Download

3. Ocean night sky iPhone wallpaper

The wallpaper showcases a mountain range reflected onto a water body next to it, expected to be an ocean. This wallpaper showcases the peacefulness of the ocean with the majesty of the mountain ranges touching the stars above.

Download

4. Man under the stars night sky wallpaper

The silhouette of the man against the bright stars creates a sense of wonder and solitude, inviting the viewer to view and wonder how small beings we are in this vast universe. The wallpaper is suitable for any iPhone 14 model and can easily be made yours by clicking that download button.

Download

5. Ocean near a mountain range night sky wallpaper

You can see a stunning image that combines the beauty of the ocean, surrounded by the majesty of a mountain range, and the wonder of the night sky.

Download

6. Stars night sky wallpaper

Trees result from nature’s incredible beauty, and stars reflect the beauty of the amazing universe around us. So seeing them together feels like you are watching the most beautiful combinations in the universe.

Download

7. Cabin under a night sky wallpaper

In this wallpaper, you could see a cozy and rustic image of a cabin standing tall on the edge of the mountain surrounded by a starry night sky. You can enjoy the peacefulness and serenity of the great outdoors and the magic of the night sky.

Download

8. Long road under night sky wallpaper

Life is always considered a long, winding road disappearing into the distance but with many surprises on the way. When it’s surrounded by a mysterious night sky filled with stars, you are in for an adventure.

Download

9. Man under beautiful night sky wallpaper

The wallpaper captures the awe and wonder that the stars can inspire, and the silhouette of the man against the bright stars shows the beauty solitude can sometimes bring to your life.

Download

10. Ship under blue night sky iPhone wallpaper

This iPhone wallpaper features a stunning image of a ship still under a beautiful cover called the night sky.

Download

The beautiful night sky on your iPhone!

I always enjoy the beauty of the night sky, the stars, the constellations, and sometimes a shooting star. While the night mode of our planet is a mysterious place, it still makes me want to explore and enjoy its beauty. So what’s your favorite wallpaper from our collection of best night sky wallpapers for iPhone? Let me know in the comments.

title.rendered: Best iPhone SE Waterproof Cases for Everyday Adventures

content.rendered:
The iPhone SE, an electronic marvel, needs protection against sweat and water. Now dry and cloudy, it remains a constant threat for people to go out with umbrellas and rainwear. While you care much about yourself, you should be equally worried about your iPhone SE’s health. Waterproof iPhone SE cases are essential, especially in the United States, where climate changes occur any time. This list of the best iPhone SE waterproof cases is for you; each comprises superior quality materials to prevent water or sweat from damaging your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spidercase
  • 2. AceTeah
  • 3. Effun
  • 4. LifeProof
  • 5. CarterLily
  • 6. HESGI

1. Spidercase

Can you expect a waterproof case to be compatible with iPhone touch ID biometric scanner? Spidercase has done this efficiently in its full-body protective cover for iPhone SE. The waterproof case from Spidercase is fully compatible with your iPhone’s Touch ID sensor.

You can submerge your iPhone SE sixteen feet underwater, thanks to Spidercase’s tested IP68 certified waterproof case, which can also endure accidental drops from the height of two meters. Normally, waterproof cases are not expected to be beautiful, but Spidercase has shattered this myth and crafted a slim and sleek case.

USP: 100% compatible with Touch ID
Check out on Amazon

2. AceTeah

Keep your iPhone SE as dry as a bone with AceTeah waterproof case, which has a dual swivel lock and sealable closure clip design. If you frequently take part in outdoor activities, this case is a must-buy for you as it protects your iPhone SE along with your ID, credit cards, cash, etc.

The case is made of environmental nontoxic food-grade polyvinyl chloride and sturdy ABS material. AceTeah has got IPX8 certification; it can easily resist heat, cold, and pressure. It can protect your iPhone SE 15 meters underwater.

USP: Waterproof 100 feet underwater
Check out on Amazon

3. Effun

If you love adventures and want to explore new terrains on the world, you can rely on Effun’s waterproof case to protect your iPhone SE. While you are all set to take a plunge into hot springs, you should not be worried about splashes that could damage your device.

The Effun has crafted this case with the precise cutout so that you can use all buttons and controls like Touch ID, cameras, speakers, power button, mute key, charge ports, and volume buttons on your SE.

USP: Precise cutouts
Check out on Amazon

4. LifeProof

LifeProof is one of the premium brands that manufacture high-end accessories for your precious iPhone SE. One of the most important features of this case is a built-in screen guard, which is nearly invisible to your eyes and touches.

This case is not only waterproof but also snowproof and shockproof. You can dive into the water and play aquatic games for one hour; however, you cannot go below two meters underwater.

USP: Invisible screen protector
Check out on Amazon

5. CarterLily

CarterLily iPhone SE waterproof case is robustly built with an aluminum metal frame that protects your phone against harms and damage. Check out its rubber button that plays a dual role in protecting your phone and supporting fingerprint function.

You can uncover the rubber button when you have to use the fingerprint scanner. The gorilla glass screen guard protects your phone’s touchscreen from high impacts and shocks. The waterproof case protects your phone from rainwater and daily life water.

USP: Aluminum metal frame
Check out on Amazon

6. HESGI

HESGI has good protection and waterproof effect. The screen protection film is made of PET material, which can resist water and snow weather or any other similar environment.

The waterproof case boasts the IP68 standard, which allows you to submerge your iPhone SE 6.6 feet underwater. Enjoy complete access to all the key functions like volume, charging, headphone jack, home button, mute, power, etc. Capture high-quality photos and videos with its front and back lenses.

USP: PET screen protector
Check out on Amazon

That’s all!

Signing off

Waterproof cases are the need of the hour, especially when you live in a country with an unpredictable climate. For comprehensive protection, you can rely only on waterproof cases for your iPhone SE.

So, which case have you chosen to protect your iPhone SE against water damage? Do share your choice with us in a comment.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

Our favorite Amazon finds:

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

title.rendered: Best screen protectors for 16-inch MacBook Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
The 16-inch MacBook Pros with M2 and M2 Max chips are the costliest laptops ever produced by Apple, and it certainly needs to be taken care of in every possible way. You shouldn’t mind spending a few bucks to get a sturdy screen protector that guards the precious display on the go!

Well, picking the best MacBook Pro 16-inch screen protector isn’t as easy as picking a protector for your iPhone. In fact, it’s a tricky part. So, we have made things easier for you and listed out the best screen protectors for the 16-inch MacBook Pro!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Filmext
  • 2. SightPro
  • 3. imComor
  • 4. Forito
  • 5. Moshi
  • 6. Spigen
  • 7. Habyby
  • 8. MasiBloom
  • 9. Zshion
  • 10. Supershieldz
  • 11. Tuxlke

1. Filmext

Tagged as Amazon’s Choice for “MacBook Pro 16-inch screen protector”, Filmext is the most loved screen guard by MacBook Pro users. Apart from screen protection, this privacy screen filter ensures that it doesn’t leak the information on your Mac’s screen to those who are sitting next to you. Even if you’re just 30-degree away from the Mac, you will hardly see anything on the screen because of the privacy screen filter.

The screen protector doesn’t affect the normal usage of your MacBook Pro; however, it protects your eyes from blue light emitted from the laptop. Its border is sealed with silicone material giving you a chance to put on or remove it easily when not needed. Besides screen protectors, you also get an ultra-thin keyboard film as well.

This product is costly as compared to other ones, but believe me, it’s the only protector that comes with a perfect privacy screen filter, and you won’t regret it once you get it for your MacBook Pro 16-inch variant. So what keeps you waiting? Go for it now!

Pros

  • High clarity
  • Designed to protect sensitive information
  • Completely bubble-free

Cons

  • The screen guard is a bit thicker  

Check out on Amazon

2. SightPro

If a magnetic privacy screen protector is what you are looking for, this offering from SightPro could be the right answer to your needs. Thanks to the magnetic attachment, you can install the screen guard without any pain. Besides, it also doesn’t leave behind the unwanted adhesives when removed.

Featuring precise cutouts, the screen defender fits accurately on the 16-inch screen. Being anti-blue light, it also protects your eyes from straining or harmful glare. Moreover, SightPro limits viewing angles so that your sensitive information has the needed protection.

Pros

  • Magnetic attachment
  • Protects your eyes from harmful glare
  • Shields the screen against scratches

Cons

  • Clarity could be better

Check out on Amazon

3. imComor

Taking care of your eyes is of the utmost importance when you are working on your MacBook Pro for longer hours. And that’s only possible when you get a screen protector that comes with an anti-blue light filter, anti-glare feature and UV protection. This is precisely what all you get when you buy imComor screen protector for the MacBook Pro 16-inch variant.

With 9H hardness, the protector guards the screen against sudden drops and scrapes. Moreover, it protects your MacBook Pro’s screen from scratches, dust, fingerprints, and residue as well. It’s easy to install and it leaves no air bubbles behind if installed with care and precision. And yes, the best part you get a TPU Keyboard cover for your MacBook Pro as a gift along with the screen protector.

Pros

  • HD clarity
  • 9H hardness
  • Anti-blue light

Cons

  • Feels a little flimsy

Check out on Amazon

4. Forito

With over 100+ positive ratings on Amazon, Forito is one of the most loved screen protectors available for MacBook Pro on Amazon. It’s designed with Anti-Glare Matte technology giving you a picture-perfect display irrespective of the surroundings you are working. With crystal clear HD glass, it doesn’t affect the natural viewing experience.

The protector is coated with oleophobic layer and hydrophobic layers, which guards your MacBook Pro against sweat, oil residue, sweat and fingerprints as well. And things can’t go better when you get two screen protectors at just $12.99 only.

Pros

  • Anti-glare matte surface
  • Hydrophobic and oleophobic
  • Highly affordable

Cons

  • Delivers only 5H hardness

Check out on Amazon

5. Moshi

Here’sHere’s a screen protector that keeps scratches and fingerprints at bay while also protecting your eyes against the screen’s glare. It features a multi-layer construction that boasts incredible clarity and reduces eye strain. So you can work for long hours with less fatigue.

Further, it’s super easy to install without any bubbles. It perfectly aligns with the 16-inch MacBook Pro. I love that it can be washed and reapplied repeatedly, which reduces waste and makes it eco-friendly. You also get a 10-year global warranty. That’sThat’s pretty cost-saving and convenient! Chose from clear or matte finishes according to your preference.

Pros

  • Thin and lightweight
  • Easy to clean
  • Reduces glare and eye strain
  • Global 10-year warranty

Cons

  • Reduces the image quality on screen so may not be suitable for everyone

Check out on Amazon

6. Spigen

Spigen is a leading Apple accessories maker, and this screen protector is a worthy investment for your precious MacBook Pro. It’s made of premium tempered glass with 9H hardness and offers full-screen coverage for ultimate protection from impact and scratches.

Further, the extreme clarity preserves the original brightness and sharpness of your display without leaving any residue. It’s also easy and convenient to install without any bubbles.

Pros

  • Retains original brightness of the screen
  • 9H hardness
  • Full-screen coverage

Cons

  • Installation instructions could be easier.

Check out on Amazon

7. Habyby

If cost was never your concern and you wanted a quality product, Habyby must be your first choice as a screen protector for your 16-inch MacBook Pro. It’s the highest in terms of standards and the anti-reflective film layer gives transmittance up to 75%, which is usually just 60% in other protectors.

Moreover, the protector limits the viewing angle to 30-degrees so that your data is always safe when someone is around you and you don’t want to peep into your screen. It blocks almost 30% of the blue light emitted by your MacBook Pro and keeps your eyes safe. Besides this, the anti-scratch and anti-fingerprint features ensure that scratches and fingerprints are always feet away from the screen.

Pros

  • Anti-reflective
  • Bubble-free installation
  • Restricts viewing angles to safeguard your privacy

Cons

  • Price seems a touch over the top

Check out on Amazon

8. MasiBloom

If you’re looking for a cheap 16-inch MacBook Pro screen guard, MasiBloom must be your way to go as it costs just $7.99. And you get two protectors at this price, well, that’s an unbeatable deal, isn’t it?!

Not sure about this as I don’t see any reviews on Amazon, but when it’s cheap, you can always expect the quality to be compromised. But that’s not the case with this protector as it comes with 4H hardness and made of high-quality PET materials.

Moreover, it guards your MacBook Pro against the dust, dirt, fingerprints, water, scratches, and other stains, if any. It’s easy to install and clean with the help of cleaning tools included in the kit.

Pros

  • High-quality PET material
  • Ultra-thin
  • Cheap yet pretty good

Cons

  • Lacks the hardness to fight out nasty scratches

Check out on Amazon

9. Zshion

Here’s yet another screen protector, which is made of PET film material and not tempered glass. So the hardness would be 4H instead of 9H, which is usually seen in tempered glass. Due to the material used in this product, it makes the protector ultra-clear and leaves no bubbles during the installation if done with care.

This protector doesn’t affect the smoothness of your MacBook Pro screen and it’s transparent as well. Features like anti-scratch and anti-fingerprint keep all the dust, dirt, fingerprints away from the display.

Pros

  • Crystal clear design
  • PET film resists fingerprints
  • Fights out blue light

Cons

  • Can’t safeguard the touchscreen against sharp scratches

Check out on Amazon

10. Supershieldz

Made of top-grade Japanese PET film, Supershieldz delivers high-definition clarity. So, you can expect the 16″ Retina display to continue to offer original clarity. Being a matte film, the screen guard also reduces glare so that you can get a much-improved viewing experience.

As for protecting the screen from scratches, Supershieldz is capable of thwarting minor scratches. Besides, the PET film is also up to the task when it comes to putting sweat and fingerprints away. With these features, the $9.99 price tag for three packs makes it one of the cheapest screen protectors for MacBook Pro 16-inch.

Pros

  • Top-quality Japanese PET film
  • Designed to reduce glare and fingerprints
  • Dust resistant

Cons

  • Doesn’t offer maximum safeguards against scuffs

Check out on Amazon

11. Tuxlke

Yet another top-of-the-line screen guards for MacBook Pro 16-inch that has caught my eyes. And guess what, I have found it fully equipped to offer the needed care to the Retina display while also ensuring you get the high-definition transparency. At 0.26mm thickness, it may be one of thinnest screen defenders but it can resist scuffs with ease.

With the ability to filter out 99% UV light and preventing up to 30% blue light, it also safeguards your eyes. Therefore, even after hours of non-stop work or long video-streaming, your eyes won’t burn. Furthermore, the screen protector features a detachable silicone seal on the rear side which makes it easy to remove and Clean.

Pros

  • 0.26mm thick
  • Detachable silicone seal
  • Excels in resisting UV light

Cons

  • Relatively less protective

Check out on Amazon

That’s all, folks!

Signing Off…

Which one of these Screen Protectors for 16-inch MacBook Pro is going to pair with your mac? I would be happy to know the name of your favorite protector. Do let us know your views if we missed any important screen guard, we will be glad to add them to our round-up list.

Recommended Accessories for your MacBook Pro You Might Love!

  • Best Sleeves for 16-inch MacBook Pro
  • Best Cases for 16-inch MacBook Pro
  • Best MacBook Pro/Air Stands
  • Best keyboard covers for 16-inch MacBook Pro

Our favorite Mac accessories:

  • Macally Multi-Device Bluetooth Keyboard
  • Belkin Connect 5-in-1 Thunderbolt 4 Dock
  • Anker 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
  • UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN Charger
  • Adjustable Laptop Stand with 360° Rotating Base

"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.
