mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

title.rendered: Best gaming accessories for your iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
With the rise of mobile gaming, gaming accessories for your mobile phone have also become important buys. There are various accessories available for you to buy in different categories. I understand that this can get confusing, and I have curated a list of the best gaming accessories for iPhone.

The accessories are the best bang for their buck in their respective categories. Let’s dive in.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Razer Kishi – Best controller for iPhone
  • 2. Nintendo Switch Joy-Con
  • 3. BENGOO G9000 Headset – Best budget gaming headset for iPhone
  • 4. Merge VR/AR Headset – Best VR headset for iPhone
  • 5. Serafim Steering Wheel – Best for racing games on iPhone
  • 6. Dizaul 3D Screen Magnifier – Best iPhone screen amplifier
  • 7. Altec Lansing BattelGrip Mobile Controller – Best for shooting games
  • 8. Altec Lansing Charging Pad – Best charging pad for iPhones
  • 9. Vakili Touch Screen Joypad – Best on-screen joypad for iPhones
  • 10. MGC Clawsocks – Best finger sleeves for iPhone gaming
  • 11. IFYOO Z108 Mobile Controller – Best budget alternative for shooting games
  • 12. LucBuy Mobile phone case – Best phone case for retro games

1. Razer Kishi – Best controller for iPhone

If you’re on the lookout for a great gamepad or controller for your iPhone, Razer Kishi is the one!

The design of this controller is future-proof. The two sides are attached to the back panels and are slideable. This means that even if your new iPhone is bigger, you can still use this controller for gaming. Moreover, the gamepad design is inspired by Nintendo Switch’s Joy-Con.

The stylizations are similar to the new Xbox controller, and you’ll find absolutely no issues adjusting the controller for new games. There’s support for Xbox Game Pass as well.

Moreover, the controller is light enough not to add too much weight to the phone. Despite the lightweight, the controller’s build is sturdy enough not to feel flimsy or breakable. Also, it’s easy to carry around!

With all these features, it’s pretty easy to guess that this controller is expensive. This is the only con I could find with the product. However, if you pay the big bucks, you’ll be getting your money’s worth.

Check out on Amazon

2. Nintendo Switch Joy-Con

The Nintendo Joy-Cons are dual controllers that are packed together with the Nintendo Switch console. Thanks to the Nintendo Switch’s hybrid system, you can either dock the Nintendo Switch for use on a bigger screen, or use its portability factor for fun gaming on the go.

However, quite a few gamers are unaware that with the latest iOS 16 update for iPhones, the Nintendo Joy-Cons can also be paired with your iPhone for gaming. Considering the fact that the mobile gaming scene is getting more advanced with online games such as Call of Duty: Mobile and the Asphalt series, the touch controls for iPhone gaming aren’t the most conducive to a better gaming experience.

These touch controls often become an impediment to the graphical fidelity and screen space that’s required with the latest games. Moreover, they’re not the best when it comes to providing you with a level of control. By pairing one or both controllers to your iPhone, the device will recognize the Joy-Cons as a single controller and allow you to play your games without the impediment of the touch controls.

So, if you’ve got a Nintendo Switch lying around the house and want to elevate your mobile gaming experience, pair the Nintendo Joy-Cons with your iPhone today!

Check out on Amazon

3. BENGOO G9000 Headset – Best budget gaming headset for iPhone

If you seriously want to get into mobile gaming or want the ultimate experience, you’ll need to invest in a good headset. Thankfully, the BENGOO G9000 Headset has you covered.

The first thing that catches your eye about the headset is its design. The headset looks ergonomic, sleek and is made for tech-savvy gamers. The futuristic looks of the headset, including the lighting, enhance the immersion.

The noise isolation, bass, and ambient noise enhancement capabilities of the headset make this a perfect companion for shooter games like Call of Duty Mobile and PUBG Mobile. You’ll be able to hear bullets whizz past you and the footsteps of enemies near you.

For more advantages on the battlefield, the noise-isolating microphones will allow you to receive and deliver messages with crystal clarity. Simply said, this headset is almost a cheat code in gaming.

The only caveat is that it’s made for beginners or intermediate gamers. If you’re an enthusiast, you’re better off spending a few more dollars.

Check out on Amazon

4. Merge VR/AR Headset – Best VR headset for iPhone

VR Experiences are still popular, with multiple new games for both consoles and mobiles being released recently. Whether you play the latest fighting games or spend time with your loved ones through family games, Merge VR Headset has you covered.

First off, the design of the headset is user-friendly. It’s built of foam, resistant to wear and tear. It’s also lightweight, ensuring your kids can experience their favorite AR games easily.

Secondly, there’s a neat slot for phones, and it’s future-proof as newer iPhones will also fit into this. Two buttons on the sides of the headset control both the lens-eye distance and the interactive experience of games.

Best of all, you can access all the iPhone-compatible apps through the Merge Miniverse, the company’s portal for gaming. From education games to the latest mobile games, there’s access to plenty of content.

A caveat of this headset is that it may not be compatible with different kinds of spectacle frames. I’d recommend you to try it before you buy it.

Check out on Amazon

5. Serafim Steering Wheel – Best for racing games on iPhone

Racing games on iPhone are aplenty, and some of them provide a proper racing simulation experience. The Serafim Steering Wheel is precisely for these games.

This steering wheel brings everything – from the pedals to a phone holder on the steering wheel. While it also works with major console games, it’s also been specifically designed with mobile games in mind.

The steering wheel comes with a one-year warranty. Moreover, its build quality is something to brag about. Don’t worry about stepping on the pedals too hard. The entire ensemble is made to be pushed to the limits.

The double vibration motors do a great job of making you feel the power of the in-game car’s engines. The X-input and D-input are standardized as well. Overall, this is a steering wheel covering all bases.

However, this steering wheel is good only for entry-level players. Pro-players might not find this to their liking.

Check out on Amazon

6. Dizaul 3D Screen Magnifier – Best iPhone screen amplifier

Screen magnifiers are important for those who want more control in their mobile gaming experience.

Sometimes, the smaller screens of phones don’t do a good job of showing the game in all its glory. Moreover, playing mobile games for too long can be detrimental to your eyesight.

The 3D screen magnifier is a good choice for those who want to put less stress on their eyes while enjoying the mobile game as if they were playing a console game.

The screen itself is foldable, which makes it highly portable. It’s got a curved shape that works well for panoramic fields of view. The build quality is above average and can sustain a substantial amount of wear and tear.

Unfortunately, the screen magnifier is suitable only for one to two people. Don’t expect to watch a movie with your family through this screen.

Check out on Amazon

7. Altec Lansing BattelGrip Mobile Controller – Best for shooting games

Good controllers meant specifically for certain game genres can be difficult to find. If you’re into shooting games, the BattleGrip Mobile Controller should be a must-buy for you.

The controller features two triggers on either side for easier control. Triggers can be customized for specific actions, and the placement makes it easier for actions such as shooting and reloading.

There’s also a silent cooling fan attached to the controller. Shooting games can be heavy on the phone and lead to heating issues. The cooling fan ensures that the temperatures remain favorable for extended gaming hours.

I wish they bettered the build quality, however. The material, while durable for small knicks and bumps, may be unable to stand bigger falls.

Check out on Best Buy

8. Altec Lansing Charging Pad – Best charging pad for iPhones

This is another product by Altec Lansing that can enhance your gaming experience.

We know that gaming can be a heavy task for phones. With the latest games having superior graphics and intense gameplay, the phone may run out of charge quickly.

This is why a wireless charging pad can be a useful tool. The Altec Lansing Charging Pad doesn’t take up too much space. Moreover, it’s small enough for you to miss it when holding the phone.

This ensures that your gaming isn’t interrupted. The suction cup grip allows the pad to stick to the back of the phone, and the material doesn’t interfere with charging even if you use a phone case. More importantly, it has a 10W charging capacity. While this doesn’t sound like much, the charging is fast and efficient.

The charging pad also features a ring stand that can keep the phone at certain angles. However, the ring stand seems flimsy, so I’d recommend caution when using it.

Check out on Best Buy

9. Vakili Touch Screen Joypad – Best on-screen joypad for iPhones

Gaming controllers can be a hassle when you prefer something much smaller. On-screen controllers can be your go-to accessory for gaming if this is the case for you.

The Vakili Touch Screen Joypad is perfect for those who don’t want to spend too much on a controller. The small form factor allows you to attach the controller to the screen, especially in those areas where the on-screen controls are present.

There’s no additional pattern to increase the size of the joypad, and it can stick to the surface of the screen without causing any damage.

It’s especially useful for racing and shooting games as you have to control the direction.

Unfortunately, you cannot add any more functionality to this controller. You cannot sprint with this controller in games where the sprint function is present.

Check out on Amazon

10. MGC Clawsocks – Best finger sleeves for iPhone gaming

When you play competitive online games, especially the likes of Call of Duty Mobile, you’ll notice that there is a lag when you drag the camera from one extreme angle to another.

Often, this drag can cost your gaming experience. This is why the MGC Clawsocks are an important buy for you. Not only do they protect your fingers, but also reduce this lag to an almost frictionless situation.

It’s also thin enough to have sensitivity in your fingers and does not interfere with the mobile screen’s sensitivity. Even if your fingers have dirt or oil, these finger sleeves will ensure that you have smooth gameplay with uninterrupted touch sensitivity.

My only issue with the sleeves is that the strings may unravel after extended usage. While this doesn’t impact the gameplay much, it can be annoying.

Check out on Amazon

11. IFYOO Z108 Mobile Controller – Best budget alternative for shooting games

If you want to improve your experience at shooting games and have budget restrictions, the IFYOO Z108 controller is a good alternative.

The controller uses a clip-on system that protects your screen from scratches. It’s also compatible with a variety of screen protectors and phone cases.

Apart from the fact that the controller uses the lowest amount of your screen space, it also helps you avoid accidental button presses on the side of your phone. Moreover, the buttons are customizable.

The low latency feedback allows you to exercise quicker reactions when you’re in the middle of an intense gunfight.

My only issue with the controller is that it isn’t durable. The ABS plastic material may not withstand high wear and tear.

Check out on Amazon

12. LucBuy Mobile phone case – Best phone case for retro games

Retro games can transport us into the past, into an era of vintage gaming. If you want the truest feel of playing these games, you have to try the retro phone case by LucBuy.

The phone case is designed to represent the classic GameBoy cases. There’s plenty to choose from, depending on the device you use.

There are 36 categories of retro games to choose from. Whether you prefer Mario or Sonic the Hedgehog, there’s content for everyone to try. All these games can be played at the back of your phone, as the case comes with a colored screen and the usual GameBoy button design.

The case itself is stated to be dustproof, shockproof, and scratch-resistant. It also comes in a variety of eye-catching colors.

You can also power the case by connecting it to your phone. The case will draw the battery from your phone. This guarantees extended gaming times. If you’re a connoisseur of older video games, this phone case is a must-buy.

A con of this phone case would be that it adds a fair bulk to the phone. So, if you don’t like a phone case that weighs too much, you might have to sacrifice the retro gaming.

Check out on Amazon

Summing up!

Mobile gaming is now considered a serious e-sporting phenomenon. If you’re an aspiring or budding mobile gamer, I hope you’ve liked this list of the best gaming accessories for the iPhone.

Since we’re on the topic, where do you think mobile gaming is headed? Are there going to be new games or genres apart from the usual shooting games and MMORPGs? Let me know what you think in the comments!

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

title.rendered: Best wireless mouse for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
A wireless mouse adds a new level of comfort to using your Mac. It makes it easier to scroll and click your way through things without tiring out your fingers on the trackpad. It’s a great companion to have with your wireless keyboard for an ergonomic work setup. There is a range of options to consider, and your choice should depend on your needs. Take your pick from these best wireless mouse for Mac.

Table of Contents
  • Top 6 wireless mouse for Mac
    • 1. Apple Magic Mouse 2
    • 2. Logitech MX Anywhere 2S – Hyper-Fast Scrolling
    • 3. SteelSeries Rival 650 Mouse – Best for Gamers
    • 4. Logitech MX Vertical – For Wrist Pain
    • 5. Logitech MX Master – Best Power Management
    • 6. TENMOS Wireless Mouse – Most Versatile

Top 6 wireless mouse for Mac

1. Apple Magic Mouse 2

You can’t go wrong with an Apple accessory for your Mac, and the Magic Mouse 2 has many tricks to offer. It’s lighter, has fewer moving parts, and boasts an optimized foot design. This makes the Magic Mouse 2 track faster and moves with less resistance.

Further, the Multi-Touch surface allows you to perform simple gestures such as swiping between web pages and scrolling through documents. The built-in battery is completely rechargeable, so eliminates the need for traditional batteries. This makes it incredibly convenient.

Pros

  • Rechargeable battery
  • Gesture support
  • Sleek design
  • Fast and smooth

Cons

  • A bit pricey

Check out on Amazon

2. Logitech MX Anywhere 2S – Hyper-Fast Scrolling

Here’s a super handy mouse that boasts hyper-fast scrolling. You can use it with up to three Mac or Windows computers via the included unifying receiver or Bluetooth Smart wireless technology.

Further, you can also press the wheel and shift to click to click mode for precise navigation. The rechargeable battery offers up to 70 days of power on a single charge. And the 4000 dpi dark field sensor tracks virtually anywhere.

Pros

  • Superfast speed
  • Long-lasting battery
  • Dual-connectivity

Cons

  • No wheel click button

Check out on Amazon

3. SteelSeries Rival 650 Mouse – Best for Gamers

If you enjoy gaming on your Mac, here’s the perfect mouse for you. Quantum wireless technology allows accurate, reliable, lag-free performance. You will get a 24+ hour battery life on a full charge or 10 hours from a 15-minute rapid charge.

Moreover, it boasts the most advanced optical sensor that provides true 1 to 1 tracking, while a secondary depth sensor adjusts the lift-off distance to control movement with precision and accuracy.

Pros

  • Great accuracy
  • Personalized configurations
  • Rapid charging battery

Cons

  • Build quality could be better

Check out on Amazon

4. Logitech MX Vertical – For Wrist Pain

If wrist pain is getting you down, check out this vertical mouse that places your hand in a natural handshake position using a unique 57-degree angle. It prevents your forearm from twisting, which is effective at reducing muscle pain.

The high precision sensor provides precise tracking that requires 4x less hand movement than a traditional mouse with a 1000 DPI sensor. Further, you can use it with up to three Windows or Mac computers.

Pros

  • Reduces wrist pain
  • High-precision tracker
  • Three ways to connect

Cons

  • Build quality could be better

Check out on Amazon

5. Logitech MX Master – Best Power Management

This wireless mouse features advanced power management. It offers up to 40 days of power on a single charge. Moreover, you can get enough power for a full day of usage in only 4 minutes, with no downtime while recharging.

Further, it’s got a unique thumb wheel for horizontal navigation and advanced gestures. It connects easily to multiple computers: via the included unifying receiver or Bluetooth smart wireless technology.

Pros

  • Great power management
  • Easy connection with multiple computers
  • Unique thumb wheel

Cons

  • Quite big and heavy

Check out on Amazon

6. TENMOS Wireless Mouse – Most Versatile

Here’s a mouse with universal compatibility and Bluetooth 5.1. The USB Type-C adapter makes it convenient to plug and play with your MacBook. The dual-mode connection lets you seamlessly switch between two devices.

Further, it features seven different coloured LED lights that change randomly while in use. This offers a soothing and funky atmosphere for work and play. The clicks are quiet, and you can also adjust the DPI levels among 800, 1200, and 1600 to meet different needs.

Pros

  • USB-C type adaptor
  • Attractive look
  • Adjustable DPI
  • Colour options

Cons

  • Lights might be distracting.

Check out on Amazon

Wrapping up!

Which wireless mouse for Mac best fits your needs? Let us know in the comments below. You can also check out how to use your iPhone as a mouse for your Mac.

Read more:

  • Magic Mouse Gestures Guide
  • Best Bluetooth mouse for iPad Pro
  • How to customize mouse pointer on Mac
  • Mouse cursor disappears on Mac? 13 Working fixes

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

title.rendered: Best accessories for iPhone 15 series in 2026

content.rendered:
The iPhone 15 series is finally launched with a slew of improvements. Apple has incorporated the USB-C port on all iPhone 15 models and replaced the Mute switch with the Action button in iPhone 15 Pro models. Also, Apple ditched leather and introduced FineWoven cases. Therefore, let’s explore the best accessories for the new iPhone 15 series to complement these changes.

Table of Contents
  1. Apple FineWoven Case with MagSafe
  2. TORRAS 360° rotatable kickstand case
  3. Belkin Ultraglass 2 screen protector
  4. Apple USB-C to Lightning Adapter
  5. Apple FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  6. Apple MagSafe charger
  7. CASETiFY USB-C to USB-C Cable

1. Apple FineWoven Case with MagSafe

Apple replaced leather with FineWoven material to make accessories to reduce its carbon footprint. The material is a velvety, suede-like microtwill that is both strong and durable. The FineWoven Case with MagSafe looks and feels great while protecting your new iPhone 15 Pro.

The case easily snaps into place and covers your iPhone tightly without adding extra bulk. Besides, thanks to built-in magnets, you can enjoy quick wireless charging or attach MagSafe accessories to the case.

Check out on: iPhone 15 | 15 Plus | 15 Pro | 15 Pro Max

2. TORRAS 360° rotatable kickstand case

If you love binge-watching shows on your iPhone, the TORRAS rotatable magnetic stand case is ideal. The ring kickstand is made of durable Aerospace-Grade material. It allows for any angle stand options and functions as a ring holder, giving you a secure and non-slip grip.

Besides, the textured case has a TPU bumper of 4-ply cushioning and 360° lens airbags. So, it has passed 3x Mil-Grade drop protection certification. Also, it has 38 pieces of N52 super-strong magnets. So, you can attach any MagSafe accessories and enjoy wireless charging.

Moreover, the case has a nano-coating oleophobic and anti-fingerprints layer. So, it efficiently prevents 99.9% of stains, fingerprints, and sweat. I liked its anti-slip texture for a firm grip and detachable DIY buttons for unique customization.

Check out on: Amazon

3. Belkin Ultraglass 2 screen protector

You must buy a durable screen protector with your new iPhone 15. The German-engineered Belkin UltraGlass 2 offers the highest level of protection. It is only 0.29mm thin yet 2.7 times stronger than tempered glass protectors. Besides, Belkin has chemically reinforced it by double ion exchange for ultra-impact protection.

Moreover, you will get enhanced durability, flexibility, and exceptional scratch resistance thanks to the lithium aluminosilicate film. Compared to the previous Belkin UltraGlass, drop performance improved by up to 24%. I liked its clever glass composition for flawless touchscreen responsiveness.

Check out on: Apple

4. Apple USB-C to Lightning Adapter

As Apple has opted for USB-C for the iPhone 15 series, you must need a USB-C to Lightning Adapter to use your old accessories with a Lightning port. So, you can charge your new iPhone, transfer data, or listen to music without replacing those accessories. For increased longevity, the cable on this adapter is braided.

Check out on: Apple

5. Apple FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe

The new iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe is ideal for keeping your ID and credit cards secure and close to hand. It can shield up to three cards. I love this wallet because it supports Find My. So, if it gets separated from your iPhone, you will be informed of its most recent known position.

Instead of leather, Apple has used FineWoven material, which is made of velvety, suede-like microtwill. So, it will enhance the aesthetics of your new iPhone 15. Besides, the wallet has strong internal magnets to easily snap on the back of your iPhone or on top of a MagSafe case.

Check out on: Apple

6. Apple MagSafe charger

The iPhone 15 series has a more powerful magnet, so wireless charging with the MagSafe charger is a breeze. It offers up to 15W quicker wireless charging thanks to the perfect magnet alignment. Besides, you can use it to juice your AirPods as well.

Check out on: Amazon

7. CASETiFY USB-C to USB-C Cable

Who said your iPhone 15 charging cables need to be boring? Well, at least CASETiFY doesn’t because it has created a top-quality USB-C to USB-C cable in funky colors. Engineered to perfection, this PowerThru charging cable promises to offer a swift power boost, increased durability, and multi-device compatibility. FYI, all my efforts to twist, bend, or tangle it went to no avail.

As I have mentioned about durability, let me elaborate on it. The cable gets its long-lasting characteristic from its braided recycled nylon build, which fights off everyday wear and tear.

In addition, the CASETiFY PowerThru cable has passed the bend tests more than 50,000 times, offering 50x improved bending strength. Also, you must know that charging cables tend to break from the head.

Check out on: Amazon | CASETiFY

Get the most out of your iPhone 15!

The iPhone 15 series is jam-packed with new features and changes. So, using the best accessories with your iPhone 15 will enhance its performance and boost your productivity. Which are your must-have iPhone accessories? Let me know in the comments below!

Explore more…

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

@graph.name: Belkin Dual USB-C wall charger
@graph.description: Along with the USB-C cable, you should buy a powerful USB-C fast adapter. The Belkin BOOSTCharge Pro Dual USB-C wall charger is an excellent solution to enjoy fast charging on your iPhone 15. It has Dual USB-C Ports to charge a MacBook up to 50W and an iOS device up to 20W simultaneously. I like to carry this adapter while on the go because it generates less heat and allows for greater power, thanks to GaN technology. So, you can charge your iPhone from 0 to 50% in 30 minutes.

@graph.name: Apple FineWoven Case with MagSafe
@graph.description: Apple replaced leather with FineWoven material to make accessories to reduce its carbon footprint. The material is a velvety, suede-like microtwill that is both strong and durable. The FineWoven Case with MagSafe looks and feels great while protecting your new iPhone 15 Pro. The case easily snaps into place and covers your iPhone tightly without adding extra bulk. Besides, thanks to built-in magnets, you can enjoy quick wireless charging or attach MagSafe accessories to the case.

@graph.name: TORRAS 360° rotatable kickstand case
@graph.description: If you love binge-watching shows on your iPhone, the TORRAS rotatable magnetic stand case is ideal. The ring kickstand is made of durable Aerospace-Grade material. It allows for any angle stand options and functions as a ring holder, giving you a secure and non-slip grip. Besides, the textured case has a TPU bumper of 4-ply cushioning and 360° lens airbags. So, it has passed 3x Mil-Grade drop protection certification. Also, it has 38 pieces of N52 super-strong magnets. So, you can attach any MagSafe accessories and enjoy wireless charging. Moreover, the case has a nano-coating oleophobic and anti-fingerprints layer. So, it efficiently prevents 99.9% of stains, fingerprints, and sweat. I liked its anti-slip texture for a firm grip and detachable DIY buttons for unique customization.

@graph.name: Belkin Ultraglass 2 screen protector
@graph.description: You must buy a durable screen protector with your new iPhone 15. The German-engineered Belkin UltraGlass 2 offers the highest level of protection. It is only 0.29mm thin yet 2.7 times stronger than tempered glass protectors. Besides, Belkin has chemically reinforced it by double ion exchange for ultra-impact protection. Moreover, you will get enhanced durability, flexibility, and exceptional scratch resistance thanks to the lithium aluminosilicate film. Compared to the previous Belkin UltraGlass, drop performance improved by up to 24%. I liked its clever glass composition for flawless touchscreen responsiveness.

@graph.name: Apple USB-C to Lightning Adapter
@graph.description: As Apple has opted for USB-C for the iPhone 15 series, you must need a USB-C to Lightning Adapter to use your old accessories with a Lightning port. So, you can charge your new iPhone, transfer data, or listen to music without replacing those accessories. For increased longevity, the cable on this adapter is braided.

@graph.name: Apple FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
@graph.description: The new iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe is ideal for keeping your ID and credit cards secure and close to hand. It can shield up to three cards. I love this wallet because it supports Find My. So, if it gets separated from your iPhone, you will be informed of its most recent known position. Instead of leather, Apple has used FineWoven material, which is made of velvety, suede-like microtwill. So, it will enhance the aesthetics of your new iPhone 15. Besides, the wallet has strong internal magnets to easily snap on the back of your iPhone or on top of a MagSafe case.

@graph.name: Apple MagSafe charger
@graph.description: The iPhone 15 series has a more powerful magnet, so wireless charging with the MagSafe charger is a breeze. It offers up to 15W quicker wireless charging thanks to the perfect magnet alignment. Besides, you can use it to juice your AirPods as well.

@graph.name: CASETiFY USB-C to USB-C Cable
@graph.description: Who said your iPhone 15 charging cables need to be boring? Well, at least CASETiFY doesn’t because it has created a top-quality USB-C to USB-C cable in funky colors. Engineered to perfection, this PowerThru charging cable promises to offer a swift power boost, increased durability, and multi-device compatibility. FYI, all my efforts to twist, bend, or tangle it went to no avail. As I have mentioned about durability, let me elaborate on it. The cable gets its long-lasting characteristic from its braided recycled nylon build, which fights off everyday wear and tear. In addition, the CASETiFY PowerThru cable has passed the bend tests more than 50,000 times, offering 50x improved bending strength. Also, you must know that charging cables tend to break from the head.

title.rendered: 7 Best Apple CarPlay head units in 2026

content.rendered:
The prevalence of Apple CarPlay reduced the excuse for carefree drivers to text while driving, which leads to many road accidents. You can use your iPhone without distractions with a CarPlay head mounted on your dashboard.

You can modify your car with an external CarPlay, even if most newer models integrate CarPlay into their head units. The built-in ones are the same. You’re in the right place if you’re looking for an Apple CarPlay head unit for your car.

Table of Contents
  1. Westods Portable Wireless CarPlay Car Stereo – Split screen available
  2. Sony XAVAX5500 Apple Car Play – Built-in subwoofers
  3. Kenwood 6.8-Inch Touch Screen CarPlay Head Unit – Support for FLAC
  4. JVC KW-M56BT Apple CarPlay – Support for DVD player
  5. BOSS Car Stereo System – Four screen sizes available
  6. Alpine ILX-F511 Multimedia Receiver – High-end head unit

1. Westods Portable Wireless CarPlay Car Stereo – Split screen available

Make your car’s interior look better with a split screen from Westods. Using Google or Siri Voice Assistant, you can easily access your smartphone using the Westod CarPlay head unit. With FM support, you can switch between your phone’s interface and FM radio programs.

Due to the built-in speaker, you can use this CarPlay with the car’s stereo or as an independent stereo. The installation of the head unit is straightforward from my experience.

The Westods 1600 x 600 resolution screen is also to touch control. The touch control can be better with a bit more sensitivity, though – pressure on the touch controls shifts the unit sometimes. It is one of the best CarPlay head units for adventurers, supporting front and rear video recording with night vision, made possible with the 2.5K high-definition camera input.

The Westods CarPlay head unit supports Bluetooth and Auxiliary connectivity for flexible output preference. While Bluetooth connectivity is always readily available, the 3mm jack plug option gives better output.

Pros

  • Supports rear and front cameras with 2.5K high-definition camera input for night vision
  • Support for digital video recording (DVR)
  • Built-in speakers available
  • Seamless installation

Cons

  • The touch sensitivity could be improved

Check out on Amazon

2. Sony XAVAX5500 Apple Car Play – Built-in subwoofers

Sony has been on a rampage with high-end electronics, and it does not go wrong with this Bezel-less capacitive touchscreen head unit. It supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto with smooth touch control. Once installed, which is easy, connect Sony’s head unit seamlessly via Bluetooth or USB. With dual USB support, you can connect and separate your music library from your phone’s navigation functionality.

The 5V outputs with the front and rear gold-plated subwoofer system give a stronger and cleaner audio signal, plus better control over the car’s stereo. Like the other car head units, this one also features built-in rear camera input for better reverse control.

Pros

  • Quality sound output
  • Support for Android Auto in addition to Apple CarPlay
  • The subwoofer system gives more control over the audio setup

Cons

  • The touch can be a bit tardy

Check out on Amazon

3. Kenwood 6.8-Inch Touch Screen CarPlay Head Unit – Support for FLAC

Enjoy a high contrast ratio and crystal clear display with the Kenwood Carplay head unit. Like the previously discussed ones, the Kenwood head unit features both CarPlay and Android Auto to use your Android and iPhone seamlessly without looking away from the windscreen. It has USB and Bluetooth support and fuses perfectly with your car’s stereo system.

Its Free Lossless Audio Codec (FLAC) support is quite impressive, with a 13 Band Graphic EQ and time alignment. With three camera inputs, you get all the parking guidelines you need for a smooth landing. The only setback is that the Bluetooth connectivity only works with a dongle. I expected this to be built-in.

Pros

  • Android Auto is also available
  • Impressive FLAC support
  • Control playback levels with the 13-band EQ
  • Full camera support with parking guideline

Cons

  • Requires a Bluetooth dongle to connect wirelessly

Check out on Amazon

4. JVC KW-M56BT Apple CarPlay – Support for DVD player

The JVC KW-M55BT Apple CarPlay has two models: a VIN-only and a VIN with DVD model. While the former is cheaper, pumping your budget by a few bucks can get you the latter model if you’re a DVD fan. Like the other head units recommended earlier, the JVC head unit supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and features a rear camera input for reverse navigation.

The 13-band equalizer and 6.8-inch capacitive touch screen give you absolute control over your playbacks. Experience smooth calling and playback with its simultaneous Bluetooth connection. An extra addition is the 1.5A USB port for fast-charging your smartphone. However, a notable shortcoming is the occasional latency during phone calls.

Pros

  • Control playback seamlessly with the 13-band equalizer
  • Charging port available
  • Pair with two iPhones simultaneously
  • Back camera input available

Cons

  • The phone call quality can be better

Check out on Amazon

5. BOSS Car Stereo System – Four screen sizes available

If you want more features and functionalities at some of the cheapest prices, you can adorn your car’s dashboard with one of these Boss Audio Systems. It comes in four screen sizes, including 7, 8, 9, and 10.1 inches. While more expensive, you might want to go with the bigger screen for easy navigation. There is an AV input for video playback. And it syncs perfectly with your steering control for easy access.

In addition to Bluetooth connectivity, there is a USB option with output for charging and connecting your flash drive for direct music playback. With the feature to switch between Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, you can pair this with your iPhone or Android phone. In addition to supporting more apps and having a touch control, you can easily take calls and reply to messages hands-free with Siri and Google voice control.

Pros

  • Operate more apps and make phone calls hands-free with voice control
  • Play music or podcasts directly via a USB flash drive
  • Control your head unit from your steering wheel
  • AV input available for video playback

Cons

  • The UI of the smaller screen model is a little dense, affecting operability

Check out on Amazon

6. Alpine ILX-F511 Multimedia Receiver – High-end head unit

If you don’t mind the price, the Alpine ILX-F511 Multimedia Receiver delivers top-notch functionalities and is still the overall best head unit on this list. Featuring Android Auto and CarPlay, the screen is an 11-inch WXGA High-Resolution Display, conferring a super-sensitive touch control. And the Hi-Res Audio Playback speaks for itself. Take your gaming experience to your car with its HDMI input.

The Alpine head unit is compatible with the DVR-C320R Alpine Dash camera, delivering a clean front and rear distance guide. This one also has built-in amplifiers with four channels, including front and rear subwoofers. Each amplifier peaks at 50 watts per channel, enough to play audio independently of your car stereo.

With support for touch and voice control (Google and Siri), you’ll enjoy free hand calls with the external microphone. Overall, the Alpine ILX-F511 Multimedia Receiver delivers top-notch quality and is worth the price.

Pros

  • Top-notch display with super-sensitive screen
  • Built-in subwoofers and hi-res speakers make it output at car-stereo level
  • HDMI and auxiliary support available
  • Steering wheel control available

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on Amazon

Apple CarPlay vs. Android Auto

Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are dashboard-mounted devices that allow you to control your smartphones easily while driving. Invariably, they perform similar functions. Their ultimate goal is keeping your attention on the windscreen and preventing distractions from your phone.

The only difference between both is the platform they support. While Android Auto only supports Android phones, the CarPlay works with Apple’s iPhone and related devices.

Although there are dedicated head units for either, most platform-agnostic car head units feature both. However, like Android Auto, the CarPlay is not exclusive to Apple. CarPlay only describes head units compatible with the Apple ecosystem. These are available from various manufacturers.

Stay safe while driving!

Although the iPhone is agreeably addictive, you know the risks behind text-driving and call-driving. Investing in one of these Apple CarPlay head units is one of the best decisions you’ll make to safeguard your life and property.

  • Best wireless CarPlay adapters
  • Apple CarPlay not Working? How to fix it

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

title.rendered: Best USB-C to USB-C charging cables for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
Due to rapid technological advancements, it is imperative to invest in reliable and efficient Mac charging solutions. The problem is that there are so many choices available that it can be difficult to pick the right product.

That’s no longer the case! We’re here today to introduce you to the best USB-C to USB-C charging cables for MacBooks with a myriad of options flooding the market.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple charging cable – Editor’s Choice
  • 2. Anker charging cable – Sleek and stylish
  • 3. AINOPE charging cable – Climate pledge friendly
  • 4. SOOPII charging cable – Smart and efficient
  • 5. JSAUX charging cable – Double-ended USB-C cable
  • 6. IFEART USB-C to USB-C charging cable
  • 7. YBMTIGICS charging cable – Durable and flexible
  • 8. Anker Powerline III charging cable – Live charged
  • 9. Deegotech charging cable – Nylon braided
  • 10. Amazon Basics charging cable – The OG

1. Apple charging cable – Editor’s Choice

As we embark on our quest to find the best USB-C charging cable for MacBook, it’s best to start by searching at home for options. When it comes to reliability, durability, and compatibility, Apple is simply unrivaled. Exclusively for Apple devices, this USB-C cable boasts fast charging capabilities while efficiently powering up your device without damaging it.

Apple charging cable features a slim and subtle design capable of pairing with various USB-C power adapters for Mac. Moreover, the high-quality materials used in this 2m cable make it an ideal travel companion.

The intelligent chip is a superior feature that surpasses factors such as overvoltage protection, ensuring that your valuable MacBook is safeguarded against any potential damage. With Apple’s commitment to superior craftsmanship and ensuring optimal performance, this USB-C charging cable meets all the right criteria.

Pros

  • Apple’s support
  • Well-suited with MacBooks
  • Does the job

Cons

  • It may not last longer

Check out on Amazon

2. Anker charging cable – Sleek and stylish

With impressive capabilities and high-quality build, it’s time to welcome the Anker nylon charging cable for your Mac. It is well-known to ensure reliability and power delivery at all times, regardless of the use case. This cable can diligently put the hunger away for your device by boasting a 100W power output.

If you frequently forget that your devices are connected and move around carelessly, rest assured. This cable features a length of 10 feet to provide you with ample room for movement. The nylon braiding material further enhances longevity by providing resistance against damage by bending or stretching. Its durable build and outstanding performance make it an excellent option.

Additionally, the Anker Cable meets strict industry standards for data transfer speeds, ensuring seamless file transfers between devices without compromise. Overall, individuals keeping an eye out for a dependable USB-C cable for their MacBook can rely on the Anker Cable 100W 10ft.

Pros

  • Nylon braided cable
  • 12,000 bend lifespan
  • Hard-wearing exterior

Cons

  • Fails to reliably charge a MacBook Pro
  • Inconsistent

Check out on Amazon

3. AINOPE charging cable – Climate pledge friendly

ANIOPE has become a go-to choice for many MacBook users all across the globe looking for a reliable and efficient charging solution. The impressive features and exceptional performance of this cable stand out from many. With its ergonomic 90° Right Angle “L” design, it will prevent typical wear, straining cable, and connection issues, extending the cable’s life. 

This 60W fast charging cable seamlessly supports PD3.0/QC3.0/QC4.0, compatible with every USB charger for Mac. AINOPE also emphasizes safety by incorporating built-in safeguards like overvoltage protection, ensuring worry-free usage. And those who constantly indulge in file transfers can experience data transfer speeds up to 480Mbps, ensuring quick file transfers. 

Proven in laboratory environments, this SR joint cable lasts almost 30x longer than traditional USB-C cables, capable of withstanding 40000 bends. These impeccable combinations of functionality and features are the reasons why ANIPOE is the top contender in this list. Definitely worth trying.

Pros

  • Advanced right-angle design
  • Reliable durability
  • Highly compatible

Cons

  • Does not support fast charging for selected devices

Check out on Amazon

4. SOOPII charging cable – Smart and efficient

This is the most interesting and smart product on our display today. The SOOPII USB-C to USB-C cable charger features an amazing power supply of 100W along with a 10-foot cable length. The unique and smart design of this cable brings you a real-time charging power display with a built-in smart chipset that safeguards the health of the battery. 

Blessed with tried and tested 36,000+ bends, this cable is comprised of special zinc alloy and rugged nylon braided exterior. Hence, rest assured, as SOOPII charging cable serves you longer and stronger for days to come. This cable delivers power flawlessly and works with all devices that support USB-C charging, including the MacBook. 

For individuals in search of exceptional performance that is dependable and effective, SOOPII is an excellent choice, given its vast array of features and capabilities. Its reliable and efficient performance is sure to satisfy even the most discerning of users.

Pros

  • Smart power display
  • Supports 100W fast charging
  • Nice at lower wattages

Cons

  • Less than optimal charging speed
  • The display screen for the wattage is not completely accurate

Check out on Amazon

5. JSAUX charging cable – Double-ended USB-C cable

Our expedition has now brought us to JSAUX, one of the best MacBook chargers available in the market. It is equipped with exceptional performance and impressive durability, capable of delivering a whopping 100W of power, ensuring fast and efficient charging. It is also comprised of an extra layer of protection against bending or fraying. 

Wait, there’s more. There is a built-in SUPER E-MARK chip that focuses on the supplied power based on the respective battery. Featuring a 3D aluminum connector and exclusive laser welding technology, this cable complies with every industry standard. What’s more, it can automatically detect the battery capacity at 80% and adjust the power supply accordingly.  

This, along with the trickle mode to extend your device’s battery life and protect it from damage, makes it well worth it. Given all the features, it’s safe to conclude that JSAUX USB-C charging cable is all you need to keep your MacBook charged effectively without any compromises in quality or performance.

Pros

  • Certified safety
  • Built-in E-Mark chip
  • Laser welding connector

Cons

  • Unresponsive at times

Check out on Amazon

6. IFEART USB-C to USB-C charging cable

With a universal match to every PD USB-C charger, IFEART is at your service. But compatibility is just one of the major selling points for this charging cable. It is constructed with premium materials, dedicated to providing a long-lasting performance and withstanding wear and tear marginally. 

The power delivery capabilities of this cable ensure that your MacBook’s battery health is always preserved, regardless of the voltage setting of the socket. Once your start using this piece of art, there is no going back, as it eliminates the need for dongles or adapters. 

Finally, for those who are concerned about the quality of the cable, you’ll not be disappointed. The reinforced connectors and a braided nylon exterior will always be on guard at all times. If you’re on the go or working at your desk, the IFEART USB-C to USB-C charging cable ensures reliable and efficient power delivery for your MacBook.

Pros

  • USB-IF Certified
  • 20V 3A output
  • Superior durability

Cons

  • Not advised for a few devices

Check out on Amazon

7. YBMTIGICS charging cable – Durable and flexible

Showcasing outstanding performance, rugged durability, and enhanced compatibility, allow me to introduce you to YBMTIGICS USB-C to USB-C charging cable. The upscaled USB-C 3.1 technology of this product supports lightning-fast charging speed effortlessly while enabling the users to make the most of high-speed data sync at 480Mbps.

The robust construction of the YBMTIGICS cable ensures excellent reliability and longevity. It can diligently withstand up to 12,000 bends. Moreover, you won’t have to worry about overheating or overcharging as this cable is equipped with an intelligent design that handles those concerns.

Every individual seeking a dependable and efficient charging solution for their MacBook should not hesitate to buy this simple and sleek alternative. Being a top priority for many, YBMTIGICS USB-C to USB-C charging cable is unbeatable in multiple aspects.

Pros

  • Supports Power Delivery
  • Built to last
  • Universal compatibility
  • E-Mark 60W chip

Cons

  • Not compatible with iPad Air 4
  • Compromised quality

Check out on Amazon

8. Anker Powerline III charging cable – Live charged

Here’s another champ all set to take your burden away of finding an optimal charging cable for Mac. The Anker Powerline III USB-C to USB-C charging cable boasts a robust design and advanced technology while promising to keep your Mac juiced up at all times. 

The design of this cable features USB-C connectors on both ends to ensure compatibility with almost every MacBook out there. Moreover, the power delivery capacity of this cable is followed by 100W energy dismissal, which can charge your device 58% faster than traditional cables. And don’t worry; it is well-equipped with the necessary protocols to keep your device safe. 

The Powerline III is built to last with reinforced connectors and a durable braided nylon exterior that can withstand everyday wear and tear. Overall, the Anker Powerline III is an excellent combination of superior performance, durability, and versatility in a sleek package, perfect for MacBook users.

Pros

  • Dual-Chip design
  • High-Speed compatible
  • Slimmer yet strong

Cons

  • Passive aggressive customer service
  • Occasionally fails to support 100W

Check out on Amazon

9. Deegotech charging cable – Nylon braided

The Deegotech USB-C to USB-C Cable is undoubtedly one of the best USB-C charging cables for MacBooks in 2023. This premium cable stands out due to its exceptional quality, durability, and fast charging capabilities. The Deegotech charging cable boasts sturdy construction, reinforced at both ends to ensure durability and prevent fraying or damage over time. 

Those who are equipped with 87W/96W/120W power adapters can seamlessly enjoy the support of 0V/5A max power delivery and fast charge. Basically, it can charge your Mac up to 38% in a matter of 30 minutes. Other extensions that will prove useful include easy-to-use file-sharing and high-speed data transfers. 

Exhibiting an impressive power output of 100W, the Deegotech USB-C charging cable is well-suited for every power-hungry MacBook out there. Finally, it also eliminates the frustration of fumbling with plug orientation by providing reversible connectors on both ends. In conclusion, this unbeatable combination of functionality and reality is definitely a choice you should consider.

Pros

  • Widely compatible
  • Built to Last
  • 6.6ft long cable
  • 480 Mbps sync speed

Cons

  • USB-C connectors are too thick
  • Braided material is decent

Check out on Amazon

10. Amazon Basics charging cable – The OG

Let’s finish off with a masterpiece straight from Amazon. The Amazon Basics cable utilizes the latest technology to provide fast and efficient charging for your MacBook, ensuring it powers up quickly. It is further capable of emitting up to 480 Mbps data transfer speed followed by power output up to 5V. 

The reinforced connectors and high-quality exterior are simply commendable. It can withstand everyday use without compromising on performance and safety, making it a versatile option for MacBook users. 

Additionally, this cable supports fast data transfer speeds, enabling seamless file transfers between devices. With its affordable price point and excellent performance, the Amazon Basics USB-C to USB-C 2.0 Fast Charging Cable proves to be a reliable choice for professionals seeking a top-notch charging solution for their MacBook. 

Pros

  • 1-Year Limited Warranty
  • Reversible design
  • Certified by USB-IF

Cons

  • Not ideal for 60W
  • Doesn’t last long

Check out on Amazon

The future is here!

Whether you’re a busy professional on the go, with these USB cables, you can bid farewell to slow charging and tangled cords. Embrace the convenience, speed, and reliability that the USB-C standard offers, and let your MacBook shine at its brightest potential.

Thank you for reading. Please comment below and let us know which USB cable you prefer from the list provided.

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

title.rendered: Best keyboard covers for 16-inch MacBook Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
An office setup with a MacBook Pro, a steaming cup of coffee, and scattered files. Imagine spilling coffee on your precious Mac keyboard. That hurts! The horror you feel is quite apparent. Getting keyboard covers for your MacBook Pro will save you from such situations!

There is a wide range of keyboard covers available on the market. You can find them in a variety of colors, designs, materials, prices, and other factors, and they can protect your keyboard from dirt, spills, finger marks, etc. In this list, I have picked the best keyboard covers for the 16-inch MacBook Pro! Take a look at the entries and pick one that fits your bill!

Table of Contents
  • 1. UPPERCASE GhostCover – Top quality, durable
  • 2. imComor – Perfect thickness for smooth typing
  • 3. CaseBuy – Transparent cover for a clean look
  • 4. EooCoo –  Lightweight and durable
  • 5. Se7enline – Multicolor keyboard cover for MacBook Pro

1. UPPERCASE GhostCover – Top quality, durable

Are you looking for a non-silicone keyboard overlay? Then, UPPERCASE has something perfect for you. Unlike most other brands, UPPERCASE GhostCover Premium Ultra-Thin keyboard overlay is made with top-quality TPU material. This ensures the material is not stretched out even after years of use. Wash and reuse the overlay as you want.

The keyboard protector comes with 0.12mm thickness to ensure that your fingers can glide through the keys swiftly without feeling interference. In addition, the transparent look of the cover blends effortlessly with the MacBook keyboard and does not interrupt the keyboard backlight. A specific cut-out for the touch ID is an applause-worthy feature of this excellent keyboard cover by UPPERCASE.   

Pros

  • Made of high-quality TPU material  
  • Washable and reusable  
  • Fingerprint sensor cut out  
  • Transparent look  

Cons

  • Rigid edges  

Check out on Amazon

2. imComor – Perfect thickness for smooth typing

With imComor’s ultra-thin cover, you can keep the keypad of your MacBook Pro safe and stylish. The product offers high-end durability with its premium-quality silicone build that sits perfectly on your keypad. Its elastic material gives you complete flexibility to use the keyboard however you want. Moreover, its 0.13mm thickness ensures negligible interference and a smooth typing experience, irrespective of the timespan.   

The keys and symbols are individually molded and printed on silicone for long-lasting use and all-around protection. Further, the water-resistant finish saves your laptop from impromptu spills, dust, and other unwanted things. The waterproof texture is so good that you can rinse it with water and reuse it without compromise— a perfect companion for your Mac.  

Pros

  • Made of superior silicone material  
  • Durable and washable  
  • Spill-resistant and dust-proof  

Cons

  • Poor fit  

Check out on Amazon  

3. CaseBuy – Transparent cover for a clean look  

Get unmatchable safety for your MacBook Pro keyboard with this premium cover from CaseBuy. Its superior-quality TPU material ensures that the cover fits perfectly over each key and is free from any typing noise. Moreover, you don’t have to worry about the fingerprint sensor because the CaseBuy MacBook Pro 16-inch keyboard cover has a separate cut-out for easy Touch ID access.   

The 0.12 mm thick ultra-thin cover lets you glide your fingers smoothly over the keypad without sticking out too much. It is a blessing if you have sweaty or oily hands. In addition, the transparent finish allows the backlight to shine, so you can use your MacBook at night or in dim light. Later, you can take the cover off and wash it with soap and water to reuse it multiple times with the same perfect finish.  

Pros

  • Top-quality TPU material  
  • Perfect thickness  
  • Dedicated cutout for Touch ID  
  • Washable and reusable   

Cons

  • Poor adhesive   

Check out on Amazon 

4. EooCoo –  Lightweight and durable  

Add an extra layer of safety to your 16-inch MacBook Pro keyboard with EooCoo cover. This ultra-thin sheet sits perfectly over your Mac keyboard like a second skin, leaving no unfamiliar feel on your fingers. In addition, the 0.12mm thick, top-quality TPU material used in making the cover ensures that it does not stretch out easily. Once you stick the EooCoo keyboard cover, you can say goodbye to all your fears.  

Like others, EooCoo keyboard cover is also waterproof, dustproof, and free from fingerprint stains. When the film feels dirty, you can wash it with water and soap and then reuse it without compromising on quality. In addition, due to high transparency, the overlay allows backlight keys to shine through clearly. Further, the print on the overlay stays on the keys for long even after continuous rigorous typing.  

Pros

  • Superior quality TPU material 
  • Waterproof, dustproof, and anti-fingerprint 
  • Washable and reusable 
  • Thin and durable finish  

Cons

  • Plastic can get damaged on system overheating 

Check out on Amazon 

5. Se7enline – Multicolor keyboard cover for MacBook Pro

Se7enline adds an extra layer of safety to your 16-inch MacBook Pro with its super thin keyboard cover. Made with the best quality non-toxic silicone material, this multicolor cover blesses you with smooth usage and all-around protection. Whether you spill water on your MacBook keyboard or are too lazy to keep it clean – Se7enline’s silicone build keeps it safe from all the unwanted chaos.  

The 0.3mm thickness of the overlay is super lightweight and feels like air on the fingers. It protects your screen from scratches while ensuring your fingers move swiftly across the keys when typing. Further, the product’s strong adhesive helps keep it intact, irrespective of how roughly you tap on the keys.   

Pros

  • Durable silicone build  
  • Safety from spills, dust, etc.   
  • Ultra-thin ensuring a perfect fit  
  • Easy to install and remove  

Cons

  • Fit issues might arise in some Mac models

Check out on Amazon 

Wrapping up!

Your MacBook is not just a laptop. It is home to your work, entertainment, and everything you put it to use for. Adding a cover to your MacBook Pro 16-inch keyboard can add more life to it. Luckily, you don’t have to spend hours looking for a suitable keyboard protector online or offline because now you have this list.   

Here, you get some of the best silicone keyboards and non-silicone covers that promise to keep your Mac new for years. Moreover, I have tried to pick keyboard covers that do not create a hole in your pockets. So, you will likely find your favorite match quickly. Do share your views in the comments below.

  • Best bags for MacBook Pro
  • Best USB-C hubs for MacBook Pro

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.
