title.rendered: 7 Best slideshow maker apps for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple Photos only allows the users to design a slideshow. It does not provide a way to share or save them. Well, that’s where I come to the picture. So, in this post, I’ll introduce you to some innovative slideshow maker apps for iPhone that can transform your photos into a dynamic presentation.

Table of Contents
  • 1. iMovie – Editor's Choice
  • 2. Animoto – Eye-catching layouts
  • 3. Magisto – Choose, set, and collect
  • 4. GoPro Quik – Automatic edits
  • 5. Slide Show Maker – Add music to your slideshow
  • 6. PicPlayPost – The three-step editor
  • 7. Slideshow Add Music to Photos – Photo slide show, video maker

1. iMovie – Editor’s Choice

Regarded as one of the best free slideshow apps for iPhones, meet our top recommendation, iMovie. It seamlessly empowers users to create visually appealing slideshows right on iPhone. The intuitive user interface, extensive editing capabilities, and vast collection of pre-designed templates of iMovie are truly one of a kind.

With the comprehensive suite of editing tools available, you can unleash your creativity and create stunning slideshows with ease, even with minimal experience. From adjusting transitions and adding text overlays to incorporating music and sound effects, professionals can customize every aspect of the slideshow. Features like PIP and green effects add a significant level of sophistication to the user’s output.

Given that iMovie is the go-to app for many iOS users, it can flawlessly integrate with iCloud and other services. It allows editors to collaborate easily and showcase their work on any platform they desire. All in all, it boasts uniformity between functionality and ease of use, making it the top choice for professionals looking to create compelling slideshows on iPhone.

Price: Free

Download

2. Animoto – Eye-catching layouts

But wait! What about those who are searching for a vast collection of pre-made templates to easily create professional slideshows? If you’re one such enthusiast, then your search ends here. Transform your favorite pictures into captivating animations with Animoto, featuring seamless transitions that will bring your memories to life.

Animoto’s vast collection of ready-to-use templates enables even those without prior design experience to create captivating slideshows in minutes. Furthermore, this app grants you the ability to completely customize every minute aspect of your slideshow. From choosing different animation styles to adding text overlays and sound effects, do as you please.

Compatible with both photo and video formats, Animoto offers versatile options for displaying work or personal content in a polished and engaging way. Having all these features on your iPhone will help you showcase your creativity or present your work professionally.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $9.99)

Download

3. Magisto – Choose, set, and collect

With its intelligent and innovative features, Magisto has revolutionized the way users capture and present their memories. The app uses AI to apply filters, transitions, and effects to user-selected photos and videos, resulting in a professional-looking slideshow.

Furthermore, Magisto’s intuitive interface makes it incredibly easy to use, allowing even amateurs to produce visually captivating presentations effortlessly. The app offers customization options, such as adding captions and background music to enhance the storytelling experience. With its advanced editing tools, users can trim image sections, adjust brightness levels, and apply slow-motion or fast-forward effects.

And what good is your creativity if you can’t share it with your friends? Magisto simplifies sharing by allowing seamless integration with social media platforms like Instagram or Facebook. This unique blend of accessibility and powerful editing capabilities makes this app an unrivaled choice for every individual looking to come up with an eye-catching slideshow.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $9.99)

Download

4. GoPro Quik – Automatic edits

When it comes to creating professional and captivating slideshows on your iPhone, GoPro Quik is undoubtedly one of the best image editing apps available. This app allows even amateur photographers and videographers to craft visually stunning slideshows. Elevate your photos and videos with GoPro Quik’s themes, filters, transitions, and music options. Transform your images in just a few clicks.

GoPro Quik is an essential tool that delivers exceptional results regardless of the image. The app also enables precise timeline adjustments and manual customization for users seeking complete creative control. A smart editing algorithm analyzes your media content to identify the most exciting moments and syncs them with a soundtrack.

Whether you’re a social media influencer or a business professional in need of a powerful slideshow app on the go, GoPro Quik is all you need. So, what are you waiting for? Take this moment to effortlessly create stunning slideshows that capture the essence of your media content.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99)

Download

5. Slide Show Maker – Add music to your slideshow

Our next presentation brings us to Slide Show Maker. In essence, it does what it is entitled to do, but better than many. Packed with a comprehensive set of features, this app allows users to effortlessly combine photos, videos, music, and text to create captivating presentations. With a user-friendly interface and intuitive controls, Slide Show Maker offers a seamless user experience.

It is composed of a wide range of customizable templates, transitions, and effects that can uplift the aura of your images chosen for the slideshow. Advanced editing tools further offer precise control over photo cropping, rotation, and color adjustments. Finally, those who crave more can utilize amazing audio editing options that allow users to incorporate voiceover or music with ease.

Users can also directly upload Slide Show Maker creations to Facebook and Twitter or save them in high-resolution formats for personal use. It is an indispensable tool for professionals seeking to create impressive slideshows on their iPhones effortlessly.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $8.99)

Download

6. PicPlayPost – The three-step editor

If you, too, are looking to curate dynamic and professional slideshows, then your search has met its end. Meet PicPlayPost, a three-step solution for your slideshow needs. From the ability to adjust image transition speed to the option of adding captions or texts, PicPlayPost offers endless possibilities for customization.

The extensive library of stylish templates and filters further enhances the visual appeal of the slideshow, allowing professionals to effortlessly create captivating content. The supreme part about PicPlayPost is that it’s not limited to images. You can repeat the same with video clips or a well-curated mix of both. It will enrich you with the best of both worlds.

Whether you’re a professional looking to showcase your work or simply want to create a memorable slideshow, PicPlayPost has everything you need. So why settle for ordinary slideshows when you can create extraordinary ones and share them directly on your favorite platform in one click? Bring out the best in you.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $6.99)

Download

7. Slideshow Add Music to Photos – Photo slide show, video maker

By now, we’ve been through a series of amazing apps that can get you started making a slideshow in no time. However, today, we’ll conclude our list with a bang. That’s right. Combined with a seamless and user-friendly interface, welcome Slideshow Add Music to Photos, which allows you to transform your photos into stunning slideshows effortlessly.

With its vast collection of professional-grade templates, you can choose the perfect style for any occasion or theme. Additionally, the app offers an extensive library of licensed music tracks. Customization options are aplenty, allowing you to adjust slide duration and transition effects and add text captions for a more personalized touch.

Sharing the completed slideshow is as convenient as ever. You can export it directly to social media platforms or save it in various formats like HD videos or GIFs. Whether you’re a professional photographer or simply want to create memorable slideshows, Slideshow Add Music to Photos is the perfect tool for achieving high-quality results with ease and efficiency.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99)

Download

Slide into your memories with style!

Craft visual masterpieces that capture the essence of a moment and infuse life into photos with these slideshow maker apps for iPhone.

Thank you for reading. Please take a moment to leave your thoughts in the comment section below.

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

title.rendered: Best camera lens protector for iPhone 13 and 13 mini in 2026

content.rendered:
One of the most desirable features of the iPhone is its outstanding camera performance. It is more crucial to add some protection to the iPhone 13 series, due to its protruding camera. While you may be using a case, it is better to use a camera lens protector for your iPhone 13 or 13 mini to ease your worries.

Investing in these lens protectors will save you from damaging your camera and having to pay a hefty repair bill. Additionally, they keep the camera lens scratch-free. Let me help you select the best camera lens protector for iPhone 13 and 13 mini.

Table of Contents
  1. Spigen iPhone camera protector: Editor's choice
  2. QHOHQ 3-pack protector: Comes with screen protector
  3. Casetify camera lens protector: Eco-friendly
  4. Ailun camera lens protector: Ultra-thin cover
  5. SPARIN iPhone 13 mini protector: 360° protection
  6. Unique Me lens protector: Best budget pick
  7. Ferilinsolens protector: Best for iPhone 13 mini
  8. Tensea metal ring lens protector: Stylish and elegant
  9. Goton Bling camera lens protector: Decorative look

1. Spigen iPhone camera protector: Editor’s choice

Spigen offers the best premium tempered glass camera lens protector for iPhone 13 and 13 mini. The thin cover provides a layer of scratch and smudge prevention without any extra raise. Altogether, it fits perfectly on the diagonal camera configuration and LiDAR sensor.

It has an anti-fingerprint coating even if you’ve touched the camera with oily or unclean hands. Spigen provides a range of colors to match the color of your iPhone. 

But the biggest turn-off for me is that the lens cover catches dust underneath. It makes the camera blurry after using it for a few weeks.

Pros

  • Anti-fingerprint coating
  • Extra scratch protection
  • Partial adhesive for no blemish

Cons

  • Collects dust

Check out on: Amazon | Spigen

2. QHOHQ 3-pack protector: Comes with screen protector

QHOHQ offers a 2-in-one protector. It comes with the iPhone 13 screen protector and camera protector too. It has 9H hardness, 2.5D rounded corners, 0.33mm tempered glass, and a smooth, non-scratch edge. Subsequently, the night anti-glare coating will protect your device from water, oil, dust, fingerprints, and scratches. 

The best part is that the company has used advanced augmented reality “Seamless” fusion technology. It has improved 99.9% optical-grade light transmission features. So, if you capture photos in low-light using flash, you will get HD-quality images.

Pros

  • AR integration for sharp pictures,
  • 360° protection
  • Advance anti-glare technology

Cons

  • Hard to remove
  • Not for iPhone 13 mini

Check out on: Amazon

3. Casetify camera lens protector: Eco-friendly

Keep your photos in HD clarity with Casetify’s simple-to-apply camera lens cover for iPhone 13 and 13 mini. It includes anti-fingerprint protection so you’ll never notice a smudge on your camera.

The tiny black camera hole detects the flashlight from all sides, eliminating hazy pictures. The strong, eco-friendly glass is scratch-proof. Moreover, you can see raised corners intended to protect your lens from all sides without interfering with your image.

Pros

  • HD clarity
  • Simple application

Cons

  • Expensive
  • Cracks easily

Check out on: Casetify

4. Ailun camera lens protector: Ultra-thin cover

The third product on my list is Amazon’s choice product. The Ailun camera lens protector fits iPhone 13 and 13 mini as well as cases. 0.1mm ultra-thin tempered glass laser cut and delicately polished ensures 99.9% transparency. Additionally, the 9H hardness provides the best scratch and accident resistance.

This cover’s advanced light transmittance and night shooting capabilities use Augmented Reality. So, you can ace nightlife photography with the sharp and crisp quality of images and videos. High-definition, anti-fingerprint screen coating makes the Ailun lens cover water and oil-proof.

But the brand needs to work on the shatterproof build to make the durability long-lasting.

Pros

  • Ultra-thin
  • Case-friendly
  • Oil resistant

Cons

  • Not durable

Check out on: Amazon

5. SPARIN iPhone 13 mini protector: 360° protection

SPARIN high-quality tempered glass lens protector with a 9H hardness offers expert protection against drops, scratches, and scrapes. It is super transparent and low-glare. It has an oleophobic and hydrophobic screen coating so it can effectively prevent oil, water, and fingerprints.

You can easily install it with the given instruction frame. Furthermore, the dust- and bubble-free self-adhesive of the lens avoids edge peeling. 

This full-coverage iPhone 13 mini camera lens protector has a night circle that helps to avoid overexposure and keep the original pixel while taking pictures. 

Pros

  • Self-adhesive

Cons

  • Thick glass
  • Not for iPhone 13

Check out on: Amazon

6. Unique Me lens protector: Best budget pick

The Unique Me iPhone 13 camera lens protector is among the best ones under $10, given the cost and functionality. It is also compatible with iPhone 13 mini. The 9H hardy tempered glass protects your camera from minimal scratches to accidental drops. 

Moreover, the oleophobic coating on the outside layer makes it water-, oil-, and dust-proof. It has a 99.99% transparency rate to provide clarity and true colors without affecting the image quality. Besides protection, a black circular pattern on the cover gives a cool look to your iPhone.

Pros

  • Budget-friendly
  • Anti-glare

Cons

  • Thick glass

Check out on: Amazon

7. Ferilinsolens protector: Best for iPhone 13 mini

Ferilinso offers three camera lens packs which are plenty to shield your iPhone 13 mini camera lens for a few years. Despite the affordable pricing, you get HD tempered glass with a laser-cutting case-friendly design and 9H hardness. No bubbles are left while installing, and no residue when you change or remove it. 

This lens protector has an enhanced Night Flash Circle to ensure you can capture stunning images at night. Additionally, the nano-electrostatic absorption technology increases the effect of flash at night. Additionally, the ultra-transparent design guarantees that the images will be clear and true to their original hues.

Pros

  • Perfect fit
  • HD clarity
  • Easy to install

Cons

  • Corners peel off easily
  • Not for iPhone 13

Check out on: Amazon

8. Tensea metal ring lens protector: Stylish and elegant

If you’re searching for a visually pleasing unique camera lens cover, Tensea iPhone 13 lens protector is the one. It fits both iPhone 13 and 13 mini and is case-friendly. The best feature is that it comes as an individual metal ring for each lens. 

The unique 5-layer aluminum and 9H hardness tempered glass protect the lenses from scratches, dust, and water. Besides the glitter effect in the border, the 3D texture and the spiral design on this glass creates lovely reflections and sparkle. 

Because of the transparent glass, you can take the greatest images without sacrificing the colors and lighting effects. Also, choose from various colors to match the lens protector with your iPhone.

Pros

  • Aluminum build
  • Unique spiral design
  • Strong adsorption
  • Ultra slim

Cons

  • Cheap quality
  • Adhesive problem

Check out on: Amazon

9. Goton Bling camera lens protector: Decorative look

Goton Bling gives your iPhone 13/13 mini a distinctively brilliant appearance with the glittering diamond crystal metal lens protector. For an overall unique look, they have placed diamonds all over the glossy shield and around the lens rings. So, if you enjoy a diamond-style iPhone back, it is ideal.

It comes in seven different colors. But the glass is not hardy at all. Therefore, don’t rely on it to shield the iPhone camera lens from accidental drops. Additionally, there is a chance that some diamonds may come off the cover and not look good. Also, you won’t get any installation tools or guides.

Pros

  • Glossy look
  • 7 Color options

Cons

  • Not durable
  • No installation tool


Check out on: Amazon

So, that’s all!

Here are all the top 10 best camera lens protectors for iPhone 13 and 13 mini. Pick the one according to your requirements. Do you use a camera lens protector for your device? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

FAQs

Does iPhone lens protector affect picture quality?

No. If you apply it correctly, the iPhone camera lens protector will not interfere with your image. So, while installing, check that there is no dust or lint on the lens. Also, handle the lens protector with care, so it doesn’t get severe scratches.

Are iPhone camera lens protectors worth it?

Many claim that lens protectors are not essential since the iPhone’s rear cameras are made of sapphire. It is robust and difficult to scratch. So, lens protectors are only for extra caution and decoration of your iPhone.

Does Apple recommend lens protectors?

There is no official statement from Apple about this. Using a lens protector depends on how you handle your iPhone. If it remains in your pockets along with keys, you should definitely consider using it.

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

mainEntity.name: Does iPhone lens protector affect picture quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. If you apply it correctly, the iPhone camera lens protector will not interfere with your image. So, while installing, check that there is no dust or lint on the lens. Also, handle the lens protector with care, so it doesn't get severe scratches.

mainEntity.name: Are iPhone camera lens protectors worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many claim that lens protectors are not essential since the iPhone's rear cameras are made of sapphire. It is robust and difficult to scratch. So, lens protectors are only for extra caution and decoration of your iPhone.

title.rendered: Best HomeKit-compatible smart switches in 2026

content.rendered:
A smart switch offers several useful features over a normal switch. For those already invested in Apple’s ecosystem, HomeKit-compatible smart switches should be perfect. Your Apple devices can control a HomeKit-compatible smart switch, create automations for turning it on and off, and much more once connected.

Here’s a quick round-up of the best HomeKit-compatible smart switches you can buy if you’re interested in integrating your smart home with your Apple devices. Let’s begin!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Lutron Caseta Smart Dimmer Switch – Control your ambience
  • 2. TP-Link Kasa Smart Dimmer Switch – Simple yet functional
  • 3. Meross 3-way Smart Light Switch – Affordable smart switch
  • 4. Eve Light Switch – Elegant capacitive touch
  • 5. Wemo Smart Light Switch – Value for money
    • Wrapping up…
    • Read more:

1. Lutron Caseta Smart Dimmer Switch – Control your ambience

The Lutron Caseta Smart Dimmer Switch is undoubtedly the best HomeKit-compatible smart switch available out there. It combines a classic switch with modern technology to offer both on/off and dimming capabilities, so you can have complete control over your smart home’s lighting ambiance. It is also compatible with three-way light setups using Lutron’s Pico remote.

While Lutron Caseta Smart Switches must be paired with an external hub, everything operates at a 431 MHz radio frequency, so it doesn’t burden your Wi-Fi network. This ensures a smooth and uninterrupted performance that isn’t hindered by network congestion. The switch’s remarkable transmission distance allows it to communicate effortlessly, even through multiple walls.

Installing the Lutron Caseta Smart Dimmer Switch is simple and easy. Unlike other smart switches, it doesn’t require a neutral wire, making it compatible with a variety of home wiring setups. Moreover, these switches come with a handy feature that can be used to cut off power when installing light bulbs.

Apart from HomeKit, the Lutron Caseta Smart Switches are also compatible with a variety of other smart home platforms like Alexa, Google Home, iFTTT, and more. This allows you to control your lights using your voice, even if you are not invested in the HomeKit ecosystem. Moreover, these smart switches also work with Lutron’s official app, so you can control your lights remotely.

Pros

  • Doesn’t require a neutral wire
  • Offers extensive compatibility

Cons

  • Requires an external hub
  • They are a bit pricey

Check out on Amazon

2. TP-Link Kasa Smart Dimmer Switch – Simple yet functional

TP-Link Kasa Smart Dimmer switches should be the ideal choice if you want something budget-friendly. They work with HomeKit and feature an on-off indicator as well as a series of brightness indicators that glow through the switch plate. You can simply tap the switch to toggle your lights on or off and increase or decrease the brightness by pressing the smaller buttons.

The TP-Link Kasa Smart Dimmer switches are easy to set up, don’t require a hub, and also offer a two-year warranty. What’s even better is that you can enable its dedicated away mode, which randomly toggles the lights on to give the appearance of someone’s home and fend off potential intruders.

Even though TP-Link does offer a 3-way variant of its smart dimmer switch, they are unfortunately not compatible with HomeKit. However, if you want something simple yet functional, TP-Link has a cheaper option that offers HomeKit support without the ability to increase or decrease the brightness.

Pros

  • Budget-friendly
  • Doesn’t require a hub

Cons

  • Requires a neutral wire
  • 3-way option not available

Check out on Amazon

3. Meross 3-way Smart Light Switch – Affordable smart switch

The Meross 3-way Smart Switches are a great option for anyone looking to add additional capabilities to their smart home setup without breaking the bank. Although they are cheaper than the alternatives, they are responsive and work with a variety of voice assistants, making them a versatile option.

Meross 3-way smart switches offer an effortless installation with labels that can be used to mark wires. Moreover, they work over a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network without any kind of external hub. The only downside of the Meross 3-way smart switch, which came up during my research, is that they need a neutral wire.

In a nutshell, the Meross 3-way Smart Switches deliver exceptional value for their price. They’re easy to install and work with a variety of voice assistants. If you’re on the lookout for good smart switches that won’t break the bank, I highly recommend the Meross 3-way Smart Light Switch. Additionally, if you need more control, Meross even sells smart switches with built-in dimmers.

Pros

  • Quick and simple installation
  • Supports 3-way wiring

Cons

  • Mediocre build quality
  • Requires a neutral wire

Check out on Amazon

4. Eve Light Switch – Elegant capacitive touch

Unlike most other smart switches available out there, the Eve Smart Switch boasts a sleek capacitive touch surface on its front. Thanks to this unique touch interface, you can simply tap the Eve light switch to turn your lights on or off or double-tap to activate a scene. Moreover, the Eve light switch makes a satisfying clicking sound whenever you tap its capacitive surface.

There is more to Eve’s attention to detail than its sleek appearance. It’s possible to customize the LED status light or upgrade software using Eve’s companion app, which works alongside the Home app.

It is possible to set schedules directly on the switch using the app, making it possible for autonomous operation without a stable internet connection.

The Eve Light Switch supports the Thread architecture that works with Apple HomeKit to enable a responsive experience. In addition to that, the Eve light switch is set to receive support for the Matter ecosystem later this year via a software update, making it compatible with more smart home platforms.

Overall, the Eve light switch is a great choice for anyone looking for a stylish, affordable, and easy-to-install smart switch that works without any kind of external hub and fits seamlessly into both single-pole or three-way circuits.

Pros

  • Minimalistic design
  • Supports 3-way wiring

Cons

  • Only works with Homekit
  • Requires a neutral wire

Check out on Amazon

5. Wemo Smart Light Switch – Value for money

The Wemo 3-Way Smart Light Switch offers a breath of fresh air for those who may be hesitant about diving into the smart home universe. With its comprehensive installation guide and clearly labeled components, setting up this switch is straightforward. Whether you’re dealing with a single pole or a three-way system, this smart switch fits snugly into your existing setup.

The Wemo Smart Light Switch supports Thread connectivity which enables a responsive experience without needing an external hub. Apart from that, these switches feature a minimalistic design along with an LED indicator on the front, which can be handy if you ever need to access them in the dark.

They work with a wide range of smart home ecosystems, including Apple HomeKit, Amazon Alexa, and Google Assistant, so you can use them with your existing devices. The Wemo app makes it easy to control your lights from anywhere. You can create custom automations and group multiple Wemo products so you can manage multiple rooms with just a long press.

Wemo smart light switches offer great value for money. They are easy to install and use, and they work with a variety of smart home ecosystems. If you are looking for reliable HomeKit-compatible smart switches for your smart home, Wemo’s 3-way smart light switches are an excellent option.

Pros

  • Offers support for Thread
  • Option to group switches

Cons

  • Requires neutral wire
  • They are a bit pricey

Check out on Amazon

Wrapping up…

Whether you’re looking for a smart switch that supports 3-way operation or lets you adjust the brightness of your lights, the HomeKit-compatible smart switches that I’ve listed above should suffice. If you found this guide useful, do let us know which smart switch you prefer in the comments below.

title.rendered: Best camera lens protectors for iPhone 14 Pro Max in 2026

content.rendered:
The camera lens peeks out from the frame more and more on every new iPhone. Due to the familiar design of the iPhone 14 Pro and 14 Max, third-party manufacturers are working on solutions to prevent scratches.  

If you are buying a new iPhone and are concerned about the camera bump, we have got you covered. Here are some strong and stylish camera protectors that will keep worries at bay. 

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen optik pro – Editor's choice
  • 2. QHOHQ lens protector – UHD protection
  • 3. CASETiFY – The tough one
  • 4. Ailun – Budget-friendly camera lens protector
  • 5. UniqueMe lens protector – Metal guard
  • 6. Ferilinso – Unbreakable lens protector
  • 7. Goton – The stylish protection
  • 8. Tough On – The bodyguard
  • 9. Tensea lens protectors – The dazzler

1. Spigen optik pro – Editor’s choice

This camera lens protector is made with 9H-hardness tempered glass, which also comes with an EZ fit tray that helps you install the camera lens on top of your camera bump. This protector comes in two pieces and features an Oleophobic coating to protect it from getting smudges and print. Also, this is compatible with all sorts of Spigen cases.

Since Spigen is a well-known and trustworthy brand, you can be sure about its quality. Also, because the brand provides more than just one piece in one pack, you’ll have a spare that you can keep for yourself or share with a friend.

Pros

  • Precise cuts
  • Comes with an installation guide

Cons

  • A bit costly

Check out on Amazon

2. QHOHQ lens protector – UHD protection

This pack comes with a remover tool that can clean the lens protector without damaging the phone lens, and the installation of this protector is all about overlapping the noise reduction holes and lens slots.

This lens protector features a 2.5D curved design and smooth edges, so it bumps less off the already peaking camera setup. It feels edgeless and almost invisible to the naked eye; also, it doesn’t create any bulk or sharp edge for the user.

Pros

  • Clear protector 
  • Comes with a removal tool

Cons

  • No installation guide
  • Too thin  

Check out on Amazon

3. CASETiFY – The tough one

This high-quality, eco-friendly lens protector ensures your camera’s safety. Their easy-to-apply camera lens cover comes with an anti-fingerprint guard, so you’ll never see a smudge on your photo. The small black camera hole also detects the flashlight from all angles, thus preventing blurry photos. 

The anti-fingerprint lens is made from 50% of recycled materials, which is a great step in the direction of sustainability.

Pros

  • Eco-friendly
  • Carbon neutral company 

Cons

  • Multiple coating might affect the clarity   

Check out on CASETiFY

4. Ailun – Budget-friendly camera lens protector

This lens protector provides you peace of mind and added security within your budget. When the flash is turned on at night, the original quality of photos and videos will be retained. You can easily install the lens protector by watching the video they have provided in the product description.

99.99% clear hydrophobic and oleophobic screen coating protects against moisture and oil residue from fingerprints. That ensures no matter how many times your fingerprint touches the camera lens, it stays smudge-free and stain-free.

Pros

  • Budget segment
  • Multiple quantities  
  • Carbon neutral company 

Cons

  • Cheaper build quality

Check out on Amazon

5. UniqueMe lens protector – Metal guard

The UniqueMe lens protector is made from metal 9H tempered glass to protect your rear camera lens. A tempered glass protection hole with a non-glare coating leaves your lens clarity intact for high-quality night mode outputs. It perfectly matches your brand-new iPhone’s colors with its matte texture.  

The no-glare coating helps you to take better night mode pictures than usual. UniqueMe provides permanent maintenance to your purchase, which also shows how confident they are about the product and its quality.

Pros

  • Metal contraption
  • Decorative

Cons

  • Too fleshy for some

Check out on Amazon 

6. Ferilinso – Unbreakable lens protector

This camera lens protector is a superb value-for-money addition to your iPhone. For under $10, you get six lens protectors. Additionally, the precise cutting provides maximum protection to the whole camera deck of your iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 14 Pro Max.

The 9H glass camera protector effectively saves the lens from drops, scratches, and other accidents. Offer full protection and double security. The pack of this protector also includes a cleaning kit.

Pros

  • Precise lens cutting
  • Snug fit 

Cons

  • Poor adhesive

Check out on Amazon

7. Goton – The stylish protection

These nano-electrostatic HD tempered glass aluminum alloy camera protectors are bubble-free protectors. This laser-cut lens protector gives a personality that no other lens protectors can. The quality of the adhesive is such that you can cleanly remove the lens without any residue on the back.

If you have issues with the product, you can contact the makers via email. Their quick response is what impressed me the most.

Because of its flashy design, it might attract more female audiences than usual. It also can add charm to their beauty and flair to their style. It is more focused on the fashion-centric audience.

Pros

  • Flashy design
  • Multicolor
  • Great after-sales services  

Cons

  • Diamonds might come off

Check out on Amazon

8. Tough On – The bodyguard

The aviation aluminum metal ring and 9H tempered glass camera protector protect your camera lens from scratches and damage. The seal ring keeps dust and water out. Additionally, the spiral pattern creates stunning reflections. With its multicolor design, the lens protector ring fits your style. 

The aluminum build of these rings gives them an aesthetically pleasing and premium look to it. And as our iPhone is also built from the aluminum casing, it gives it a flush design language.

Pros

  • Aluminum build
  • Lightweight  

Cons

  • Color fades with time 

Check out on Tough On

9. Tensea lens protectors – The dazzler

Tensea rear rhinestone camera lens protector made of aviation aluminum and 9H tempered glass is designed for iPhone. This glass protector ensures that there are no bubbles, is case-friendly, and leaves no residue once removed. Along with that, the diamonds on its outer ring make your camera lens shine.

Pros

  • Customized design 
  • Lightweight  

Cons

  • The studs might fall off

Check out on Amazon

Conclusion

While iPhones are pretty sturdy and strong, it’s always better to keep them protected. While there are tons of accessories for the screen and the back, there are fewer options for the camera lens. I hope my curated list helps you make a purchase decision.

Our favorite Amazon finds:

  • Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Qi2 15W Charging Station
  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

title.rendered: 20 Useful iPhone Calendar App Tips and Tricks

content.rendered:
The Calendar app on your iPhone isn’t just an app; it’s a personal assistant in your pocket. Starting with iOS 18, Apple has enhanced the Calendar app by fully integrating reminders, allowing you to create, edit, and view reminders without leaving the app. This refreshed version of the Calendar app lets you schedule events and delegate your calendar to others. It also simplifies task management by letting you handle reminders directly within the app.

So, if you have been using the Calendar app only to check the day’s date, you’re missing out on a lot. Thus, to help you out, we have compiled this list of tips and tricks that you can use to truly master the iPhone’s Calendar app.

Table of Contents
  1. Use the redesigned calendar view
  2. Set up reminders in the Calendar app
  3. 3. Schedule events from posters
  4. Change the default calendar account
  5. Edit up reminders in the Calendar app
  6. Create reminders and set alerts
  7. Select your preferred calendar view
  8. Create or add a new calendar
  9. Control when you want to start the week
  10. Open or share files before a meeting
  11. Let Siri add events from other apps
  12. Drag and drop an event to organize your schedule
  13. Copy and paste events
  14. Maximize Siri
  15. Delegate your calendar to others
  16. Access your calendar through any device
  17. Add a travel time
  18. Sync events with CarPlay
  19. Show or hide individual calendars and all-day events
  20. Add your contacts’ birthdays

1. Use the redesigned calendar view

The Calendar app already has multiple ways to view your days, weeks, and months. However, iOS 18 took this a step further by adding four more views showing each day’s event details. A new button in the app lets you switch between Compact, Stacked, Details, and List views for the unknowns.

  • The Compact view, as the name suggests, lets you view the monthly calendar along with the reminders and events below each day in a compact way. The different colored lines below a day represent the number of events or reminders you have.
  • The Stacked view enlarges the calendar view a bit and showcases your events and reminders in a stacked view below the particular date. All the events and reminders are compressed into a single, multicolor line. The more the number of events you have, the more color lines you’ll have underneath the date.
  • The Details view, on the other hand, gives you complete information about the day’s events and reminders with different colors and names.
  • The List view is like the miniature version of the compact view; however, taping on a particular day shows more information about your upcoming events and reminders for the specific day only, unlike other view options where you can find information about the days.

2. Set up reminders in the Calendar app

Earlier, you could only create events in the Calendar app; however, with iOS 18 installed on your iPhone, you can create scheduled reminders right within the Calendar app. This true integration of the Reminders app into the Calendar app makes it easy to separate events from tasks and keep your tasks synced to the Reminders app.

Here’s how you can create a reminder in the Calendar app:

  1. Open the Calendar app and tap the + button at the top right corner.
  2. Here, tap on Reminder.
  3. Next, enter the necessary details and hit the Add button at the top right corner.

The created scheduled reminder can be viewed in both the Calendar and Reminders app.

3. Schedule events from posters

Did you know your iPhone can now detect event details from posters and automatically create calendar entries? With iOS 18.3, Apple has enhanced Visual Intelligence to recognize dates, times, and locations from images. If you come across an event flyer or concert poster, simply point your camera towards it and long-press the Camera Control button. Now, tap Create Event > Schedule to instantly add it to your Calendar app.

I regularly use this feature to schedule events quickly without manually typing the details. Want to know more about hidden gems like this? Check out our guide to hidden iOS 18.3 features for more iPhone tricks.

4. Change the default calendar account

If you use multiple calendars, setting the correct default account can save you a lot of time and confusion. In iOS 18, this process is even smoother.

How to set up:

  1. Open Settings, scroll down and tap on Apps.
  2. Here, locate and tap on Calendar.
  3. Next, tap on Default Calendar.
  4. Select the calendar you want all new events to default to, such as your personal or work calendar.

Pro Tip Choose a calendar that aligns with your primary focus (e.g., work or family) to streamline event creation.

5. Edit up reminders in the Calendar app

You can create and edit reminders within the Calendar app, eliminating the need to shuffle around different apps. You can mark reminders as complete, reschedule, or edit all the details. Any changes you make to a reminder in the Calendar app are automatically reflected in the Reminders app.

6. Create reminders and set alerts

Adding your following appointments and schedules is one thing, but it’s useless if you don’t look at them. Setting alerts and reminders ensures that your iPhone reminds you of an upcoming event a week or a few days before. 

First, you’ll have to create an event if you haven’t done so yet.

  1. Open the Calendar app.
  2. Tap the Add (+) button at the upper right
  3. Add a title to your event.
  4. Then scroll down and tap Alert.

  5. Select from the options from 1 week before to At the time of the event.
  6. Select Add.

If you’re the forgetful type, you can add another alert by tapping the event → Edit. Select Second Alert and choose a time for the alert.

You can also set up a default alert time for all your appointments instead of wasting precious time setting up an alert every time you create a new event. To do this:

  1. Head to Settings → Apps.
  2. Select Calendar.
  3. Scroll down to Default Alert Times.
  4. Set up default alert times for Birthdays, Events, and All-Day Events.

7. Select your preferred calendar view

There are different ways to view your calendar — from a general year view to a more detailed day view.

  • Yearly view: To view the entire year, just tap the month at the top left of the calendar to zoom out to the year. You can swipe up and down to see the previous and future years ahead.
  • Monthly view: From the year view, tap a month to switch to a monthly view. A monthly view lets you view days with schedules — symbolized by grey dots under them. You can also swipe up and down to view other months. 
  • Weekly view: To see an overview of your weekly schedule, turn your screen sideways and view your calendar. This format will also show hourly breakdowns for each day.
  • Day view: Tap Today to see your day’s hour-by-hour schedule. Tap another day or swipe sideways to see your schedule for a different day.
  • Tap the List button on top of the screen beside the Search button to see all your upcoming schedules for the day in a list. 
  • You can always head back to the present day by tapping Today at the bottom of the screen.

8. Create or add a new calendar

Managing multiple aspects of your life on a single calendar can be perplexing. With Apple Calendar, you can create separate calendars to have a dedicated calendar for your work, personal life, and much more.

For example, if you have multiple projects, having a calendar for each one can help you manage your schedules and commitments more efficiently and prevent overlap. 

It’s also color-coded, so you’d know at a glance where the event of schedule plotted in your calendar belongs. 

To create a new one:

  1. Open the Calendar app → Tap Add Calendar at the bottom.
  2. Tap Add Calendar on the popup menu. Choose any of the following:

    • Add Calendar: You’ll need to input a calendar name, the email address you want to use, and the color you want to assign for the calendar.
    • Add Subscription Calendar: You’ll need to enter the link to the calendar you want to subscribe to. Subscription Calendars are read-only data feeds that keep you updated on events as the data provider updates them.
    • Add Holiday Calendar: Choose the country you want to add to their holiday to your calendar.

9. Control when you want to start the week

For some, the week starts on a Sunday, while others begin their week on a Monday. The iPhone Calendar starts the week on a Sunday by default, but you can choose a different day.

To do this:

  1. Go to Settings → Apps → Calendar.
  2. Scroll down and tap Start Week On → select the day you prefer.

10. Open or share files before a meeting

You can add attachments to your calendar invite to easily access or share them with your invitees. 

  1. Go to your event.
    In any Calendar view, tap on a particular day to see the events for the same.
  2. Tap Edit → Add Attachment.
  3. Locate the file you want to add. Use the search bar or the Browse tab to look for it in other locations.

  4. Tap Done.

To remove the attachment from the event, just go to the event, tap Edit, then swipe left over the attachment and select Remove.

11. Let Siri add events from other apps

Siri can also check your activity from other apps like Messages, Mail, and Safari to update your calendar with other events, such as an online meeting sent through your email, a hotel booking, or a flight reservation. 

To let Siri do this:

  1. Go to Settings → Apps → Calendar.
  2. Select Apple Intelligence & Siri.
  3. Turn on Show in App.

This enables Siri to suggest events it finds in other apps. 

12. Drag and drop an event to organize your schedule

The Calendar list view not only lets you see your daily schedule’s overview, but it also allows you to quickly organize and move your schedule to another day.

You can do this in your weekly or daily view by selecting an event and dragging it to another time slot. 

13. Copy and paste events

If an event is recurring, you can easily copy and paste it into your calendar. Just touch and hold the event and select Copy.

  1. Tap and hold the timeslot where you want to paste the event. This will create a new event.
  2. The copied event will appear below the Title, along with other details. Tap it and select Add.

14. Maximize Siri

You can also use Siri, the trusted Apple digital assistant, to create events in the Calendar for you. Just say, “Hey Siri, create a new event in my Calendar,” and fill it out with all the details. 

If you want to change an event, just say something like, “Can you change an event in my schedule on [date]?” Select the event you want to edit and inform Siri of the changes you want to make.

15. Delegate your calendar to others

Another great Calendar feature is the ability to delegate your calendar to others. You can let an assistant or a family member manage your schedule, including adding, editing, responding to, and deleting invites. To do this:

  1. Open the Calendar app → Choose Calendars at the bottom.
  2. Tap the info (i) button beside the calendar you want to share.
  3. Select Add Person.

  4. Enter the email address of the person.
  5. Tap Add. 
  6. Tap View & Edit beside the person’s name and toggle Allow Editing. Don’t toggle it if you only want to share a read-only view of your schedule.

If the person didn’t receive your invitation to share your calendar, tap Resend Sharing Invitation. You can cancel sharing anytime by tapping Stop Sharing.

Note that you’ll receive notifications and alerts whenever the person you gave editing privileges adds, edits, or modifies your calendar. You can toggle off Show Changes to turn off alerts and notifications about the shared calendar.

16. Access your calendar through any device

Placing all your schedules in the Calendar ensures you can easily access them when needed — except when you leave your iPhone behind. Don’t worry, though; you have the option to sync your Calendar across your Apple devices.

This feature is turned on by default, but if you turned this off in the past, then:

  1. Go to the Settings app → iCloud.

  2. Tap Show All → Toggle on Calendars.

Because it’s synced with your iCloud, you can go anytime to iCloud.com to access your calendar there. 

17. Add a travel time

Adding appointments to our calendars helps ensure we don’t miss them. However, this doesn’t take into account factors like traffic jams and location. With Calendar, your iPhone will automatically notify you when it’s time to leave based on where you’re coming from and where you’re going. 

Once done creating your event, tap Edit → select Travel Time. If you entered a location in the event, enter your starting location. If not, you can choose as little as 5 minutes to two hours as leeway for your transit to your scheduled event.

18. Sync events with CarPlay

Surprised? Don’t be. If you’re using Apple CarPlay, you can also see upcoming calendar events on your dash.

This can also display directions to the location if you’ve added an address to the event. 

19. Show or hide individual calendars and all-day events

A cluttered calendar is counterproductive and can be a nuisance instead of helping you organize your life. That said, you have the option to view and hide individual calendars as well as all-day events.

20. Add your contacts’ birthdays

Are you the type who forgets birthdays? Then worry no more! Just input your contacts’ birthdays in their contact information and set a birthday reminder in the Calendar to receive a reminder on their birthday.

  1. First, head to Contacts.
  2. Tap a contact → Edit.
  3. Scroll down and select (+) add birthday → Tap Done.

  4. Then open Calendar.
  5. Tap Calendars → Tick Birthdays → Select Done.

Here’s a more comprehensive guide on viewing birthdays on Calendar.

Wrapping up…

With continuous advancements and new feature additions, the Calendar app on iOS 18 is more powerful and intuitive than ever. Whether you are planning an event or managing a hectic workday, the Calendar app on your iPhone has the tools to keep you on track.

What’s your favorite Calendar feature? Let us know in the comments below!

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

mainEntity.name: How do I troubleshoot if the Apple logo doesn't work on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the Apple logo appear on some devices or apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo is a proprietary symbol of the Apple company. So, it may not appear or be displayed correctly on non-Apple devices or unsupported apps. You might see the logo as a blank space or a different symbol.

mainEntity.name: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to delete messages or conversations?

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't delete messages on your Mac the regular way, you can use the Terminal app to force delete messages. Simply open the Terminal, enter the command: rm –r ~/Library/Messages/chat: and hit Return.

title.rendered: 5 Best USB-C to MagSafe 3 cables for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
If you’re using a modern MacBook, having a reliable USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable is essential. The cable offers a number of advantages over the traditional USB-C to USB-C cable, including faster charging speeds and easier detachment.

Apple’s new MacBooks come with USB-C to MagSafe 3 cables in the box; however, if you lose or damage the original, our list is a great resource! We have sifted through several Amazon listings and user reviews to list down the best USB-C to MagSafe 3 cables that you can buy for your MacBook.

1. Apple USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable – The OG

Apple’s original MagSafe 3 cable should be the first thing to come to your mind if you are looking for a MagSafe charging cable for your 14″ or 16″ MacBook Pro and M2 MacBook Air. It features a braided cable and a metallic MagSafe connector for durability. Moreover, the MagSafe connector has a LED that changes from amber to green once your MacBook is fully charged.

What’s even better is that it’s available in four colors, including Space Grey, Midnight, Starlight, and Silver. This way, you can easily choose a cable that matches your MacBook. You can also mix and match colors or get the Midnight option if you’re worried about the light-colored cables getting discolored over time.

This 2-meter-long MagSafe cable can be paired with a compatible USB-C power adapter to charge your Mac from a wall outlet conveniently. It offers up to 140 Watts of fast-charging capabilities and a magnetic connection that is strong enough to resist most unintended disconnects. However, if someone trips over the cable, it will release to keep your MacBook secure.

Pros

  • Available in four colors
  • It has the perfect amount of magnetic resistance

Cons

  • The USB-C connector could’ve been metallic.
  • It could’ve been cheaper.

Check out on: Apple | Amazon

2. AICARGER Magnetic 3 Cable – 140W fast-charging

Available at a great price, the AICARGER 140W USB-C to Magnetic 3 Cable works with all the latest models of M1 or M2 MacBooks and is one of the cheapest yet feature-packed MagSafe cables of the bunch. Unlike the other cables in this list, AICARGER USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable comes with a plastic header which helps keep the MagSafe connector cool to the touch.

The cable is 2 meters long, so you can have plenty of room to move around while using your MacBook. Meanwhile, the cable’s MagSafe connector helps minimize the likelihood of you tripping over it and damaging your MacBook.

Just like the original cable, it’s also braided, offers a LED indicator to display your MacBook’s charging status, and supports up to 140W of power delivery, allowing you to charge your MacBook quickly. The only downside about this cable is that its MagSafe connector is slightly wider, which might obstruct access to USB-C ports when using certain USB-C hubs with your MacBook.

Pros

  • Plastic Magsafe connector offers better insulation
  • Available in Black and White colors

Cons

  • The plastic MagSafe connector can be flimsy
  • Bigger connector obstructs access to USB-C ports

Check out on Amazon

3. Korllo MagSafe 3 charging cable – Durable and affordable

The Korllo USB-C to MagSafe 3 charging cable is a high-quality cable that is compatible with the latest MacBook Pro and MacBook Air models. This cable features a magnetic MagSafe 3 connector making it easy for you to connect or disconnect the cable while minimizing the risk of any mishaps.

The cable is braided with high-density nylon thread, which makes it more rugged and durable while adding to the aesthetic appeal. It also offers 140 Watts of fast-charging capability, which can quickly charge your MacBook.

Overall, the Korllo USB-C to MagSafe 3 Charging Cable is a great option for those who want a durable yet affordable charging cable for their MacBook.

Pros

  • Nylon braided cable offers extra durability
  • Supports up to 140 Watts of fast charging

Cons

  • The USB-C connector could’ve been metallic.
  • Bit costly for a third-party cable

Check out on Amazon

4. PonJel Magnetic 3 charging cable – Superior build quality

The PonJel USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable is a dependable charging solution designed specifically for MacBook users. It supports up to 140W of power delivery, making it ideal for charging the latest MacBook Pro models. The cable features strong magnets that securely hold the MagSafe connector in place. It even has a handy LED indicator that shows the charging status.

This cable works with a wide array of PD chargers with different wattages, including wall chargers, car chargers, and power banks. It has a length of 2 meters, providing ample flexibility for use while your MacBook is charging. Moreover, the cable is built to last so that it can withstand everyday use.

Overall, the PonJel charging cable is a great option for those looking for a reliable MagSafe charging cable for their MacBooks. It’s compatible with the latest MacBook Pro models and supports up to 140W power delivery. The cable also has reasonably strong magnets and offers an LED indicator.

Pros

  • Offers a LED indicator to display the charging status
  • Fits the MagSafe 3 port well

Cons

  • Fails to charge MacBook Air reliably

Check out on Amazon

5. Seynli MagSafe 3 Cable – Efficiency personified

For MacBook Pro and MacBook Air users who want quick charging, the Seynli USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable is a great choice. It supports up to 140W power delivery, so you can ensure that your MacBook charges quickly and safely.

The 2-meter cable is also very flexible and easy to connect and disconnect, thanks to the MagSafe connector.

The Seynli USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable has a durable braided design that is tangle-free and can withstand wear over time. It also has a safety feature to protect your MacBook from damage caused by incompatible chargers.

Overall, the Seynli USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable is a great option for MacBook users who want an economical yet high-quality charging solution. It’s fast, efficient, secure, and durable, and it comes with a 1-year warranty. If you’re looking for a new charging cable, I highly recommend giving this one a try.

Pros

  • Has overvoltage, overcurrent, and short-circuit protection
  • Offers one year warranty

Cons

  • There’s a slight delay before it can start charging
  • The magnets aren’t strong

Check out on Amazon

Wrapping up…

Whether you’re looking for a reliable USB-C to MagSafe 3 charging cable for your MacBook Pro or MacBook Air, the cables that I’ve mentioned above should suffice. If you found this guide useful, let us know which cable you purchased in the comments below.

FAQs

Which Mac models have a MagSafe 3 port?

As of writing this article, the M2 MacBook Air, 14-inch MacBook Pro (2021, 2023), and 16-inch MacBook Pro (2021, 2023) have MagSafe 3 ports.

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to type the Apple logo on a Windows PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

title.rendered: Best audio editing software for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
Do you have ambitions of becoming a musician? Or do you like to dabble in audio editing as a hobby? Either way, you’re probably in need of some excellent audio editors that can break new ground and expand your horizons. If this sounds like you, you’re going to love this list of the best audio editing software for Mac.

While other PCs can work well with these apps, the apps run efficiently on MacBooks. This is thanks to the superb computing power and software optimization that only Apple is known for. So, let’s dive into the list and check out these apps, shall we?

Table of Contents
  1. Logic Pro – Editor's Choice
  2. Audacity – Supports many file formats
  3. Adobe Audition – Great for podcasts
  4. WavePad – Decent free features
  5. RX Post Production Suite 7 – Best for professionals
  6. Fission – Can process audio in batches
  7. ocenaudio – Best for beginners
  8. GarageBand – Syncs with iCloud
  9. Reaper – Constantly improving

1. Logic Pro – Editor’s Choice

For professional music producers who use MacBook, there’s little reason to go beyond Logic Pro. This audio editing app is designed specifically for Mac. The proverbial saying “a match made in heaven” stands true for Logic Pro and your MacBook.

The app features all the tools that you’d need for audio editing. This includes, but isn’t limited to, tools for songwriting, editing, and mixing. Moreover, the app is relatively easy to use, thanks to a modern interface that works in tandem with the tools themselves. Apart from this, you’ll find samples, instruments, loops, and effects to experiment with for your song.

To put things into perspective, Logic Pro has over 5900 instrument and effect patches, 1200 instrument samples, and almost 15,000 loops designed by Apple. Overall, you can’t find a similar wholesome toolkit to edit your audio on Mac.

The only major con of this software is that it’s significantly expensive. Not everyone can afford to shell out close to $200 for the software.

Pros

  • Value for money
  • Thousands of effect patches, instrument samples, and Apple loops
  • Not too difficult to use

Cons

  • Relatively expensive

Price: $199.99

Download

2. Audacity – Supports many file formats

There’s no bigger disappointment than paying for an audio editing app to find out that it doesn’t support some file formats. Fortunately, with Audacity, you won’t have to worry about this issue. This audio editing software for Mac supports all the major file formats, as well as some of the less-used formats out there. Moreover, it’s free to use, open-source, and supports multiple PC platforms.

Another major advantage of Audacity is that it’s easy to use. Regardless of your level of expertise, Audacity ensures that audio mixing and editing become something that even a beginner can manage. Additionally, it doesn’t take up much storage space in your Mac. Furthermore, its open-source nature allows third-party integrations for your projects as well.

The only issue with Audacity is that you’ll have to work slightly harder to lay multiple tracks together.

Pros

  • Huge range of file format support
  • Very convenient to use
  • Takes up less storage space

Cons

  • Difficult to lay multiple tracks

Price: Free

Download

3. Adobe Audition – Great for podcasts

Adobe produces some of the best software suites you’ll find on the market today. However, Adobe Audition has become a favorite of audio engineers, streamers, and more specifically, podcasters. While there are plenty of other tools you can use as a podcaster, Adobe Audition’s all-rounder performance takes it to the top of the list.

This audio editing software for Mac has pretty much everything that you need. Whether you want to add a background score to your podcast intro or edit various podcast segments, Audition can cover it all.

Moreover, if you’ve been facing issues with background noise or white noise during your recording sessions, Adobe Audition’s audio clean-up tool is one of the best available today. Without a doubt, the best podcasts available today have used or still use Adobe Audition as their audio editing software!

However, I wouldn’t recommend this tool to beginners, as it can be quite difficult to use. Moreover, it works on a subscription service that can be expensive in the long run. Nonetheless, if you’re a podcaster and have money to spare, Adobe Audition is the way to go!

Pros

  • Great for editing podcasts
  • One of the best audio clean-up tools
  • Has the best premium features

Cons

  • The subscription model makes it expensive in the long run

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $31.49)

Download

4. WavePad – Decent free features

Free audio editing apps for Macs tend to hold all of their best features behind expensive paywalls. However, if you want a taste of premium audio editing without spending the big bucks, WavePad could be what you’re looking for. This app is completely free to use, with in-app purchases for other features.

In terms of audio file format support, WavePad provides support for multiple file types, such as AAC, AMR, GSM, OGG, MID, and M4A, to speak of a few. Apart from this, you can use effects such as echo, amplification, and noise reduction to edit your soundtracks. WavePad also features Audio Units which give its users access to thousands of different tools and effects.

Overall, this app is quite versatile and flexible in its usage and can be utilized for multiple different types of projects.

Pros

  • The free version has good features
  • Supports many file types
  • Audio units give access to thousands of effects

Cons

  • The premium version is quite expensive

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $99.99)

Download

5. RX Post Production Suite 7 – Best for professionals

If you’re a professional music producer and want the absolute best tool for audio editing on Mac, RX Post Production Suite 7 should be your first pick. This tool is only used by advanced users and audio editors who work on big-money projects. After all, this tool comes from the brilliant minds at iZotope, which has been leading the audio editing field for a few decades.

With the seventh iteration and update to the Production Suite, this audio editing software for Mac provides even more potent tools that take audio editing up by a notch. You’ll find tools such as RX Advanced, Neutron 4, Insight 2, and Nectar 3 Plus, among others. Combine them together, and you have pretty much everything that you need for post-production audio.

Moreover, all the tools that you’re using provide visual feedback. This gives you a decent idea of what you may need to change or where you’re going wrong. Basically, as a professional audio editor, there’s little else that you need.

However, this audio editing app is far too expensive for most people. Beginners will also have to face a steep learning curve when using the app’s tools.

Pros

  • One of the most comprehensive audio editing software for Mac
  • Excellent for post-production audio
  • Support for thousands of plugins

Cons

  • Steep learning curve
  • The premium version is priced exorbitantly

Price: $999

Download

6. Fission – Can process audio in batches

Sometimes, you’ll have to produce audio in bulk instead of working on intricate audio. In such cases, it can be challenging as most audio editing apps don’t allow batch processing of audio. However, Fission provides this capability and makes you work smarter, not harder.

You won’t find too many advanced tools in Fission. It’s a very simple piece of software designed to edit and create lossless audio. From cutting and trimming the audio to editing audio metadata, Fission provides the necessary tools for you to process audio easily. Nonetheless, it shines when you have to process plenty of audio files together and change them to various file formats, such as .aac, Apple Lossless, or even FLAC.

With Fission, what you see is what you get. This editing tool is designed to process audio faster and therefore lacks the more complex features you might see in other audio editing apps for Mac.

Pros

  • Convenient to use
  • Can process audio in bulk
  • Perfect for lossless audio editing and processing

Cons

  • Doesn’t have too many advanced features

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $35)

Download

7. ocenaudio – Best for beginners

From the advanced post-production process of RX Production Suite 7, we move to ocenaudio. This Mac audio editing app is perfect for beginners who want to understand the concept and nuances of audio editing. Furthermore, the editing app is free to use, thanks to its open-source nature.

The user interface for ocenaudio is very clean, with no complicated buttons or options to overwhelm the user. Despite this simplicity, the developers have ensured that there’s some element of modernity in the overall UI. Apart from this, you’ll find the basic audio editing tools, such as track cutting and the ability to preview effects in real-time.

You’ll also be able to work on large projects with this tool, as it can handle bigger files than most other editing apps. This is a nifty addition, considering others fail to handle files of multiple GBs. To sweeten the deal, ocenaudio also supports Virtual Studio Technology plugins.

In terms of disadvantages, you won’t be able to edit or process multiple tracks together. Considering the importance of this feature, advanced users may be disinterested in the app quite easily.

Pros

  • Perfect for beginner-level audio editing
  • Can handle large file sizes
  • Also supports VST plugins

Cons

  • Can’t process multiple tracks together

Price: Free

Download

8. GarageBand – Syncs with iCloud

For a completely free audio recording and editing tool on your Mac, GarageBand is a pretty decent option. Moreover, if you’re a beginner who wants to explore the world of audio editing, you can use GarageBand to start your journey.

Despite being a free app, it comes with all the necessary tools you require for audio editing. Moreover, it comes with a simple interface that doesn’t perplex users or create unnecessary complications. Along with this, beginners can make use of the visual EQ to understand the process better and rectify their mistakes.

Although it comes with a host of features, its biggest flex has to be the fact that it syncs with iCloud. You’ll be able to import or export all your songs directly through iCloud on GarageBand. Whether you want to experiment with a new song or want to save your remix, GarageBand’s iCloud integration is a boon.

However, since the app is free, users will find that plenty of top-tier features are missing from the audio editing software.

Pros

  • Decent option for beginners
  • Completely free to use
  • Syncs with iCloud to import or export data

Cons

  • Doesn’t have most of the advanced features

Price: Free

Download

9. Reaper – Constantly improving

Most audio editing apps for Mac scarcely release updates. They add new features to a new version and charge the full cost. However, with Reaper, you won’t have to worry about this issue. Reaper is one of the most advanced music editing software out there. For a one-time cost, you’ll get plenty of the premium features that you’d find in the more expensive editing apps.

For example, Reaper is so tightly coded that you’ll be able to install it from anywhere – whether that’s directly from the cloud or through a portable drive. Moreover, it supports all the bit depths and sample rates imaginable. If that’s not enough, Reaper also supports thousands of third-party plugins for virtual instruments.

Nonetheless, what truly sets Reaper apart from the competition is its constant updates. You’ll frequently receive updates from Reaper after the full purchase. These updates will contain bug fixes, interface improvements, and even new features. The best part? These updates are frequent and FREE.

My only gripe with Reaper would be that it has a steep learning curve. Beginners will find it quite complex to use.

Pros

  • Constantly adds new features, improvements, and fixes
  • Provides support for third-party plugins
  • Has plenty of top-tier features

Cons

  • Not the easiest tool to use for beginners

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $60)

Download

Summing up

If you want to edit your audio to produce a few masterpieces, you’re going to need the right tools for the job. With this list of the best audio editing software for Mac, you’ll reach a few steps closer to your goal. I’ve covered these apps based on varied use cases. If you have any recommendations, let me know in the comment section below. I’ll be sure to check them out!

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.
