title.rendered: Best HomePod Coasters, Bases, and Mats in 2026

content.rendered:
When your intelligent gadgets begin to grab your guests’ attention at home, you feel satisfied for a moment. But little did you know that sometimes those devices left their nasty marks on the glass or wooden surface. A case in point is Apple’s HomePod, a silicone base that leaves rings on surfaces. So having HomePod bases, mats, and coasters could be a perfect solution to avoid those ugly stains on your tabletops.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Pad & Quill Leather HomePod Coaster
  • 2. KIWI Design Aluminum Alloy Coaster Holder for HomePod
  • 3. LuckyNV Natural Leather Waterproof HomePod Mat
  • 4. CIRCLE TECH Aluminum Alloy HomePod Coaster
  • 5. LANMU Silicone Anti-Slip Pad for HomePod
  • 6. Casa Bellante Leather Coaster for HomePod

1. Pad & Quill Leather HomePod Coaster

Pad & Quill is known to manufacture luxurious Apple accessories. This leather HomePod coaster is the best surface protector for you. Pad & Quill has used American full grain leather to manufacture this state-of-the-art surface protection for HomePod. This ultra-soft leather mat is available in three beautiful colors: whiskey, chestnut, and galloper black.

Marine grade stitching of leather base imparts exquisite finesse to this product. Pad & Quill has achieved new heights in minimalist arts by crafting this surface protection for HomePod.

USP: Marine grade stitching

2. KIWI Design Aluminum Alloy Coaster Holder for HomePod

KIWI Design has crafted a durable HomePod coaster from aluminum. The material is strong enough to protect your smart speaker; the design of this coaster will never destroy your HomePod. You can install this coaster anywhere in your house – kitchen, bathroom or bedroom.

Design of this aluminum coaster is simple, and therefore it creates a remarkable sophistication in your living room. A mixture of stainless steel and aluminum alloy ensures that your HomePod does not roll down from the flat surface.

USP: Flexible and durable
Check out on Amazon

3. LuckyNV Natural Leather Waterproof HomePod Mat

A leather mat for your Apple HomePod is a beautiful home décor piece. Enhance your home and office’s aesthetic elements by placing your smart speaker on the mat, which is made of natural leather. This waterproof mat is one of the best accessories for your intelligent speaker.

LuckyNV has crafted this mat from cowhide material, which protects the sound. Anti-knock quality of this leather mat keeps damage at bay. You can use your HomePod without any worry.

USP: Cowhide material
Check out on Amazon

4. CIRCLE TECH Aluminum Alloy HomePod Coaster

Sporting a compact form-factor, Circle is worth considering for three reasons. First and foremost, the stand is made of high-grade aluminum alloy which endows durability while also giving it a modern look.

The second, it fits HomePod pretty well and also resists vibrations. And with the anti-slip pad, it remains steady on any surface. As for price, Circle coaster is a bit expensive at $21.88. But considering the specs, it’s overall a good deal.

USP: High-grade aluminum alloy construction
Check out on Amazon

5. LANMU Silicone Anti-Slip Pad for HomePod

Featuring a soft and scratch-resistant design, LANMU can offer the needed care to your HomePod. For one, the pad is made of silicone material and is fully capable of absorbing vibrations. Thus, it shields the smart speaker against scuffs and ensures the pure sound is not compromised.

The coaster sports a flat rubber base so that the speaker can fit snuggly. Another feature worth noting is that it also doesn’t leave behind any white rings on wooden furniture. Lastly, LANMU comes at $7.99 for one pack and $12.99 for a two-pack, making it one of the cheapest coasters for HomePod.

USP: Flat rubberized base
Check out on Amazon

6. Casa Bellante Leather Coaster for HomePod

Another HomePod coaster made of genuine leather. This time it is from Casa Bellante, which has manufactured state-of-the-art coaster. Casa Bellante has used 100% genuine leather to produce an ultra-soft coaster with artisan signature.

Casa Bellante has deliberately kept a low profile to highlight the modern design of the coaster. You will get a set of two coasters for your Apple HomePod.

USP: Ultra-soft leather
Check out on Amazon

That’s it!

Signing off…

HomePod mats or coasters are one of the essential accessories for your smart speaker. Since you invest a lot of money in your smart speaker, you need to protect the device from every side. Aside from covers and mounts, HomePod bases should be on the top of your list.

You may also like to explore:

  • Best Accessories for HomePod and HomePod Mini
  • How to use HomePod and HomePod Mini with Mac
  • HomePod mini 2: Everything We Know So Far

Which HomePod base would you like the most? Do share your feedback in comment section.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

mainEntity.name: What is the font for the Apple logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Apple logo isn't a character in any specific font. Instead, it is a special symbol embedded in Apple's operating systems.

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Windows doesn't have a built-in way to type the Apple logo. However, you can copy and paste it from the internet. Alternatively, you can type the Apple logo into a Microsoft Word document. Set the font as Baskerville Old Face and type F000. This will activate the Character Map function. Now, press the Alt and X keys together to insert the Apple logo.

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensure you're using an Apple device or app that supports the logo emoji. Then, check the Text Replacement shortcut you made. You may delete it and create the shortcut again. If the issue persists, restart your device.

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

title.rendered: Best MagSafe stands for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
MagSafe continues to be Apple lovers’ favorite part of the ecosystem. One of them is the MagSafe stands for iPhone, whose popularity has skyrocketed with iOS 17’s StandBy mode.   

These sleek, magnetic add-ons bring seamless charging, convenience, and ergonomic brilliance to your work desks. Here, I’ve shared some of the best MagSafe stands that excel in design, performance, and utility.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen Mag Fit S MagSafe stand – Editor's Choice
  • 2. ESR wireless charger with Kickstand – Travel buddy
  • 3. Anker PowerWave 2-in-1 Magnetic Stand Lite – Compact
  • 4. Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 Charging Stand
  • 5. UGREEN 2-in-1 MagSafe charging stand – Tabletop friend
  • 6. Anker 622 Magnetic Battery (MagGo) – Everyday essential
  • 7. Twelve South HiRise 3 MagSafe stand – Charge two iPhones
  • 8. Rueseio 3-in-1 MagSafe stand – Safe charging

1. Spigen Mag Fit S MagSafe stand – Editor’s Choice

If you already have a MagSafe wireless charger and want to juice your iPhone while in FaceTime, streaming, or StandBy mode, get a Spigen Mag Fit charger stand. This flexible stand features a sleek, lightweight, and compact aluminum build.

In addition, the grip pads and Nanotec technology ensure the stand sits firmly when placed on flat surfaces. The foldable mounting system lets you place your iPhone in different viewing angles. You can put your iPhone in portrait or landscape orientation with a single adjustment.

If you use StandBy mode regularly, you will love the ease this stand will bring in using this feature. Also, you can add these StandBy widgets for a more seamless experience. Besides, the Mag Fit S stand is designed exclusively for MagSafe chargers.

Once you attach your wireless charger to the stand, you can enjoy uninterrupted charging for the iPhone. Also, you can adjust the stand to power your AirPods. Plus, you can fold the stand and keep it in your bag during travel.  

Pros

  • Steady aluminum frame  
  • Can charge AirPods  
  • Foldable for multiple views 

Cons

  • Adjustment issues with camera bump 

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR wireless charger with Kickstand – Travel buddy 

I won’t exaggerate when I say this MagSafe charger from ESR is a revolution. Why? The credit goes to its smart design, which comprises a compact circular frame with a built-in kickstand.

This on-demand kickstand pops out, enabling you to place your iPhone anywhere and enjoy StandBy mode during charging. With a lightweight aluminum frame, the ESR wireless charger makes it easy to carry around in your backpack or even handbag.

In addition, the product features advanced heat management technology that promises full charge in as little as 2.5 hours. Further, the ESR kickstand charger comes with a 5ft long USB-C cable. So you can move around while charging your iPhone.  

Pros

  • On-demand kickstand 
  • Handy and portable 
  • Innovative heat management  

Cons

  • Overheating issue 
  • Less durable 

Check out on Amazon

3. Anker PowerWave 2-in-1 Magnetic Stand Lite – Compact

The Anker PowerWave MagSafe charging stand perfectly balances style and performance. Where the snap-on pad aligned on the stem charges your iPhone, the base powers up your case-enclosed AirPods.

The solid design and steady magnetic connection hold your devices firmly, ensuring efficient charging. Promising ease of use, the charging stand has LEDs on the charging base displaying the charging status.

The white light shows active charging, while the flashing white indicates interruptions. In addition, you will also get a 5ft long USB-C charging cable for easy connectivity.  

The PowerWave MagSafe stand supports landscape viewing positions, perfect for enabling the StandBy mode on your iPhone. Moreover, you can customize the viewing angle up to 40 degrees and enjoy the best streaming experience.

Pros

  • Custom set viewing angle up to 40° 
  • LEDs showing charge status 
  • Strong magnets  
  • Slim and lightweight build 

Cons

  • Expensive  

Check out on Amazon

4. Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 Charging Stand 

Can’t manage simultaneous charging of your Apple Trinity? No worries, the Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 charging stand is your savior. This power beast provides optimized charging support for the iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods.   

The stand features a T-shape and offers fast charging of up to 15W for iPhone 12 and up models. The 33% fast charging support is also available for Apple Watch Series 7 and subsequent variants.

Besides, the perfectly aligned magnets provide quick and efficient charging anywhere and anytime. In addition, the smart architectural design of the Belkin 3-in-1 charging stand is ideal for resting your iPhone in different orientations.

You can freely attend FaceTime calls in portrait mode and use StandBy in landscape. Plus, it doesn’t consume enough space, making it ideal to place on bedside desks, coffee tables, and corners.  

Pros

  • Charges 3 devices at once 
  • Smart design  
  • Ideal for StandBy mode 
  • Fast charging for iPhone and Apple Watch 

Cons

  • A bit expensive

Check out on Amazon

5. UGREEN 2-in-1 MagSafe charging stand – Tabletop friend

If you plan to add a new charging accessory to your collection, you cannot miss UGREEN’s 2-in-1 charging station. The charger features a solid magnetic lock system comprising 8 N52H magnets, giving 700g of magnetic force.

Therefore, it swiftly holds your iPhone in place and offers charging of 7.5W for iPhone and 5W for AirPods. For design, the charging station features a sleek frame that doesn’t consume extra space.

In addition, a ball joint made of aluminum alloy makes it easy to adjust the stand at multiple angles. Similarly, the 360° rotatable magnetic ring lets you easily switch between landscape and portrait modes.   

Like most chargers, the UGREEN 2-in-1 stand has an LED indicator displaying active charging status. Plus, the USB-C connectivity ensures you don’t struggle to find the right port for the charger stand. 

Pros

  • 360° rotatable magnetic ring

Snap, charge, and go – with the stylish Anker 622 magnetic battery charger. The 5,000mAh battery of this power bank gives a maximum 7.5W charging support to your iPhone. However, you won’t find it here if you are looking for fast charging.   

The small size of this handy charger might make you doubt its competence. However, the charger features Anker’s Mini Cell technology that promises top-notch performance in its tiny frame.

Feel free to carry your iPhone snapped on the 0.5” thick MagSafe battery pack without messing with the charging and burdening your hand. Another big USP of this MagGo charger is the built-in foldable stand attached to its rear side.

You can pull it out to place your iPhone in StandBy mode or when you want to go hands-free. Lastly, the super strong magnets hold your iPhone firmly, giving a stable power push.

Apple lovers meet Twelve South HiRise 3 Deluxe charging stand with MagSafe. The product features a stylish frame made of aluminum and a soft leather-wrapped Qi base that gives a premium look. Plus, its vertical design doesn’t consume space on your tables or desks.    

It is ideal for simultaneously charging iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Additionally, you get fast charging support at 15W for iPhone, 5W for Apple Watch, and 7.5W for AirPods. FYI, the Qi charging base will also charge a second iPhone (8 and up) instead of AirPods.

Adorning a sleek design, the charging pad lets you securely snap your iPhone on and increase charging efficiency by 25%. This multi-device charger powers your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously.

title.rendered: How to create a memory movie with Apple Intelligence on your iPhone

content.rendered:
A part of the Photos app for ages, memory movies are automatically curated videos that have your photos and videos compiled into themed highlights. While they’re automatically created, users with Apple Intelligence-supported iPhones can now create memory movies with nothing more than a text description. Keep reading to learn how to create a memory movie using Apple Intelligence on an iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What are memory movies?
  • What you need to create memory movies
  • How to use Apple Intelligence to create a memory movie on iPhone
  • How to edit a memory movie
  • How to share your memory movies
  • How to delete a memory movie

What are memory movies?

Memory movies are short videos automatically generated by the Photos app by grouping the available photos and videos based on different locations, events, or people in your library. Whether it’s a holiday celebration, a vacation, or a collection of random photos, memory movies bring those moments to life in an engaging and visually appealing format.

While earlier, memory movies were created automatically in the Photos app, the arrival of Apple Intelligence changed the game. You can now create a memory movie with Apple Intelligence with just a text prompt, then make additional changes to the created movie afterward to customize it further.

All this makes memory movies a great way to relive your favorite moments without needing any professional editing skills. With just a few taps and a text prompt, you can transform your iPhone gallery into a mini cinema featuring your most cherished memories.

What you need to create memory movies

Since memory movies is one of the Apple Intelligence features, you need an Apple Intelligence-supported iPhone model up and running on iOS 18.1 or a later version to get your hand on the feature; not to mention, you must also sign up for the Apple Intelligence waitlist.

How to use Apple Intelligence to create a memory movie on iPhone

Creating a memory movie with Apple Intelligence on an iPhone is pretty straightforward. You just need a text prompt or can use one from Apple’s suggestions. Here’s how you do it:

  1. Open the Photos app on your iPhone and head to the Memories section. (The position of the Memories section may vary for you if you have customized the Photos app earlier).
  2. Here, tap the Create button next to Memories.
  3. Tap one of the available suggestions or type your own prompts and hit the Send button to create a memory movie.


Now, sit back and relax and let Apple Intelligence do its magic. You’ll see a series of photos from your library and different keywords coming together (like the Marvel logo introductory sequence) and get assembled as a movie.

How to edit a memory movie

Once a memory movie is created, you can make various changes to it, such as changing the music track, adding filters to individual photos, changing the movie title, and more, before saving it. Here’s how:

  1. To change the music track in the memory movie, tap the Music button in the bottom-left corner.
  2. Next, tap the Add Music button, then choose one of the available music. This feature works best if you’re an Apple Music subscriber.

  3. Now, tap the Filter button in the bottom-right corner to add a filter to the photos in your movie.

  4. For additional edits, such as editing the movie title or timeline, tap the three-dot button at the top and choose the appropriate option.
  5. Once you’re satisfied with the created memory movie, tap the X button in the top-right corner, then tap Done.

How to share your memory movies

What’s the benefit of creating such a stunning memory movie when it’s just confined to your iPhone? Well, Apple has already thought about this: it lets you share any memory movie you have in the Photos app via various means. Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Open the Photos app and head to the Memories section.
  2. Here, play the memory movie you want to share.
  3. Next, tap the three-dot button in the top-right corner and select the Share Movie option in the drop-down menu.
  4. Now, choose the app using which you want to share the memory movie, and it’s done.

How to delete a memory movie

There may come a time when you no longer need a particular memory movie created using Apple Intelligence or an automatically created one. In that case, you can easily delete the memory movie without much effort. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open Photos app and locate the memory movie you want to delete.
  2. Next, tap and hold on to the movie, then tap the Delete Memory button in the pop-up menu.
  3. Finally, tap Delete Memory in the confirmation prompt that appears.

Relive precious memories…

The memory movies feature on your iPhone lets you compile highlights of your birthdays, vacations, or even just a quiet Sunday with your friends without much manual effort. Plus, the many personalization options it offers allow you to add your personal touch to already-created movies, making them truly yours.

What do you think about Apple Intelligence-created memory movies? Do share your thoughts in the comments.

FAQs

Can I create a memory movie without internet access?

Now, you can’t. Having a cellular connection with working mobile data to your iPhone connected to a working Wi-Fi network is necessary to create a memory movie.

How long can a memory movie be?

The length of a memory movie can range from 30 seconds to a few minutes depending on the number of photos, videos, and selected theme.

Can I create memory movies for specific people?

Yes, you can. All you need to do is specify the person’s name in the text prompt. You need the people to be identified in the Photos app for this.

How often does the Photos app create new memory movies?

There’s no fixed interval between memory movie creation. However, the Photos app creates a new memory movie when it detects new additions to your library, significant events or dates, and more.

acceptedAnswer.text: While earlier you could delete messages and conversations using the Command+Delete keyboard shortcut, it doesn't work anymore.

mainEntity.name: How do I recover deleted messages on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Messages open, click View in the menu bar and select Recently Deleted. Select the conversation you want to restore and click Restore.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I delete a message or conversation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any message or conversation you delete in the Messages app on your Mac is moved to the Recently Deleted section and stays there for the next 30 days. You can head to the said folder to recover the deleted conversation or message within 30 days of deleting it.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting messages help free up storage on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting the messages alone won't free up much storage on your Mac; you must delete the attachments separately via System Settings or Finder.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I can’t delete a message?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both the host and the passenger’s device must be connected to the internet via cellular or Personal Hotspot to initiate the SharePlay session and access the Apple Music.

mainEntity.name: How long can a memory movie be?

acceptedAnswer.text: The length of a memory movie can range from 30 seconds to a few minutes depending on the number of photos, videos, and selected theme.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Best SD card readers for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
As technology advances, iPhone and iPad users prioritize convenience above all else. This has resulted in an increase in demand for SD card readers. To free up space on your iPhone and iPad, you can use SD card readers and transfer important files. Isn’t that handy? To make your purchase easier, I have curated a list of the best SD card reader for iPhone and iPad!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Veetone MFi-certified SD card reader – Editor's Choice
  • 2. SUNTRSI SD card reader – The 4-in-1 reader
  • 3. Oyuiasle SD card reader – Two-way transfer support
  • 4. SZHAIYIJIN SD card reader – Perfect tool for the photographer
  • 5. Fubiaofei SD card reader – Slim and sleek
  • 6. ZOIOT SD card reader – The Y-shaped reader
  • 7. DESOFICON SD card – Micro SD card reader

1. Veetone MFi-certified SD card reader – Editor’s Choice

Despite the promises made by numerous SD card readers to ensure device safety, they often fall short of delivering on their claims. But this is not the case with the Veetone SD card reader. With exceptional performance, versatility, and Apple MFi approval, it stands as one of the best card readers for iPhone and iPad. With its seamless performance, it ensures a hassle-free experience.

The universal iOS compatibility of this reader entails easy media transfer from an SD or microSD card directly to your Apple devices. And don’t worry if you’re fond of carrying large videos on an SD card. Its high-speed data transmission capabilities ensure swift and efficient transfer rates, saving valuable time for individuals on the go.

The compact design offers convenience and portability, making it ideal for travel or use in various work settings. It can withstand SD cards with a capacity of 256GB and supports standard photo formats (including JPEG and RAW) and SD/HD Video formats (including H.264 and MPEG-4). All in all, it is the optimal choice for those who crave a reliable and affordable card reader for their iPhone and iPad.

Pros

  • 36 Months Warranty
  • Universal compatibility
  • Super high-speed transmission

Cons

  • Supports one-way transmission for iOS 9.2-12.4

Check out on Amazon

2. SUNTRSI SD card reader – The 4-in-1 reader

The SUNTRSI SD card reader emerges as a top-tier choice for those who handle multiple devices at once. For all your file transfer needs, this reader is your one-stop shop. Designed to cater to the specific needs of Apple devices, this SD card reader offers an unmatched blend of efficiency, reliability, and versatility.

The compact and stylish design of this reader facilitates high-speed transfers capable of achieving a speed of 14 to 16 Mbps. With its wide compatibility, it supports various standard photo formats like RAW, JPEG, GIF, PNG, etc., without any hassle. In spite of being tiny and lightweight, the SUNTRSI SD card reader boasts a sturdy build quality that guarantees long-lasting functionality and durability. 

Best of all, it features an integrated Lightning connector that enables direct access to the iPhone or iPad without requiring additional adapters. All in all, everyone who is looking to carry a universal connector for all their devices in their pockets must try the SUNTRSI SD card reader. Streamline your data management workflow with utmost ease.

Pros

  • Small and portable
  • Charging port
  • Easily manage and backup files

Cons

  • Not MFi Certified

Check out on Amazon

3. Oyuiasle SD card reader – Two-way transfer support

As we continue looking for the best SD card reader for iPhone, it’s unfair to overlook the Oyuiasle SD card reader. It is one of the top contenders for iPhone and iPad users looking for a reliable and efficient device to transfer data without any delay. Designed specifically for Apple devices, this card reader ensures optimal compatibility and seamless integration with iOS.  

With its lightning connector, users can easily connect their iPhones or iPads to SD cards, making it easy to import or export photos, videos, or documents. It is enriched with flawless standard support of photo formats, such as JPEG, RAW, and 4K video formats, such as H.264 and MPEG-4. All this with high-speed data transfer speed via its USB 3.0 interface.  

Simply plug and play your way into accessibility. Eliminate all the need for complicated setups and gadgets with this one tool. With its well-crafted design and affordable price point, the Oyuiasle SD card reader provides professional users with a convenient solution for expanding storage capacity and efficiently managing files on their Apple devices.

Pros

  • Double duty
  • Two-way transfer
  • High-speed transfer

Cons

  • Some iOS devices have reportedly frozen up

Check out on Amazon

4. SZHAIYIJIN SD card reader – Perfect tool for the photographer

It’s a good day for individuals looking for a compact SD card reader, just like this next one. SZHAIYIJIN SD card reader is one of the best options available for iPhone and iPad users looking to expand their device’s storage capabilities. With its compact and sleek design, it seamlessly integrates with both devices, ensuring optimal convenience. 

It also supports SDHC, SDXC, microSD, and even UHS-I cards, making it highly versatile for various file types and sizes. A lightning connector ensures fast and stable data transfer rates of up to 14MB/s. It supports iOS Files, so you can access and manage your files directly from your device’s card reader. 

Additionally, the SZHAIYIJIN SD card reader has built-in security features like password encryption to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access. For those in search of efficient storage solutions customized to their iPhones or iPads, this SD card reader is the ultimate choice. Its reliability, functionality, and user-friendly experience make it a top-notch option for professionals.

Pros

  • Dual card slots
  • Female USB interface
  • High-speed data transfer

Cons

  • Occasionally stops working

Check out on Amazon

5. Fubiaofei SD card reader – Slim and sleek

Probing ahead, make way for the 4-in-1 assistant, Fubiaofei SD card reader. With its compact design and high-speed performance, it’s an ideal choice for both personal and professional use. Honestly, it’s all you need for a seamless data transfer experience. With a variety of supported formats, including DHC, SDXC, and microSD cards, you can streamline your file transfer process at a very reasonable price.  

A lightning connector makes it easy for users to transfer photos and videos from their cameras straight to their iOS devices. As a result, importing is simplified and does not require extra adapters or software. With the Fubiaofei SD card reader, you won’t experience any issues transferring large media files.  

It is further equipped with the latest high-tech chips, which make data transmission more secure. Enabled with many more features and durable build quality, this top-tier SD card reader provides a reliable solution for Apple enthusiasts seeking to expand their device’s storage capabilities while maintaining optimal data transmission speeds.

Pros

  • 4 in 1 Assistant
  • Supports up to 512 GB memory card

Cons

  • Comparatively pricey
  • Supports one-way transfers for iOS versions 9.2-12.4

Check out on Amazon

6. ZOIOT SD card reader – The Y-shaped reader

Featuring a unique design with universal support for all Apple devices, welcome the ZOIOT SD card reader into your lives. This compact yet powerful device boasts exceptional compatibility, supporting various types of memory cards, including SDHC, SDXC, microSD, and CompactFlash. It can seamlessly read both SD card and MicroSD card simultaneously, allowing you to transition as you desire.  

Its high-speed USB 3.0 interface ensures swift and seamless data transmission with only a 16 M/S latency drop, enabling users to conveniently access their files without any lag or delay. Furthermore, the ZOIOT SD card reader comes with an accompanying app that facilitates easy management of files on both iPhones and iPads.  

The sleek design and durable build quality of the ZOIOT SD card reader ensure that you don’t have to worry about finding a replacement for years to come. Our goal is to provide professionals with the utmost convenience in handling their critical data transfers efficiently.

Pros

  • I-Flash Device app
  • Can read multiple cards simultaneously
  • Two-way transfer

Cons

  • Does not support SD cards with more than 128 GB capacity

Check out on Amazon

7. DESOFICON SD card – Micro SD card reader

Today, we’ll try something new. Instead of a grand ending, how about a small one? Meet the tiniest SD card reader for your iPhone and iPad, DESOFICON. It might not look like much, but trust me; this one has got potential. This innovative device allows users to easily transfer and manage their photos, videos, and documents from an SD card to their Apple devices.  

Its compact design ensures portability and convenience, making it an ideal companion for photographers, videographers, and professionals on the go. With its lightning-fast transfer speed of up to 14MB/s, users can quickly backup or share files without any hassle. Moreover, the DESOFICON SD card reader boasts wide compatibility with various iOS versions, including iOS 9.2 and above.  

Further, the robust construction guarantees durability and long-lasting performance in demanding situations. Additionally, it supports a variety of file formats such as JPEG, RAW, H.264, MP4, and more. The DESOFICON SD card reader is the perfect solution for iPhone and iPad users who prioritize efficient data management without compromising quality or reliability.

Pros

  • Exfat & fat32 support
  • 24 Months warranty
  • Lifetime technical support

Cons

  • Some iPhones fail to recognize this reader

Check out on Amazon

Anytime, anywhere!  

As we bid farewell, remember that the journey toward optimal data transfer, storage, and accessibility continues to evolve, promising even more remarkable innovations in the years to come. Embrace the future, as technology and imagination intertwine seamlessly like never before. Regardless of your profession, the ideal SD card reader you desire is out there. Try everything that piques your interest and leave no stones unturned. 

Thank you for reading. Please leave your thoughts in the comment section below.

  • Best USB-C card readers for Mac
  • Best USB-C to HDMI adapters

mainEntity.name: Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device's security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an active internet connection to use SharePlay with CarPlay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both the host and the passenger’s device must be connected to the internet via cellular or Personal Hotspot to initiate the SharePlay session and access the Apple Music.

mainEntity.name: Can SharePlay in CarPlay be used with third-party music apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: SharePlay in CarPlay is primarily designed to work with Apple Music. While it’s possible for third-party music apps like Spotify to work with SharePlay, they don’t support SharePlay in CarPlay at the time of writing this post.

acceptedAnswer.text: Now, you can't. Having a cellular connection with working mobile data to your iPhone connected to a working Wi-Fi network is necessary to create a memory movie.

mainEntity.name: How long can a memory movie be?

acceptedAnswer.text: The length of a memory movie can range from 30 seconds to a few minutes depending on the number of photos, videos, and selected theme.

mainEntity.name: Can I create memory movies for specific people?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can. All you need to do is specify the person's name in the text prompt. You need the people to be identified in the Photos app for this.

mainEntity.name: How often does the Photos app create new memory movies?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no fixed interval between memory movie creation. However, the Photos app creates a new memory movie when it detects new additions to your library, significant events or dates, and more.

title.rendered: Best Michael Jordan Wallpapers for iPhone (2026)

content.rendered:
Welcome to our collection of the best Michael Jordan iPhone wallpapers. With six NBA championships and five MVP awards, MJ had one of the most decorated careers in sports history. These wallpapers encapsulate everything from the essence of his signature jump shot to his famed competitive spirit. Browse through our best Michael Jordan wallpapers for iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Jordan 4k wallpaper
  • 2. Michael Jordan iPhone wallpapers
  • 3. Michael Jordan dunk wallpaper
  • 4. Artistic Michael Jordan iPhone wallpapers
  • 5. GOAT Michael Jordan 4k wallpaper
  • 6. Superman Jordan iPhone wallpaper
  • 7. Award-winning Michael Jordan wallpaper for iPhone
  • 8. MJ 23 forever 4K wallpaper
  • 9. Artistic Michael Jordan wallpaper
  • 10. Illustration Michael Jordan wallpaper

1. Jordan 4k wallpaper

Nike honored the former basketball player and Chicago Bulls Hall of Fame member by renaming an entire shoe category in his honor. You may make this minimalistic wallpaper as your iPhone’s face by hitting the download button.

Download

2. Michael Jordan iPhone wallpapers

This wallpaper with the number 23 on the back and the colors of the team he was most successful with has a lot to say about the player’s love for the game both on and off the court. This could work as a motivation for you to work towards your passion on and off the court.

Download

3. Michael Jordan dunk wallpaper

Here’s a look at the most legendary dunk in basketball history. By tapping the download button below, you can get your hands on this classic wallpaper developed by our in-house graphic designers.

Download

4. Artistic Michael Jordan iPhone wallpapers

As I look at this wallpaper, the first thing that springs to mind is an inspirational quotation from Michael Jordan: “If you accept the expectations of others, especially negative ones, then you never will change the outcome.”

Download

5. GOAT Michael Jordan 4k wallpaper

The Michael Jordan GOAT wallpaper for your iPhone is one of my personal favorites on this list. Jordan is regarded as one of the best basketball players of all time owing to his exceptional talent, competitive drive, and multiple honors.

Download

6. Superman Jordan iPhone wallpaper

Emphasizing his intensity and passion for his game in red and representing his iconic style with black, this Michael Jordan 4K wallpaper can be your go-to iPhone face if you’re a die-hard fan of the player.

Download

7. Award-winning Michael Jordan wallpaper for iPhone

Enjoying success is easy, but the road to it is difficult. This wallpaper illustrates perfectly the adage that hard work always pays off. Click the link below to get this 4K iPhone wallpaper.

Download

8. MJ 23 forever 4K wallpaper

MJ retired from basketball in 2003, but his influence as a player and cultural icon goes on. Here’s a wallpaper of Jordan wearing his legendary number 23 jersey. Download this elegant wallpaper for your iPhone by clicking the button below.

Download

9. Artistic Michael Jordan wallpaper

Download

10. Illustration Michael Jordan wallpaper

The superstar was drafted third overall by the Chicago Bulls. The paper-cut wallpaper depicts one of his favorite mid-range shots, which helped him score a lot of points throughout his career.

Download

How good?

Hope these wallpapers made you take a walk down memory lane, and I’m pretty sure you are already in love with these MJ 4K wallpapers but have you checked our football wallpaper collection? You’ll be equally impressed.

Read more:

  • Best graffiti wallpapers for iPhone
  • Free Disney wallpapers for iPhone

title.rendered: Best VR headsets for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
Are you looking for a VR headset for your iPhone to play games or experience immersive 360-degree videos? Virtual Reality’s popularity is booming daily as more people are taking an interest.  

A single Virtual Reality headset for iPhone can enable you to travel the world or explore space from the comfort of your sofa. To help you out, I have compiled a complete list of the 10 best VR headsets for the iPhone to enjoy gaming and watching videos. So, with no further ado, let’s get started!

Table of Contents
  • Best VR headsets for iOS buy in 2026 (Top 8 picks)
    • 1. Meta Quest 2 – Editor's choice
    • 2. BNext VR headset: Best budget pick
    • 3. Atlasonix VR headset: Get gaming support
    • 4. PlayStation VR2 – Stylish and feature-packed
    • 5. HTC Vive Pro 2 – Top-notch 5K display
    • 6. Pansonite – Interactive controller for gamers
    • 7. Apple Vision Pro – Bonus Pick

Best VR headsets for iOS buy in 2026 (Top 8 picks)

1. Meta Quest 2 – Editor’s choice 

Oculus Quest 2 is, till now, the best standalone VR headset for iPhone with a controller. You don’t need to connect cables or use devices to enjoy the amazing 360-degree movie or gaming. It has 6GB RAM, a single LCD screen with 1832 X 1920 pixels per eye resolution, and a refresh rate of up to 90Hz.

Besides, Meta Quest 2 boasts the powerful Adreno 650 GPU, as analyzed by UploadVR, making the display output 50% crisper and your 3D experience seamless. Further, the headset features three outside cameras, which you can use to track your position so that you don’t run into furniture or walls. This doesn’t require any external sensors!

The built-in speakers and a 3.5mm jack will provide a crisp, 3D positional audio experience. It is comfortable to wear for a long time because of its lightweight.

Last but not the least, the battery backup is about three hours, depending on how you use it. You will need iOS 10 or higher to use Oculus Quest 2 with your iPhone. As it’s a standalone model, you can connect both devices using Bluetooth and the Oculus app.

However, the biggest turn-off is its price. It’s a little expensive but definitely worth it.

Pros

  • Lightweight
  • Easy to use
  • Cables are not required
  • Edgy display
  • Accurate motion tracking

Cons

  • Less battery backup
  • Need a Facebook account
  • Costly

Check out on Amazon

2. BNext VR headset: Best budget pick

The BNext VR headset for iPhone is a pocket-friendly choice though it has fewer features than most high-end ones. You don’t need to connect cables or optimize app settings to experience immersive VR. So, I must say it’s easy to set up. This virtual reality headset includes FD and OD support for a wide field of vision.

Thus, you can get a precise focal distance and less distortion to guarantee the best 360° viewing experience. BNext designed the device for comfortable and prolonged wear. It has a soft nose piece, breathable foam face, eyesight protection system, and a completely adjustable head strap to relieve strain.

However, the weight of the headset may hurt your nose!

Pros

  • Budget-friendly
  • Easy to set up
  • Adjustable head strap
  • Anti-blue light system
  • Larger lens

Cons

  • Not interactive
  • May hurt your nose

Check out on Amazon

3. Atlasonix VR headset: Get gaming support

If you want to buy a VR headset for iPhone with a controller, the Atlasonix VR headset is for you. It has a 4″ AMOLED display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate to give you an immersive VR experience. It supports iPhones with 4″–6.3″ displays. With 3D gaming support and HD optimization, you can enjoy games, movies, and more!

Atlasonix VR headset has FD and OD adjustments to widen the viewing angle to 360°. Besides the great experience, it also offers comfort with a completely adjustable head strap, an anti-blue light system, and a soft nosepiece. You will get exclusive VR movies and games from a library of over 300 titles.

Pros

  • Good build quality
  • Eye protection system
  • Remote controller

Cons

  • Weight might hurt the nose
  • Interface needs improvement

Check out on Amazon

4. PlayStation VR2 – Stylish and feature-packed

Experience virtual reality like never before with the PlayStation VR2 headset. Featuring two 2000×2040 OLED displays, this amazing console blesses you with stunning 4K@120fps HDR visuals of your virtual spaces. Besides, you get a sleek, lightweight frame that effortlessly sits on your head without giving a bulky feel. The included controllers ensure the best gaming experience.   

Unlike Quest 2, PlayStation VR2 features a modest content library. However, the power-packed features like intelligent eye tracking and headset haptics quickly compensate for this void. Besides, adaptive triggers help elevate your in-game experience through improved responses, tactile gameplay, and interactions. You also get a stunning 110-degree field of view of the surroundings.   

You may escape into dynamic soundscapes with its Tempest 3D AudioTech support. Moreover. the technology adapts to your head movements and position to ensure optimized responsiveness in the virtual space. While PS VR2 excels in providing interactive virtual experiences, you can only use it with Play Station 5. This is indeed a big bummer for these Sony VR glasses for iPhone.   

Pros

  • Highly intuitive controls 
  • 4K HDR visuals  
  • Includes controllers 
  • 3D audio immersion

Cons

  • Small content library

Check out on Amazon

5. HTC Vive Pro 2 – Top-notch 5K display

HTC Vive Pro 2 is for you if you value performance over money. Packed in a lightweight, plastic chassis, the headset teleports you to a real-life virtual world with its intuitive functionalities. Besides, it houses a dual display setup that efficiently offers a combined 5K resolution for your eyes to cherish. With a stunning 120-degree field of view, you can take in more of your virtual surroundings.  

It is needless to say that lenses form one of the most essential components of a VR headset. Luckily, the HTC Vive Pro 2 offers 5K 4896×2448 resolution through its lenses to give a crystal-clear view. Moreover, 120Hz refresh rates play a significant role in running graphics-intensive games and apps. Every thrilling move in your game will come to life with these amazing VR goggles for the iPhone.

Regarding design, the HTC Vive Pro 2 includes wide arms of plastic on the sides and a strap on the top with soft padding. So, it doesn’t feel bulky when worn for hours in a stretch. Additionally, there is an adjustable IPD dial to find the perfect angle for your visual expeditions. FYI, this flexibility saves you from eye fatigue and distorted vision, making Vive Pro 2 perfect for adults and children.   

Pros

  • 5K clear visuals 
  • Adjustable IPD dial 
  • Comfortable design 
  • Strong plastic build

Cons

  • Weak software
  • Tricky handling of controllers

Check out on Amazon 

6. Pansonite – Interactive controller for gamers 

Designed to excellence, the Pansonite VR Headset is a budget pick to unlock a new virtual dimension with your iPhone. This compact device renders seamless access to unmatched virtual reality spaces where comfort meets innovation. With an aspheric HD lens, Pansonite headset gives a worthy 120-degree field of view of your surroundings without messing up with colors and clarity.  

One of the best features of these versatile headsets is the wide range of customization and functionalities. Here, you can easily adjust the IPD range between 60 mm and 70 mm and the focal distance in the range of 37.5mm to 46.5mm. So, all you need to do for this is move the button placed on the top of the glasses. Smooth, right?   

In terms of audio, the Pansonite headset features 360-degree sound. However, sound quality is not one of its strongest features as there are some better options in the same price range. The handheld controller that comes with this headset also responds quickly to human movements. As a result, gaming sessions will be more responsive.

Pros

  • Adjustable lenses 
  • Lightweight, plastic design 
  • Works with Android 
  • Budget-friendly

Cons

  • Controller is average

Check out on Amazon

7. Apple Vision Pro – Bonus Pick

Apple has made its first move in the mixed reality niche with Vision Pro headsets. Scheduled for a 2024 launch, Apple Vision Pro is branded as a spatial computer that links virtual space with the physical world to create real immersive experiences. Moreover, the two micro-OLED screens are designed to provide 4K resolution displays for the glass wearers.   

Unlike most VR headsets that rely on controllers, Apple Vision Pro works differently from them. You can control this smart device with hand gestures, voice commands, and eye movements. With a simple tap of your fingers, you can easily manage all your tasks. Also, the built-in cameras allow you to take 3D photos and videos with top-notch clarity.  

In Vision Pro, Apple has included two silicon chips – the M2 and the new R1. M2 chips control the native visionOS operating system, while R1 chips handle sensor, camera, and microphone information. Vision Pro does not come with an in-built battery. It comes with a battery pack that can run two hours on a single charge.  

Pros

  • Two micro-OLED displays 
  • Comfortable headband build  
  • Powered by M2 and R1 chips 
  • Hand and eye controls

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on Apple

Wrapping up 

This was my list of the best VR headsets for iPhone consisting of different budgets and preferences. Choose the one that suits your requirements best. What do you think of Apple’s rumored VR glasses? If they launch, would you buy them? Share your answers in the comment below.

Read more:

  • Meta vs Apple AR/VR war: Who will rule the virtual realm?
  • Apple Vision Pro vs. Meta Quest 3: A comparative study

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

content.rendered:
Are you a fan of the iconic Hogwarts Legacy video game? Do you love the spells and sorcery of the wizarding world? If yes, then you must be looking for a way to display the fandom on your iPhone’s display. Well, I present you the perfect way to do that; download these Hogwarts Legacy iPhone wallpapers inspired by the images on Unsplash and spread the magic!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Hogwarts moonlit castle 4K wallpaper
  • 2. Hogwarts legacy flying hippogriff legacy wallpaper
  • 3. Hogwarts Legacy deluxe wallpaper
  • 4. Hogwarts Legacy dark art wallpaper
  • 5. Dragon lair Hogwarts Legacy wallpaper
  • 6. Hufflepuff Hogwarts wallpaper for iPhone
  • 7. Slytherin Hogwarts Legacy 4K iPhone wallpaper
  • 8. Wizarding world Hogwarts Legacy wallpaper
  • 9. Silhouette Hogwarts Legacy wallpaper
  • 10. Artistic Hogwarts wallpaper for iPhone

1. Hogwarts moonlit castle 4K wallpaper

Step into a world of enchantment as the magical school of witchcraft and wizardry comes to life under the silvery light of the moon. A glimpse of this masterpiece is enough to take you on a roller-coaster ride.

Download

2. Hogwarts legacy flying hippogriff legacy wallpaper

If you ever wondered what it’s like to ride a hippogriff after watching Harry Potter movies, Hogwarts Legacy has brought you a mesmerizing in-game experience. Cherish these precious moments by downloading this beautiful wallpaper for your iPhone.

Download

3. Hogwarts Legacy deluxe wallpaper

Featuring rich details and vibrant colors, this wallpaper brings the beloved world of Harry Potter to life in stunning 4K resolution. Download this wallpaper for your iPhone now.

Download

4. Hogwarts Legacy dark art wallpaper

Carrying the essence of evil with magic, the following wallpaper is dark and suspenseful at the same time. One peek at it, and everyone can sense a storm brewing. Want to try it? Then go and hit the download button.

Download

5. Dragon lair Hogwarts Legacy wallpaper

Intricate details and stunning colors make this wallpaper sure to leave you stunned. It takes you to the heart of the castle, where a fierce dragon guards a hoard of treasure. So, what are you waiting for? Tap the download button now!!

Download

6. Hufflepuff Hogwarts wallpaper for iPhone

Whether you’re a proud Hufflepuff yourself or simply appreciate the values of loyalty and hard work, this wallpaper is sure to satisfy you. It features the iconic Hufflepuff crest, complete with a badger and the house colors of yellow and black.

Download

7. Slytherin Hogwarts Legacy 4K iPhone wallpaper

With its high-quality 4K resolution, this wallpaper is sure to make a statement on your iPhone. Featuring iconic green and silver colors and the Slytherin crest, this wallpaper is a must-have for any fan of the cunning and ambitious house.

Download

8. Wizarding world Hogwarts Legacy wallpaper

This stunning 4K wallpaper features iconic symbols and locations from the Harry Potter universe, including Hogwarts Castle. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or a novice, it will definitely capture your imagination.

Download

9. Silhouette Hogwarts Legacy wallpaper  

This elegant wallpaper features a striking black-and-white silhouette of Hogwarts Castle. With its clean lines and minimalist design, this wallpaper is a perfect choice for those who appreciate simplicity and elegance.

Download

10. Artistic Hogwarts wallpaper for iPhone

Bring a touch of whimsy and wonder to your iPhone with the Artistic Hogwarts Wallpaper. Colorful brushstrokes and playful details capture the spirit of Hogwarts castle in the wizarding world.

Download

Are you excited?  

This collection of exquisite backgrounds is designed to add a touch of magic and charm to your iPhone. From the Hogwarts crest to the castle and grounds, as well as various characters and creatures, you can customize and personalize your display to express your personal tastes and preferences. So, why wait? Download these amazing backgrounds and get ready to be dazzled.

title.rendered: Best Apple TV Remote Cases and Covers in 2026

content.rendered:
With every edition, Apple TV is getting smarter. The same is the case with its remote. The latest Siri remote is literally a revolution in remote technology. The only problem with these remotes is that they are delicate.

A normal fall or a shock can break them and you are left with nothing more than regret. Why regret, when we have listed cases for remotes too. The list includes cases for 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Generation of Apple TV remote, so make yourself comfortable and have a look at the list.

Table of Contents

    Best Siri Remote Cases and Covers (our top 9 picks)

    1. Hapurs

    Hapurs has designed a precise case for your fourth-generation Apple TV remote. This cover is made of durable and soft silicone, which ensures a firm grip. Your remote will never slip off your hands while you are speaking Siri commands. You can use an attached lanyard to hold the remote securely.

    Check out on Amazon

    2. elago R1 Intelli

    Created with soft silicone material, the elago R1 Intelli case is highly protective. It is fully capable of absorbing shock. Due mainly to the textured design, the cover provides an improved grip. Intelli comes with very strong magnets that let you easily attach it to any metal surface. The cover offers hassle-free access to all the functions of your Apple TV remote. Lastly, R1 Intelli is available in six captivating colors.

    Check out on Amazon

    3. Fintie Honey Comb Series

    The Finite remote case sports a form-fitting design and snaps on perfectly on your Siri remote. With the picture-perfect cut-outs, it offers full access to all the ports and buttons. Carved with the quality material, the remote cover is very durable. The anti-slip material prevents drops and also provides enhanced grip. Finite Apple TV remote case comes in as many as 11 color options.

    Check out on Amazon

    4. Akwox

    What makes Akwox Siri remote case a reasonably good choice is the sleek design. Crafted with the finest silicone material, the cover feels extremely soft to the touch. The remote cover is strong enough to withstand drops and resist scratch. Thanks to the precise cut-outs, it allows you to easily access all the functions. Even better, there are six charming color options available to choose the right cover for your remote.

    Check out on Amazon

    5. Act Labs

    This case from Act Labs resembles the iPhone case. It is made from plastic and completely covers the back of your Apple TV remote. In addition, it also covers four corners. The case has a removable wrist strap that can also be adjusted in different sizes. There are precise cuts for mic and touch surface that gives you unobstructed access to all the functions of the Siri remote.

    Check out on Amazon

    6. Bear Motion

    With its precise manufacturing, Bear Motion case for Apple TV fourth-generation remote allows you to quickly access buttons. The form-fitting factors guard the back and sides of your remote from scratches, dirt, and bumps. You should not be worried about your Apple TV remote even if your kids are using it.

    Check out on Amazon

    7. SIKAICASE (2nd, 3rd Generation)

    Exhibiting slim-fit design, SIKAICASE is made to be a protective suit for your Apple TV remote. The soft structure power by premium quality silicone material looks nice. Exact cut-outs boost user-experience. Courtesy of improved grip, your remote won’t slip out of your hands. 11 color options are enough to handpick the right match for your remote.

    Check out on Amazon

    9. InventCase (2nd, 3rd Generation)

    InventCase is a classically designed cover for Apple TV remote. It is made from premium black PU leather that looks very elegant. The cover protects the remote from dust and dirt while the cuts on it give you unhindered access to all the functions. As it is designed specifically for the 2nd and the 3rd generation, the cover fits perfectly on the remote. Lastly, there are no color options available at the time of writing this.

    Check out on Amazon

    Signing off

    Which remote case is going to pair with your Siri remote? Let us know its name and the one quality you have liked most about it.

    Whether it’s improved grip, full-body protection, or good-looking design, these remote cases live up to the expectation on all aspects. Besides, they are very lightweight and fit perfectly on your remote.

    You may also want to check out:

    • Best Game Controllers for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV
    • How to turn on  dark mode on Apple TV

    Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

    Our favorite Amazon finds:

    • Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Qi2 15W Charging Station
    • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
    • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
    • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
    • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

    As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.

title.rendered: Best Apple TV Remote Charging Stands in 2026

content.rendered:
After a tiresome day, you wish to recline in a comfortable chair for binge-watching on Apple TV. But your Apple TV Remote is missing, and worse, it is discharged when you finally find it. You think your evening is spoilt. You wish you had got an Apple TV remote charging stand to keep that remote control safe and charged.

I extensively searched across the web and found some of the best Apple TV Remote charging docks. While doing so, I also found a viable solution to clear out the clutter of charging cables or connecting cables causes. The answer to all your woes regarding safekeeping, charging, and messy wires is this article and the accessories mentioned below.

Table of Contents
  • 1. TotalMount Apple TV Remote Holder
  • 2. elago D Stand Charging Station
  • 3. elago 3 in 1 Charging Hub
  • 4. Twelve South HiRise 2
    • That's all for now

1. TotalMount Apple TV Remote Holder

Whether you are worried about losing your Apple TV Remote or irritated by all the wires that are seen, TotalMount offers an excellent solution for both the issues. As the name suggests, it is basically a remote holder that can be mounted on side or back of your TV by a quality adhesive.

The inbuilt dock can charge your remote when plugged in, keeping it always ready for action. Moreover, the two cable managers included with the holder, aid you in organizing and hiding the cords. The holder is also compatible with all Apple TV remotes.

USP: Compact design
Check out on Amazon

2. elago D Stand Charging Station

A docking station that is strong, flexible, smart, elegant, easy-to-use and multipurpose. You can park this cylindrical stand next to the Apple TV device or on your side table; it will look great everywhere. Designed especially for original Apple Lightning Cable, it supports Apple TV (Siri remote), iPhone, AirPods, iPad mini, Wireless keyboard, Magic mouse.

The silicon outer covering does not scratch or harm your device or cable. While the inner aluminum cylinder ensures that elago D stand can sustain the weight of your devices. Additionally, the charging slot is fashioned in a way that the device does not slip. To insert the lightning cable into the slot, simply separate the top and the bottom cap. The product is available in black and silver color.

USP: Silicon exterior protects from scratches
Check out on Amazon

3. elago 3 in 1 Charging Hub

If you loved the features of elago D stand mentioned above, you would fall head over heels for this product as well. Manufactured with high-quality silicone, this charging hub is flexible and durable. The flexibility feature also extends to devices you can attach from Apple TV remote to Apple Watch.

The three cable management holes in the rear end not only allow you to charge multiple devices simultaneously but also keep the clutter of wires in the background. In my opinion, if your Apple TV is placed in the bedroom, elago’s Charging Hub is a perfect accessory for your bedside table. Everything from your AirPods, iPhone, Apple Watch to your Apple TV remote will be safely placed and charged just next to you.

USP: Charges multiple devices together
Check out on Amazon

4. Twelve South HiRise 2

Already a very popular and trusted charging stand for iPhone & iPad. As the HiRISE 2 uses lightning connector, it can also power your Apple TV Siri remote. Talk about killing a few birds with one arrow.

Quite compact in its structure, the stand can fit perfectly even on the smallest desks. Also, the metal body adds subsequent weight, ensuring sufficient stability. The unique combination of sturdiness and compactness further allows users to remove the TV remote with one hand.

The device is available in black, silver, and white colors. You can also opt for a refined version of this model, dubbed as HiRise 2 deluxe. This model comes with Lightning + Micro-USB cables that save you from hunting the cable every time.

USP: One-handed iDevice removal
Check out on Amazon

That’s all for now

Charging stands for Apple TV remote listed above are developed for the original Apple lightning cable, and therefore, I count these products among the best charging docks. Now your original cable not just enjoys a perfect fit, it is also protected from wear and tear.

Considering our varied requirements, your choice may differ from mine. Do you even prefer a charging station or you like the traditional charger? Which of these products did you like the most, or have I missed your favorite one? Do share your comments with us.

Don’t miss:

  • Best Wireless Headphones for Apple TV
  • How to Use Your iPhone or iPad as Apple TV Remote
  • Best Apple TV Remote Cases

title.rendered: Best 11-inch iPad Pro Keyboard Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
What’s an iPad Pro without an elegant keyboard case? Nothing but a good tablet without an X-factor. Keeping in mind the high demand, I’ve taken a peek at some of the best 11-inch iPad Pro 2020 keyboard cases (available in the market right now). And they have looked well-timed for the power-packed iPad!

Table of Contents
  1. Boriyuan
  2. Apple Smart Keyboard Folio
  3. Fintie
  4. OYOSUOGG
  5. KVAGO
  6. Zagg slim book go

1. Boriyuan

“Boriyuan” keyboard case provides the desired flexibility both as a practical typing asset and an essential stand for media consumption. You can take advantage of the three levels of brightness and the seven vibrant colors to write articles or work on your projects even in low light.

The other notable feature is the sturdy casing that can deliver a dependable shield to your iPad Pro. Thus, your random falls or scuffs won’t have any impact on your tablet.

You can use the folio to convert the cover into a useful stand. As it’s fully adjustable, you are guaranteed to have multiple viewing angles. And if dark colors are your thing, Boriyuan’s eight hue options might help you discover a better pair for iPad.

USP: Sturdy casing with fully adjustable stand
Check out on Amazon

2. Apple Smart Keyboard Folio

If you can travel a bit farther in favor of a top-notch build and an enhanced typing experience, Apple Smart Keyboard Folio can be a great pick.

What I like the most about this case is the full-size keyboard that’s designed to let you type more smoothly. The keys are pretty smooth and responsive, allowing your finger to go about the business with ease.

Another quality that makes it stand out is that it doesn’t require charging. With the solid build, the cover can withstand minor falls. Thanks to the reliable stand functionality, it provides comfortable viewing angles.

USP: Best typing experience
Check out on Apple

3. Fintie

Three qualities make Fintie a decent contender for your iPad Pro. First and foremost, the cover has a durable construction that provides the needed safeguard against accidental bumps.

The second, anti-slip grooves ensure you have stable viewing angles. So, expect both your typing and media watching to be a better experience.

The third, it has case has a holder for Apple Pencil and it also allows the digital pen to get powered up wirelessly. Lastly, you can pick out this cheapest ($27.99) keyboard case in two colors like black and composition book.

USP: Anti-slip grooves for multiple viewing angles
Check out on Amazon

4. OYOSUOGG

OYOSUOGG keyboard cover appears to be more pragmatic than many of its counterparts. The low-profile design makes it a better suit for a formal outing.

Soft microfiber lining interior coupled with the durable leather exterior plays a significant role in helping the cover withstand impact. ABS keys are accurate and easy to type. Magnetic cover with auto sleep/wake feature maximizes the battery life of your tablet. Furthermore, the case is available in four color options.

USP: Professional design
Check out on Amazon

5. KVAGO

KVAGO has got a slim design and also offers you the flexibility to remove the keyboard when you want to get rid of the bulk. The keyboard has smooth and tactile keys making it a lot easier for you to write emails or even create a short piece for the presentation.

The backlit keys come into the play when the darkness creeps in, and you still want to finish out your task. Front cover can be fine-tuned for multiple viewing angles depending on your activity.

Though I don’t expect much from this thin cover, scratches and minor falls won’t be able to hurt your iPad.

USP: Seven-color backlit keys
Check out on Amazon

6. Zagg slim book go

“Zagg” has come up with a keyboard case that can be called as the most equipped rival of Apple Smart Keyboard. And at $99, it’s a lot cheaper than Apple’s offering ($179).

Regarding specs, “slim book go” is on the slimmer side and flaunts a notebook style keyboard that can accelerate your typing. Furthermore, the case is removable offering you the flexibility to use it as a simple cover especially when you want to hold the tablet a bit more comfortably.

The seven colors backlit prevent darkness from stopping your work and using Apple Pencil? Check out the super handy slot to keep the digital pencil safe.

If you are looking for a rugged keyboard case, Zagg’s rugged book go would be a solid pick. Though it’s more pricey $149, your iPad gets the complete defense against unexpected damage.

USP: Seven colors backlit keys
Check out on Zagg

That’s all, folks! As always, share your valuable inputs about the above cases and which one looks timed for your iPad Pro 11.

Stay Tuned for More…

Apple’s keyboard case does look superior on several fronts. And if you want to have a seamless experience, it should be the way to go.

However, the third-party keyboard cases shouldn’t be underestimated. Despite being available at a much lower price, they offer a decent typing experience.

As and when more accessory makers introduce covers for the 2018 iPad Pro, we’ll keep updating this post to include more top-notch options. So, remain tuned in with us.

You’d like to snap a look at the following posts as well:

  • Best 11-inch iPad Pro Leather Cases
  • 11-inch iPad Pro Folio Cases

Have you chosen Apple’s keyboard case for your iPad or gone for a cheaper yet functional option? Feel free to let us know that.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best Wireless Headphones for Apple TV in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple has already fulfilled its dream to create a wireless world by launching AirPods and wireless charging compatible iPhones. The best thing about AirPods is you can connect them to all Apple devices. And this also includes your Apple TV. While watching your favorite show or movie on Apple TV, you wouldn’t like to disturb others; for this reason, you would use AirPods or other Bluetooth headsets. With its limited battery capacity, TV users may wish to explore a list of the best Bluetooth headphones to watch Apple TV content.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Riwbox
  • 2. Meidong
  • 3. Apple AirPods Max
  • 4. WXY
  • 5. ANSTEN
  • 6. Picun
  • 7. Avantree

1. Riwbox

Riwbox has taken special care of your comfort, and therefore, it has manufactured this pair of Bluetooth headphones with memory-protein ear cushion. This soft cushion feels like human skin that gives you lasting comfort. You can binge-watch your favorite TV shows or more than one movie during the weekend.

The headband is softly padded; hence, you feel great comfort even after watching TV for a long time. Even if you forget to power off the headphones, you can watch and listen to the entertainment by using an audio cable. The foldable design saves space on your work desk.

USP: Space-saving design
Check out on Amazon

2. Meidong

With 30 Hours playtime, Meidong is one of the best Bluetooth headphones for your Apple TV 4K. Never stop your entertainment spree. When the battery dies, you can use 3.5mm audio cable to continue watching your favorite contents. When you use smart noise-canceling, the battery gets drained after 15 hours of playtime.

You can enjoy superior sound quality while watching Apple TV. This is possible with 40mm powerful aperture drivers. At home, you may be surrounded by your kids or pesky guests; but you can continue watching movies and TV series peacefully.

USP: 40mm powerful aperture
Check out on Amazon

3. Apple AirPods Max

You can’t go wrong with Apple’s premium over-ear headphones that boast superior sound quality and a sleek design. These offer high-fidelity audio and active noise cancellation to make sure you enjoy whatever you’re tuned into on your Apple TV. At the same time, spatial audio with dynamic head tracking provides theater-like surround sound to keep you immersed.

Further, it’s designed with a knit-mesh canopy and memory foam ear cushions for extreme comfort and exceptional fit. And the computational audio combines custom acoustic design with Apple’s H1 chip and software for breakthrough audio experiences. The adorable color options make this an all the more attractive option.

USP: Apple-designed drivers and unique features
Check out on Amazon

4. WXY

WXY Bluetooth headphones are a beautiful gift for girls or women of discerning taste. The rose girls and young women highly appreciate the gold color of the earphones. You can enjoy your Apple TV time for long hours as they give you 14 hours of music time. When the battery drains, you can charge its 450mAh battery with USB cable in just 2.5 hours.

You can use these Bluetooth headphones in three different modes: wireless, wired, and MP3. Note that when you use wired mode, the microphone will be disabled.

USP: Earmuff controls
Check out on Amazon

5. ANSTEN

ANSTEN has designed these wireless headphones uniquely. Unlike other headphones, ANSTEN’s wireless earphones can transmit signal up to 164 feet (50 meters). The distance does not hamper the signal as it supports zero delays; the product is ideal for using Apple TV. Unless there is a power cut, the headphone will not lose connection with the transmitter.

The plug and play feature is exceptionally convenient for senior citizens who want to watch movies and TV shows on Apple TV. The battery in this headphone can deliver 25 hours of non-stop performance.

USP: Unique base design
Check out on Amazon

6. Picun

Picun presents Bluetooth 5.0 Technology coupled with hi-fi stereo sound. The dual 40mm large-aperture driver offers more stable transmission speed and high-quality audio output. For better music listening with Hi-Fi stereo sound experience, Picun provides ear cushions that completely cover your ear. Next, you can immerse yourself in the rich audio.

For long-lasting comfort, the headphones have memory-protein ear cushion that feels like human skin texture. You can watch movies and listen to music on your Apple TV for hours.

USP: Hi-Fi stereo sound
Check out on Amazon

7. Avantree

Avantree’s headphones and Bluetooth transmitter automatically connect when you turn them on; you don’t need to pair the two devices. The fast stream technology reduces Bluetooth delay. It delivers high-quality sound in precise synchronization.

You can pair the transmitter with other Bluetooth receiving devices, which might include other headphones or speakers in your office or home. The Audikast transmitter of Avantree works up to 100 feet.

USP: Fast stream technology
Check out on Amazon

That’s all friends!

Signing off…

Bluetooth headphones for Apple TV help you watch your favorite contents without disturbing others at home. When you watch late-night shows, the volume of TV might disturb your kids or spouse. To avoid this situation, you can connect wireless headphones to your Apple TV and consume entertainment.

Which Bluetooth headphone would you like to buy for your Apple TV?

  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)

  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub
