title.rendered: Best manga reader apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
We, weebs and Otakus, always look for convenient and immersive platforms to devour our favorite manga. However, with many options available, it might get confusing to find a platform where you can read non-pirated manga. That’s why I have brought you the best manga reader apps for iPhone and iPad. With these apps, you will never miss a new chapter and will have an exceptional reading experience!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Shonen Jump Manga & Comics – Editor's choice
  • 2. MANGA Plus by SHUEISHA – Best app to read manga for free
    • 3. VIZ Manga – All genres in one place
    • 4. WebComics – Enjoy webtoons with manga
    • 5. MangaToon – Read manga in your language
    • 6. Manga Readеr – Offline reading companion
    • 8. Manga Storm CBR – Read different manga formats

1. Shonen Jump Manga & Comics – Editor’s choice

Shonen Jump is the most-used app on my iPhone. It provides all the trending shonen manga and lets you download chapters to read offline. I love to read the ongoing series on it as the app updates new chapters whenever it’s available in Japan. That takes the waiting game out of the picture.

You will enjoy each manga panel as the app offers a 2-page spread view in landscape mode. Besides, it syncs your reading progress across all your devices to help you keep track of your favorite series. The best part is you can get a free preview of premium volumes before purchase.  

Titles available: My Hero Academia, Jujutsu Kaisen, One Piece, Chainsaw Man, Demon Slayer, One-Punch Man, Naruto, Bleach, Death Note, Dragon Ball, Boruto, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, Spy x Family, etc.

Pros

  • 15,000+ manga chapters
  • No ads
  • Dark mode available

Cons

  • Difficult to switch between landscape and portrait modes
  • The interface could be improved 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

2. MANGA Plus by SHUEISHA – Best app to read manga for free

Any list of free manga reading apps would be incomplete without this top pick – MANGA Plus. This is the official manga reader from Shueisha Inc., the publisher behind the most notable comics such as Naruto, Dragon Ball, One Piece, Bleach, and more. My current favorite is Spy X Family.

It’s available globally, and you get the latest chapters for free simultaneously when they are released in Japan. Moreover, the app directly compensates the creators and avoids piracy. My favorite part about this app is connecting with a large web community and leaving comments on each chapter you read.

You can even create a collection of your favorite manga. Lastly, the app is well laid out and easy to navigate. Rotating your phone quickly switches between landscape and portrait modes. You can even choose the reading direction and manga resolution.

Titles available: One Piece, My Hero Academia, Jujutsu Kaisen, Hunter x Hunter, Black Clover, Boruto: Naruto Next Generations, Dragon Ball Super, Bleach, Naruto, Death Note, Tokyo Ghoul, Mashle: magic and Muscles, etc.

Pros

  • Classic legendary manga collection
  • Read for free
  • Multiple language translation

Cons

  • Some chapter gaps
  • Limited content

Price: Free

Download

3. VIZ Manga – All genres in one place

VIZ Manga offers the most comprehensive collection of manga of all genres, including shojo romance, slice of life, drama, comedy, horror, etc. I use this app to read new chapters of Komi Can’t Communicate for free (no pun intended ). The app updates its library weekly and makes the chapters available the same day it is released in Japan.  

The manga reader is easy to use and displays each panel as original without cropping. Moreover, you may read offline by downloading chapters. Also, the registered users can continue reading where they left off and sync all devices. Moreover, the premium subscription is affordable and gives access to the whole library. 

Titles available: Komi Can’t Communicate, Uzumaki, Inuyasha, Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead, Nana, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End, Kimi ni Todoke, Call of the Night, etc.

Pros

  • 10,000+ manga chapters
  • Create a personal reading list
  • Few titles offer new chapters for free

Cons

  • Glitchy sometimes

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

4. WebComics – Enjoy webtoons with manga

Not only manga but also webtoons take up a large portion of my reading list. And WebComics is the best place to get trending webtoons. It has an extensive collection of manga, comics, manhwa, anime, etc. In almost all genres! Also, it includes American, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese comic books.

Besides, BL lovers can enjoy exclusive original series. I liked its simple UI, smooth reading experience, full-colored HD panels, and personalized suggestions. The app releases new comics and updates chapters daily. Further, you may unlock exclusive deals to read limited-edition books.  

The best part is you can interact with your favorite creator via the creator community. The app also has connected 8000k comic enthusiasts worldwide. Additionally, you may create your own community and chat with web friends.

Titles available: My Disciples Are She-Devils, The God Devourer, Marvelous Hero of the Sword, Bride of the Dawn, The Naive Mr. Lu, School Beauty’s Private Bodyguard, etc.

Pros

  • Free manga released every day
  • Exclusive original content
  • Supports full-screen view and dark mode
  • Interactive creator community

Cons

  • Need to buy coins to read for free
  • No way to track read and unread comics. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

5. MangaToon – Read manga in your language

If you want an app to read more than manga, then MangaToon is ideal. It offers various manhua, comic books, novels, and chat stories. To enjoy premium chapters for free, you may earn free points and reading vouchers. The best part is the app supports 8 more languages besides English. 

Titles available: Mademoiselle will mess around, Bossy President, Dragon Princess Yuan, The Heiress Young Ruffian, etc.

Pros

  • Publish your original stories in their community
  • Multiple language translations
  • Read novels and chat stories
  • iMessage support

Cons

  • The library is updated weekly
  • Reading on iPad is glitchy

Price: Free ($0.99 for 100 coins)

Download

6. Manga Readеr – Offline reading companion

While on the go, we don’t have a stable network connection to fetch and load HD manga. To solve this, I suggest using the Manga Reader app. It offers 1000+ manga titles to pick and download for offline reading. Hence, you will get the finest uninterrupted reading experience.

Besides, I liked its smooth navigation and personalized daily recommendations on the “Today” home page. Moreover, the app has enhanced filtering and search capabilities to explore new titles quickly. However, the app requires a membership to read a whole manga.

Titles available: Solo Leveling, Jujutsu Kaisen, Black Clover, Hunter X Hunter, Chainsaw Man, One-Punch Man, Naruto, etc.

Pros

  • Personalized manga recommendations
  • Minimal and non-intrusive advertisements
  • Multiple reading modes

Cons

  • Needs a subscription to read manga

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download

8. Manga Storm CBR – Read different manga formats

This app is a free manga comic reader that can fetch DRM-free comics in CBR/CBZ/PDF files from your cloud storage. So, it imports comics you already have on the cloud onto your iPhone or iPad for easy offline reading. Also, you can use it to organize your imported comics in multilevel folders (called “comic groups”).

Besides, the app lets you set your most comfortable reading direction. Further, your reading progress is saved automatically, and you can even read multiple comics continuously, moving from the last page of the current one to the first page of the next comic with a swipe.

Of course, this app does not help discover any new content. It’s solely a manga reader app for those who already have comics in supported formats like CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, RAR, ZIP, 7Z, TAR, and PDF files.

Pros

  • Handy reading options 
  • Supports multiple file formats
  • Create Comic driver
  • Automatic bookmarking

Cons

  • The interface looks outdated and clunky

Price: Free (Get Pro subscription at $2.99)

Download

Enjoy fellow otakus, Dattebayo!

The best manga reader apps for iPhone and iPad offer a convenient and immersive way to indulge in the captivating world of manga. With various features, extensive libraries, offline reading, and user-friendly interfaces, these apps cater to the preferences of all manga enthusiasts.

Which app do you use to read manga and comics? Let me know in the comments below; I will surely try that app!

Explore more…

  • Best free anime games for iPhone to play
  • Best Free Visual Novel iPhone and iPad Apps

  • Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Qi2 15W Charging Station
  • HiWe MagSafe 7-Card RFID-Blocking Wallet
  • Qi2.2 25W MagSafe Car Vent Charger
  • LISEN Qi2 15W 5000mAh MagSafe Power Bank
  • JLab Go Sport+ Wireless Workout Earbuds

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

title.rendered: Best hidden iPhone secret codes to know in 2026

content.rendered:
All smartphones, including iPhones, can reveal information or perform some handy action when entering a specific USSD code. Since these secret dialer codes are not mentioned explicitly, you may not be aware of them. To assist, I have listed 15 useful iPhone secret codes that you will find interesting and helpful. Take a look.

Table of Contents
  • What are iPhone secret codes?
  • 15 most useful iPhone secret codes
    • 1. Find out how much signal your iPhone has
    • 2. Hide or show your caller ID
    • 3. Check the SMS center
    • 4. Check, enable, or disable Call Waiting status
    • 5. See iPhone IMEI number
    • 6. See iPhone IMSI
    • 7. Check Call barring
    • 8. Forward calls
    • 9. Get local traffic information
    • 10. Check cellular data usage
    • 11. Check Call Line Presentation
    • 12. Check the postpaid or prepaid account balance
    • 13. Check alert system
    • 14. See your missed calls
    • 15. Full Rate Mode

What are iPhone secret codes?

Secret codes are just a fancy name for Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), which are strings of characters basically used by developers and technicians to troubleshoot smartphones. 

Every smartphone has a different set of access codes and shortcuts that allow you to modify internal iPhone settings.

If you’re a ’90s kid, these secret codes were more popular back when the device’s settings were less sophisticated and didn’t allow users to modify their functions. Regardless, these codes still let you do certain things faster and access information readily, with fewer taps. 

15 most useful iPhone secret codes

Before you begin:

  • Please note that several codes mentioned here may not work globally or with all carriers. They are functional only in the United States and their carriers.
  • To use all these codes, you have to open the Phone app and be in the Keypad tab. Some codes require you to tap the call button, while a few may not.

Now, let the magic begin!

1. Find out how much signal your iPhone has

To find out, you can Enter Field Test Mode by typing *3001#12345#*

This lets you see all the details about your iPhone’s settings, network, and other technical data about your device.

You can use this to check your signal if you have poor reception. Just look for Rsrp, which stands for Reference Signal Received Power. Rsrp0 is the tower nearest you, while Rsrp1 is the second closest. Beside it are numbers ranging from -40 to -140 decibel-milliwatts. Signals closer to -40 indicate a strong signal, while a number closer to -140 indicates that you have a poor connection.

2. Hide or show your caller ID

If your carrier supports hiding your caller ID, you can use this secret code to hide your caller ID. This means that when you call someone, they’ll see an Unknown or No Caller ID.

  • If you’re in the US, enter *67 before the number you want to call.
  • If you’re outside the US, enter *31 before the number and hit the Call button.

On the other hand, add *82 before the number to show your Caller ID.

3. Check the SMS center

Whenever you send an SMS, it goes straight to the SMS center or server before being forwarded to the receiver. If you’re facing any issues with SMS, enter the hidden code *#5005*7672# on your iPhone to see more details.

4. Check, enable, or disable Call Waiting status

The Call Waiting feature notifies you of another call when you’re already on a call. To learn if this is enabled on your iPhone, use the code *#43#. Dialing *43# enables it, while using #43# disables it.

5. See iPhone IMEI number

The International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) is a 15 to 17-digit number that serves as a unique ID for your phone’s hardware. Carriers can block stolen or lost phones using their IMEI at a network level. This is important to know when your device gets stolen or lost.

Just type the code *#06# to see your IMEI and other details.

6. See iPhone IMSI

The international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) can be seen on your SIM card packet the moment you buy it. It is a unique number that identifies every user of a cellular network. Find your IMSI number by dialing 5005# on the keypad.

7. Check Call barring 

Call barring lets you block incoming or outgoing calls to and from your phone. This may be useful if you keep receiving unwanted telemarketer calls or want to avoid expensive international calls.

To check if the feature is enabled on your device, dial *#33#. Use the code *33*pin# to enable call barring on your iPhone. To disable call barring, dial #33*pin#.

8. Forward calls

Using the call forwarding feature, you can easily forward your calls to your phone’s answering machine or another number. Use the code *#21# to check for its status on your iPhone. 

Alternatively, you can directly dial *21#. This enables call forwarding if disabled and disables it if it’s currently enabled.

You can also elect to forward your calls to another number by adding *21 to the phone number to which you want to forward your calls.

Depending on your carrier, there are also varied ways to forward calls on your iPhone.

9. Get local traffic information

Sometimes you want to know the traffic status but aren’t connected to the internet to use traffic apps like Google Maps. In such cases, you may dial 511 to learn about your local traffic.

10. Check cellular data usage

If you’re on prepaid and rely on cellular data for your connection, you can easily check your cellular data usage by dialing the following codes below, depending on your carrier: 

  • AT&T: *3282#
  • Verizon: #3282
  • T-mobile: #932#

Meanwhile, if you’re on postpaid, you can check your data plan status by using the code *646#.

11. Check Call Line Presentation

Call Line Presentation enables the call recipient to see the telephone number of their caller. If the recipient of your call can’t see your number, you may want to check if Call Line Presentation is enabled on your phone by dialing *#30#.

12. Check the postpaid or prepaid account balance

  • If you’re on postpaid, you can check your bill balance by entering *225#
  • If you’re on prepaid, check your account balance by typing *777#

13. Check alert system

Test Emergency Alerts contain government test alerts from your local government. This is disabled by default.

If you’re running iOS 15.3 or earlier, tap *5005*25371# to enable your iPhone’s Alert System Status. To turn it off, just enter *5005*25370#.

Meanwhile, if your phone is running iOS 15.6 or later, just head to Settings → Notifications →  toggle Test Alerts on or off. You can also check out our guide on how to turn off government alerts.

14. See your missed calls

If you’re wondering how many missed calls you have, just dial #61#.

15. Full Rate Mode

While the iPhone has numerous audio settings that let you adjust audio quality, you can also enable your iPhone’s Enhanced Full Rate (EFR) mode to improve your call sound quality. Just type *3370# to enable it.

The downside is that your iPhone will likely spend more power during calls.

Wrapping up…

I hope you learned about a few new shortcodes. Which one from the list above seems most helpful to you? Let me know in the comments below. Second, if you know other similar codes, share them with me as well. We would love to mention that in this post.

Finally, here are some more helpful posts you will love to check out:

Read more:

  • 22 Tips to use iPhone like a Pro
  • How to use T9 dialing on an iPhone

  • LISEN Qi2 15W 5000mAh MagSafe Power Bank
  • JLab Go Sport+ Wireless Workout Earbuds
  • Anker 100W 3-Port GaN Charger with Smart Display

title.rendered: Best iPad Pro 10.5-inch Screen Protectors in 2026

content.rendered:
The first line of defense that I make sure to choose for my iPad even before completely interacting with it is—a high-quality screen guard. Knowing how badly a little scratch can harm the user experience, I make sure to go for a trusted shield. And this wise decision always keeps my tablet on the safer side in the case of accidental falls! Taking all the must-have qualities in mind, I have selected the best 10.5-inch iPad Pro screen Protectors that have been prepared to stand up to the task admirably.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Anker
  • 2. TANTEK
  • 3. Skinomi Tech
  • 4. iCarez
  • 5. OMOTON
  • 6. Halnziye
  • 7. Ztotop
  • 8. amFilm
  • 9. ESR
  • 10. iLLumiShield

1. Anker


Anker screen guard is an absolute beast. Constructed with the finest tempered glass, it is enormously strong and fully capable of knocking down even ugly scratch. It’s just 0.3mm thick and comes with oleophobic coating to prevent fingerprints and dust.

Since it’s bubble-free, you will not have a hard time while installing it on your device screen. The high definition clarity offers a delightful viewing experience. Being highly sensitive, it recognizes your every touch and tap.

USP: HD clarity
Check out on Amazon

2. TANTEK

This screen defender from TANTEK is a reliable bet. And what puts it ahead of the curve is the precise laser cutting. So, expect this screen guard to perfectly fit on the screen.

The high clarity coupled with 9H hardness makes it a complete package. Thus, you have a much-improved viewing experienced. Lastly, TANTEK offers it in a pack of three topped by a lifetime replacement warranty.

USP: Anti-scuffs and smudge
Check out on Amazon

3. Skinomi Tech

Skinomi Tech screen guard is extremely easy to install thanks to the smooth edges. It provides full-screen protection from scratch. What stands this tempered glass screen guard in good stead is the 9H hardness.

Being so robust, it can withstand even the sharp scratch by a knife. The crystal clarity ensures you have a great viewing experience. As it keeps grime and smudges away, you will continue to enjoy smooth-sailing touch experience.

USP: 9H Hardness
Check out on Amazon

4. iCarez

The one quality that makes iCarez screen protector a top choice is exceptional responsiveness. The premium tempered material retains its full-fledged functionality for long. Empowered by scratch-resistant coating, the screen guard doesn’t let scratch harm the screen of your device.

The high transparency ensures the retina display never loses its charm. Precise cutouts allow sensors and front camera to function without any disturbance. Lastly, it comes in a pack of two protectors with a single purchase.

USP: Touch-sensitive
Check out on Amazon

5. OMOTON

OMOTON screen guard boasts of high definition clarity. Endowed with industry-standard hardness, it has enough strength to keep scrape at bay. Since the protector is bubble-free, you will be able to install it without any hassle. What’s more, it doesn’t leave any residue behind when you remove it. Another important quality to take note of is that it is gifted with high sensitivity.

USP: Industry-standard hardness
Check out on Amazon

6. Halnziye

Halnziye screen guard comes with rounded edges that assist it is not just getting installed perfectly on the screen but also offer edge-to-edge protection. The industry-leading hardness has been further bolstered by the oleophobic coating that doesn’t allow fingerprints, oil or grime to damage its quality.

The premium tempered glass offers stunning clarity. Being quite smooth, your fingers have a nice feel when touching its surface. Moreover, the protector is solid enough to retain its impressive functionality for long.

USP: Round edges
Check out on Amazon

7. Ztotop

Ztotop screen protector has packed in with all the required qualities to be rated as a trusted shield for the touchscreen of your iPad. The slightly curved edges make it ultra-convenient to install the guard. Since there is no bubble at all; you won’t face any difficulty while putting it on the screen.

Since it doesn’t leave any residue behind when removed, you will be able to uninstall it without any pain at all. The Hydrophobic Oleophobic coating keeps both clarity and responsiveness intact by driving away dust, sweat, and fingerprints. It comes with two protectors inside the box.

USP: Anti-fingerprint
Check out on Amazon

8. amFilm

With 0.33mm thickness and robust hardness, amFilm has been primed to be an immaculate defender of your iPad Pro’s touchscreen. It has precise cutouts for front camera and sensors. The protector has curved edges which empower it to offer the complete safeguard to the screen. As for transparency and responsiveness, it’s right up there with the best. The screen guard doesn’t allow dust, grime or oil to build up.

USP: Anti-scratch
Check out on Amazon

9. ESR

ESR screen protector is made to be anti-scratch. Hence, the screen guard can help the touchscreen of your device to come out unscathed even from a brutal fall—face down. With 0.33 thickness, it has the strength to ward off scratch when it really matters the most.

Another thing worth mentioning is that this protector offers maximum clarity of 99% which is quite decent. Moreover, you will have a natural touch feel when interacting with the screen of your device.

USP: Shatter resistance
Check out on Amazon

10. iLLumiShield

Powered by a tempered ballistic glass screen, iLLumiShield is exactly what you need to keep the delicate touchscreen shielded from brutal scratch. The protector has the 9H hardness that can even knock down the scratch of a dagger.

Both in terms of offering natural touch feel and transparency, it stands up to the mark. And since there is no bubble at all, you will be able to put it on the screen with a breeze. Needless to say, it’s good enough to prevent grime or sweat from destroying your smooth experience.

USP: Natural touch feel
Check out on Amazon

That’s all!

Pick up the Right Shield

Which one of these screen guards has made it to your iPad Pro? Let me know its name and the quality that you have liked in it.

And yes, if I missed to include any quality screen guard, do inform me about that. One important thing, I will keep on updating this elite list so that you will easily find the most robust shield for your tablet.

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

title.rendered: Best mousepads for Apple Magic Mouse in 2026

content.rendered:
Using a mouse pad for your Apple Magic Mouse is important. Not only does it help your mouse glide around with ease, but it also protects the mouse from dirt and scratches. However, choosing such an accessory among thousands of options is never easy.

So, with my list of the best mouse pads for Apple Magic Mouse, you’ll know exactly which mouse pad to go for if you’re in need of one.

Without further ado, let’s check out these fantastic products!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Belkin Large Mouse Pad – Editor's choice
  • 2. Vaydeer Hard Silver Mouse Pad – Extremely durable
  • 3. 3M Mouse Pad – Perfect for precision
  • 4. SteelSeries QcK – Designed for gaming
  • 5. K KNODEL Mouse Pad – Highly versatile
  • 6. JIKIOU Mouse Pad – Budget friendly
  • 7. French Koko Mouse Pad – Beautiful design

1. Belkin Large Mouse Pad – Editor’s choice

Belkin has always produced some of the best Apple accessories, whether you’re looking for an iPhone case or a car mount. So, it’s no surprise that we’ve got a Belkin mouse pad on our list of the best mouse pads for the Magic Mouse. This particular mouse pad comes with a durable jersey surface that helps you glide your mouse with immaculate ease.

At the back, Belkin has provided a neoprene, non-slip surface. This ensures that your mouse pad doesn’t move around the surface and slip on slanted surfaces. Regardless of whether you’re playing games or editing videos, the mouse pad’s surface provides you with pinpoint accuracy. Moreover, since the mouse pad is quite large, you’ll be able to move your mouse around with complete freedom.

The only minor issue with the mouse pad is its smell. That’s right – since the mouse pad is made of rubber, the smell lingers for quite a few days. Nonetheless, this isn’t a dealbreaker!

Pros

  • Decently priced
  • Quite durable and smooth
  • Has a comfortable size

Cons

  • Comes with a chemical smell

Check out on Amazon

2. Vaydeer Hard Silver Mouse Pad – Extremely durable

Although most of the mouse pads for Apple Magic Mouse tend to be made of rubber, this practice doesn’t spell great in terms of durability. Cheap rubber mouse pads can get worn out pretty easily. If you’re looking for something that’s built to last, check out this Vaydeer mouse pad.

The mouse pad is made of aluminum, which already increases its durability tenfold. To be more precise, there are two surfaces on the mouse pad. The metal side is made of aircraft-grade aluminum alloy. On the other hand, the other side is made of premium PU leather. While the metal side is good enough on most days, you’ll prefer using the leather side during colder nights and during the winters.

Regardless of whichever side you use, you’ll find the mouse pad to be extremely smooth. This also increases the precision with which the Magic Mouse works. Apart from this, the pad itself is pretty thin, with a lightweight finish. According to the manufacturers, the surface is also waterproof.

Pros

  • Very durable thanks to aluminum alloy construction
  • Double-sided with PU leather at the back
  • Relatively thin and lightweight

Cons

  • The waterproof claim isn’t backed up by an IP rating

Check out on Amazon

3. 3M Mouse Pad – Perfect for precision

While the Apple Magic Mouse and Magic Mouse 2 are quite precise by themselves, you can always go for more precision. Moreover, when precision comes under $10, it’s never a bad option. With this mouse pad from 3M, you’re virtually guaranteed more precise strokes with the Magic Mouse.

This particular mouse pad is also designed specifically for wireless and optical mice. In fact, the material used in its construction helps the mouse reduce any losses in signals and skip errors. It also helps to know that this mouse pad is quite thin and can be stored away at the back of your notepad. Lastly, the back of the mouse pad uses an advanced adhesive that lets you keep the pad in place.

However, some users have stated that the new iteration of the mouse pad feels slightly flimsy.

Pros

  • Designed to add precision and control
  • Reduces signal loss and latency
  • Easy to store

Cons

  • Feels slightly flimsy

Check out on Amazon

4. SteelSeries QcK – Designed for gaming

This might come as a slight surprise, but the Apple Magic Mouse can be used for gaming. Since the mouse works with both macOS and Windows, pairing the mouse isn’t an issue. Furthermore, the mouse is quite precise and works perfectly for fast-paced games such as first-person shooters.

So, if you’re a gamer who uses the Apple Magic Mouse or Magic Mouse 2 for gaming, check out this SteelSeries QcK mouse pad. The pad uses SteelSeries’ exclusive QcK micro woven cloth, which is optimized for both low and high DPI movements. Additionally, the nonslip rubber base ensures that your mousepad stays in place during competitive gaming sessions.

You’ll also receive a boost in accuracy thanks to the high thread count in the fiber and the overall smooth finish of the mouse pad. Basically, this is one of the best gaming accessories and the best mouse pads for magic mouse, especially if you’re a gamer.

Nonetheless, you might find the mouse pad slightly challenging to keep clean.

Pros

  • Exclusively designed micro woven cloth for fluid operation
  • The rubber base ensures stability
  • Decent finish

Cons

  • Can attract dirt easily

Check out on Amazon

5. K KNODEL Mouse Pad – Highly versatile

What’s better than a small mouse pad for Apple Magic Mouse? An entire desk mat that provides stability and space for all your accessories! This mouse pad (or desk mat, if you will), comes at a large size of 31.5″ x 15.7″, which is big enough to keep your keyboard, mouse, Apple Pen, and iPad.

The size of the mat helps in protecting your desk from gathering dust and provides a smooth, stable surface to glide your mouse. Moreover, the premium PU leather material of the mat ensures longevity that you won’t find in other mouse pads.

Moreover, the company also claims the mat to be resistant to water and heat. This makes the mat easier to clean, as you’ll be able to wipe away any spills with a damp washcloth. While there aren’t too many premium features in the mouse pad, it looks good and does the job perfectly!

However, the mat comes tightly rolled and will take a few days of usage to completely flatten out. You might have to manually flatten it out using heavier weights.

Pros

  • Minimalist and practical design
  • Made of premium PU leather
  • Provides some resistance to water and heat

Cons

  • Takes some time to flatten out completely

Check out on Amazon

6. JIKIOU Mouse Pad – Budget friendly

title.rendered: What is Inactivity Reboot in iOS 18.1, and how does it work?

content.rendered:
Apple continues to solidify its reputation for security with iOS. Its recent update, iOS 18.1, offers an array of features with a groundbreaking Inactivity Reboot that raises the security bar on your iPhone. Keep reading as we explore what the Inactivity Reboot feature is and explain how it works seamlessly in the background on your iPhone to prevent unauthorized access.

Table of Contents
  • What is Inactivity Reboot in iOS 18.1?
  • How does the iPhone Inactivity Reboot feature work?
    • BFU VS AFU
  • How to get Inactivity Reboot on your iPhone
  • Advantages and disadvantages of iPhone rebooting after 3 days of inactivity

What is Inactivity Reboot in iOS 18.1?

Inactivity Reboot is a new iPhone security feature in iOS 18.1 that automatically restarts your device after three days of inactivity. While the feature was discovered accidentally, it can effectively secure your device data from thieves and unauthorized access.

This undocumented security feature can make it difficult for someone trying to break into your device. Inactivity Reboot puts your iPhone into a BFU (Before First Unlock) state, encrypting the user data, which is much harder to crack as compared to the AFU (After First Unlock) state.

How does the iPhone Inactivity Reboot feature work?

The Inactivity Reboot feature uses SEP (Secure Enclave Processor) to track the last unlocked state of your iPhone. If the last unlock time exceeds three days (72 hours), SEP initiates the command to restart the system.

Once your iPhone restarts, it enters the Before First Unlock (BFU) state. In this state, encryption keys are enabled to ensure your data remains encrypted and secure until the device is unlocked again.

BFU VS AFU

BFU (Before First Unlock) is a state when your iPhone restarts, but you haven’t unlocked it with a PIN or a password, as FaceID or TouchID alone won’t let you do so. This state engages automatically on reboot and keeps the device data encrypted till you unlock it. Your iPhone is in its most secure state in BFU and can only receive calls.

Once you unlock your iPhone with the correct PIN or password, the AFU (After First Unlock) state kicks in, offering some level of decrypted data access, making it friendly for forensic and hacking tools to crack and extract your data on the device.

In simple words, AFU is less secure than BFU and easier to crack for tools to access your personal content.

How to get Inactivity Reboot on your iPhone

iOS 18.1 doesn’t have a specific toggle to enable or disable Inactivity Reboot. The feature is hardwired in the code and triggers automatically after a certain period of inactivity. This inactivity period was initially set to seven days in iOS 18.0 but later updated to three days in iOS 18.1.

To get this feature working on your iPhone, you must update it to iOS 18.1 or above. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Settings app and go to General.
  2. Tap Software Update and select Install Now.

Advantages and disadvantages of iPhone rebooting after 3 days of inactivity

Having your iPhone reboot after three days of inactivity can serve several advantages. Aside from improving your device’s performance and overall stability, it eliminates any security vulnerability or background process that may exploit your iPhone’s security. In addition, it can optimize your iPhone’s battery and prevent unnecessary battery drain.

I don’t see any significant disadvantages of having your iPhone reboot after being inactive for three days. At most, it may disrupt your file download queue or flush your temporary app data, which can be restored by simply opening the app again.

Wrapping up

Inactivity Reboot may not seem like a significant feature at first, but it can truly be a game-changer for defining the iPhone security standard. That said, law enforcers and hackers still have an opportunity to bypass your device before the inactivity reboot triggers after three days of inactivity. To stay protected, I recommend rebooting your iPhone while you can — a simple but effective way to strengthen its security.

For a deep dive, you can check out Jiska Classen’s blog on Inactivity Reboot, where he reverse-engineers the feature and explains the nitty-gritty in detail.

FAQs

Can you set your iPhone to turn it off after a certain time?

iOS 18 doesn’t offer any feature to shut down your iPhone after a certain time. However, you can configure to lock your device after a certain period from Settings > Display & Brightness > Auto-Lock.

Do all iPhones have the auto-start feature?

All iPhones updated to iOS 18 and above can restart automatically after three days of inactivity. However, in some cases, your iPhone may reboot due to a software bug or a glitch.

Can you turn off Inactivity Reboot on iOS 18?

Currently, you can’t disable the Inactivity Reboot feature on iOS 18, as it’s built into the system’s code. Apple is working on refining Inactivity Reboot for iOS 18.2, but it’s unlikely that a toggle to turn it off will be included.

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

title.rendered: Best MagSafe cases for iPhone 14 series in 2026

content.rendered:
Getting a good protective case is the next step after buying an iPhone 14. A careless drop can damage the screen. MagSafe cases are a great choice. Besides safeguarding your iPhone, it allows for quick wireless charging and compatibility with other MagSafe accessories. To help you out, I have hand-picked the best MagSafe cases for iPhone 14 series.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple leather case with MagSafe – Editor's choice
  • 2. Spigen Mag Armor – Good grip
  • 3. ESR Air Armor clear case with HaloLock – Ultimate drop protection
  • 4. Caseology Nano Pop Mag silicone case – Simple and minimal
  • 5. TORRAS translucent matte case – Fingerprint-proof
  • 6. Otterbox Defender XT clear case – Rugged and durable
  • 7. Ringke Fusion Magnetic clear case – User-friendly
  • 8. Case-Mate Tough Plus case 3-in-1 pack
  • 9. CASEKOO Mag clear cases – Crystal clear forever

1. Apple leather case with MagSafe – Editor’s choice

I think Apple’s official leather case with MagSafe is ideal for a classy patina look and provides additional protection for your iPhone. It is made of finely tanned and treated leather that feels premium and has perfectly aligned built-in magnets. Also, you can easily snap on the thin case and fit your iPhone appropriately. Besides, wireless charging is quicker and simpler than before. 

So, shield your iPhone from drops and scratches in addition to easy press buttons and precise cutouts. The screen’s edges are sufficiently high to prevent the screen from getting scratched. Remember that using MagSafe accessories will leave very few traces of interaction.

Pros

  • Official MagSafe compatibility
  • Tanned and treated leather
  • Luxurious look

Cons

  • Pricey

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max

2. Spigen Mag Armor – Good grip

Spigen Mag Armor MagFit case offers an attractive matte-textured look with a sleek pattern and fine lines. Besides, the thermoplastic polyurethane and PVC material are shock absorbing. Also, the chances of sudden drops are lessened thanks to the textured TPU sides. The embedded clicky buttons provide reliable feedback. 

The best part is it is 0.07″ thin, and the raised borders protect the screen and cameras from scratches. Also, Spigen’s Air Cushion technology with padded corners provides additional drop protection. And without any doubt, its integrated magnets are strong and complement wireless charging and MagSafe accessories.

Pros

  • Sleek pattern
  • Textured TPU sides for good grip
  • Optimal slimness

Cons

  • Only two color options

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max

Check out on Spigen:iPhone 14 | 14 Plus

3. ESR Air Armor clear case with HaloLock – Ultimate drop protection

If you are prone to slip off your iPhone, this ESR Air Armour MagSafe-compatible case is for you. The reinforced shock-absorbing Air-Guard corners, raised screen edges, and camera guard lens frame provides test-certified military-grade protection from drops, bumps, and scratches. Besides, you will get a magnetic strength of 1500g, which is perfect for the HaloLock and MagSafe.    

Also, place-and-go wireless charging is quicker and simpler. To keep your case looking brand-new and showcase the genuine elegance of your iPhone for longer, it has a durable acrylic back with a matte surface that resists scratches and never turns yellow. The sides, however, will become yellow because they are TPU. Therefore, I advise choosing the one with the black option.

Pros

  • Air guard corners
  • Tough acrylic back
  • Fingerprint-proof

Cons

  • Rubbery hand feel

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14

4. Caseology Nano Pop Mag silicone case – Simple and minimal

I love minimal cases for iPhones, so I recommend the Caseology dual-tone Nano Pop case. The contrasting twin colors, inspired by fresh fruit and summer hues, provide a splash of color to your iPhone 14. Besides, the body’s silky soft texture makes it cozy in your hand. 

Unique AirSpace Technology offers extra shock absorption on all four corners, protective inner defensive patterns, and raised camera rings. Moreover, it comes with screen protector compatibility and military-grade drop protection. Its MagSafe-compatible magnets will keep it aligned.

Pros

  • Dual tone
  • Lint and dust-free
  • Lightweight

Cons

  • The insider liner is glued in

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max

5. TORRAS translucent matte case – Fingerprint-proof

Want a stylish look for your new iPhone 14? This sleek TORRAS case is elegantly frosted for a translucent smoked finish with black edges. It has better scratch and fingerprint resistance thanks to the high-quality material from Germany. Also, the new Nano Oleophobic anti-yellowing coating provides a velvety smooth and silky touch sensation without being sticky. 

Besides, the TPU side soft bumper with a 4-ply cushioning and Sliproof technology offers a superb grip for secure holding and makes it 360° shockproof. It has patented airbags that are tested to survive drops of up to 10 feet. Also, the 1.2mm screen lips, 0.8mm camera bezels, and Camera Airbags guard against dust, scratches, and damage.

This improved magnetic array with 4x stronger magnets aligns properly and securely with MagSafe chargers for safe and quick wireless charging. Additionally, its independently operated buttons are more responsive and simple to push, providing a pleasant tactile experience. I loved its interchangeable button colors for a customized look.

Pros

  • Patented camera lens AirBags
  • Grippy feel 
  • Colorful button options

Cons

  • Slippery

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max

6. Otterbox Defender XT clear case – Rugged and durable

Otterbox is a veteran among iPhone case brands. Their Defender series is well-known for its 5x DROP+ protection, which surpasses military standards. The superior durable construction is made of 50% recycled plastic that safeguards against drops and scratches. Also, its not-so-bulky profile maintains a secure grip. 

The synthetic rubber slipcover and protective 2-piece design keep the dirt out. Furthermore, MagSafe chargers and accessories are secured by built-in magnets. You will love it because it’s comfortable to handle, equipped with a lanyard attachment, and upgradeable with a holster option. Also, stay stress-free with the lifetime limited OtterBox warranty.

Pros

  • Protective 2-piece design
  • Port covers
  • Optional holster

Cons

  • Slightly thick

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max

7. Ringke Fusion Magnetic clear case – User-friendly

How about adding a hand strap or wrist lanyard to your iPhone case? Ringke Fusion case includes Duo-QuikCatch lanyard holes on either side for easy accessibility. Besides, the brand has added a 38-piece magnetic ring in the hybrid transparent case for the safe attachment of MagSafe accessories and charger.

Also, the polycarbonate clear back panel, TPU bumper frame, reinforced corners, and higher bezels give you tough protection. Therefore, it disperses the effect of unintentional drops and bumps. But after a few months, the PU material becomes yellow with daily usage.

Pros

  • Anti-shock protection
  • Duo-QuikCatch lanyard holes 
  • Built-in 38-piece magnetic ring

Cons

  • Yellows with prolonged use

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro

Check out on Ringke: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Ma

8. Case-Mate Tough Plus case 3-in-1 pack

The Case-Mate 3-in-1 protective kit provides 360-degree protection for the iPhone 14 series. The pack includes a Tough Plus MagSafe phone case, a glass screen protector, and a lens cover. The thin-fit case has increased cushions and air ridges layers for 15-foot drop protection. Also, the built-in magnets allow MagSafe charging and 5mm raised lips to protect the screen and camera. 

This brand uses plant materials and technology that resist scratching and yellowing. In addition, it features soft textured side bumpers, tactile buttons, and an improved grip. Additionally, you’ll get a 9H tempered glass screen protector. It prevents dust, scratches, and fingerprints, provides 2X shatter protection, and maintains screen clarity. 

Lastly, the tempered glass lens protector with a protective frame offers your iPhone camera lenses the best possible damage protection. The thin layer resists fingerprints to avoid smudges and streaks on the back camera. You can install screen and lens protectors easily thanks to the precise cuts and high-quality adhesive.

Pros

  • 15ft drop protection
  • Fits perfectly
  • 5mm raised edges

Cons

  • Weak magnets

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max

9. CASEKOO Mag clear cases – Crystal clear forever

CASEKOO MagSafe case includes an exclusive patent magnetic array called MagPrime technology for a strong magnetic field and safer battery health. Also, compared to the others, the magnetic force of the ring is 150% greater. Therefore, you will enjoy a seamless MagSafe attachment and faster wireless charging.

Besides, it is made of PC and ultra-clear TPU from German Bayer and has blue resin and innovative CRYS-GEL and CLEAR-LOCK technology. So, your case will look brand new for a prolonged time. Additionally, the 3-layer bumper with U-Shock 3.0 Corner Airbags can absorb 99.99% of the drop impact. 

Besides, the 2.5mm raised camera lip and 1.5mm raised screen edges to elevate the phone from flat surfaces to avoid bumps and scratches. Likewise, it works with any screen or camera protection. I liked its hybrid back panel protection with a non-slip coating, which is explosion-proof and has passed 4,000 daily scratch tests.

Pros

  • 7x mil-grade 10ft drop protection
  • Strongest magnets
  • Lifetime return and exchange

Cons

  • Collects dust

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | 14 Plus | 14 Pro | 14 Pro Max
